senses.en: Sleep at someone's house because you are too tired, drunk, etc. to leave.
senses.example: Dave CRASHED OUT at a friend's flat after the end-of-term party.
senses.example_zh: 期末派对后，戴夫在朋友家过夜。

senses.example: I CRASHED OUT in front of the TV last night.
senses.example_zh: 昨晚我在电视机前睡着了。

senses.en: Separate the best or most talented people so that they can receive special or different treatment.
senses.example: The private schools CREAM OFF many of the best pupils.
senses.example_zh: 私立学校选拔走了许多最优秀的学生。

senses.en: Take money or divert funds, usually wrongfully or unfairly.
senses.example: This means smaller banks can CREAM OFF excess profits during lending booms.
senses.example_zh: 这意味着较小的银行可以在贷款繁荣期捞取超额利润。

senses.example: He tried to stay calm, but you could hear the anger CREEPING IN.
senses.example_zh: 他试图保持冷静，但你能听到愤怒开始显现。

senses.en: Get included despite attempts to keep it or them out.
senses.example: Errors CREPT IN as the text got longer.
senses.example_zh: 随着文本变长，错误悄悄混入。

senses.example: An angry tone CREPT INTO her voice.
senses.example_zh: 她的声音中开始出现愤怒的语调。

senses.en: make someone feel worried or uneasy.
senses.example: He CREEPS me OUT when he gets drunk.
senses.example_zh: 他喝醉时让我感到毛骨悚然。

senses.en: To do the same activity for a very long time.
senses.example: He's been CREEPING OUT ON that computer game all day.
senses.example_zh: 他整天都在玩那个电脑游戏。

senses.en: Start to have a negative feeling.
senses.example: Fear CREPT OVER me as I walked through the graveyard.
senses.example_zh: 当我走过墓地时，恐惧感逐渐袭来。

senses.example: They CREPT UP ON their rivals and overtook them.
senses.example_zh: 他们悄悄逼近对手并超越了对方。

senses.example: I'm going to be late tonight as something has just CROPPED UP at work.
senses.example_zh: 今晚我要迟到，因为工作上突然有事。

senses.example: She CROSSED him OFF her Christmas card after they argued.
senses.example_zh: 他们吵架后，她把他从圣诞贺卡名单上划掉了。

senses.en: Put as line through some writing to show it is wrong.
senses.example: She CROSSED OUT her mistakes and wrote the correct answers above them.
senses.example_zh: 她划掉错误，在上方写上正确答案。

senses.example: The treasure map was deliberately drawn to CROSS us UP.
senses.example_zh: 这张藏宝图是故意画来迷惑我们的。

senses.example: He CRUISED THROUGH the exam.
senses.example_zh: 他轻松通过了考试。

senses.en: Clear a table in a restaurant.
senses.example: The waiter CRUMBED DOWN before the coffee was served.
senses.example_zh: 服务员在上咖啡前清理了餐桌。

senses.example: I've got to work tonight; can I CRY OFF going out for dinner?
senses.example_zh: 我今晚得工作；我能取消出去吃晚饭的约定吗？

senses.en: Shout because you are in pain.
senses.example: He CRIED OUT when he dropped the box on his toes.
senses.example_zh: 他把箱子掉到脚趾上时大叫了一声。

senses.en: Go across a place rather than around it to make the journey quicker.
senses.example: It'll be quicker if we CUT ACROSS the park.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们穿过公园会更快。

senses.en: Affect people of different groups, classes, etc.
senses.example: The issue CUTS ACROSS social backgrounds as it affects us all equally.
senses.example_zh: 这个问题跨越社会背景，因为它平等地影响我们所有人。

senses.example: The firm CUT BACK production because sales were sluggish.
senses.example_zh: 由于销售疲软，公司削减了生产。

senses.en: Remove branches from a plant or tree to encourage future growth.
senses.example: We CUT the tree BACK every winter.
senses.example_zh: 我们每年冬天都修剪这棵树。

senses.example: The government has decided to CUT BACK ON spending on the armed forces.
senses.example_zh: 政府已决定削减军费开支。

senses.example: I'm trying to CUT DOWN the amount of coffee I drink during the day.
senses.example_zh: 我正在努力减少白天喝咖啡的量。

senses.example: A lot of soldiers were CUT DOWN by enemy fire as they stormed the airport.
senses.example_zh: 许多士兵在冲向机场时被敌军火力击倒。

senses.en: Reduce a vertical thing to ground level by cutting.
senses.example: The logger CUT the tree DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 伐木工把树砍倒了。

senses.en: Cut something from a high position.
senses.example: After Christmas he didn't carefully detach all the decorations, he just CUT them all DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 圣诞节后，他没有仔细地取下所有装饰品，而是把它们都剪了下来。

senses.example: Doctors advised her to CUT DOWN ON the amount of saturated fats in her diet.
senses.example_zh: 医生建议她减少饮食中饱和脂肪的摄入量。

senses.example: The fans CUT IN when the engine starts getting too hot.
senses.example_zh: 当发动机开始过热时，风扇开始运转。

senses.en: Drive in front of another vehicle without warning.
senses.example: A car CUT IN and nearly caused an accident.
senses.example_zh: 一辆车突然抢道，差点造成事故。

senses.example: We were having a conversation when he came up and CUT IN.
senses.example_zh: 我们正在谈话，他走过来插了话。

senses.en: Include someone in a deal that makes money.
senses.example: We had to CUT the police IN on the deal to avoid trouble.
senses.example_zh: 为了避免麻烦，我们不得不让警方参与这笔交易。

senses.en: Mix fat and flour until the combine.
senses.example: CUT the butter IN with the flour.
senses.example_zh: 把黄油拌入面粉中。

senses.en: Stop your unfair or unreasonable behaviour.
senses.example: Will you two idiots CUT IT OUT and keep quiet.
senses.example_zh: 你们两个白痴能不能住手，保持安静。

senses.example: The telephone's been CUT OFF because we didn't pay the bill.
senses.example_zh: 因为我们没付账单，电话被切断了。

senses.example: The heavy snow has blocked many roads and CUT OFF a number of villages.
senses.example_zh: 大雪堵塞了许多道路，使一些村庄与外界隔绝。

senses.example: I'm CUTTING OUT salt from my diet.
senses.example_zh: 我正在从饮食中戒掉盐。

senses.en: When an engine or motor stops.
senses.example: The car CUT OUT at the traffic lights just as they went green.
senses.example_zh: 汽车在交通灯变绿时突然熄火了。

senses.en: Cut a picture or similar from a magazine, etc.
senses.example: I CUT some pictures OUT to use as visual aids.
senses.example_zh: 我剪下一些图片用作视觉辅助。

senses.example: We’d better CUT OUT, the security men are on the way.
senses.example_zh: 我们最好快走，保安正在过来。

senses.example: They CUT OUT three prime bulls from the herd.
senses.example_zh: 他们从牛群中分出了三头优质公牛。

senses.example: Although he'd promised to help, the star CUT OUT ON the charity when offered more money.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他承诺帮忙，但当有人出更多钱时，这位明星背弃了慈善机构。

senses.example: After cutting the tree down, the logger CUT it UP into logs.
senses.example_zh: 伐木工把树砍倒后，把它切成原木。

senses.en: Drive into a neighbouring lane, directly in front of another vehicle.
senses.example: I was just driving onto the motorway slip-road, when a red Mini CUT me UP and I had to brake suddenly to avoid an accident.
senses.example_zh: 我正驶入高速公路匝道时，一辆红色Mini车抢了我的道，我不得不急刹车以避免事故。

senses.example: Her reaction really CUT me UP.
senses.example_zh: 她的反应真让我伤心。

senses.en: Have a lot of small injuries.
senses.example: I CUT my hand UP when I broke the glass.
senses.example_zh: 我打碎玻璃时割伤了手。

senses.example: They tried to DAMP DOWN the anger over the announcement.
senses.example_zh: 他们试图平息对这项声明的愤怒。

senses.example: They tried to DAMP DOWN the flames before the fire spread.
senses.example_zh: 他们试图在火势蔓延前压住火焰。

senses.en: When there is too much moisture and a plant is affected by fungal parasites.
senses.example: The seedlings DAMP OFF in the spring if it's very wet.
senses.example_zh: 如果春天非常潮湿，幼苗会得猝倒病。

senses.example: He DASHED DOWN a memo and sent it to everybody.
senses.example_zh: 他匆匆写了一份备忘录并发给所有人。

senses.example: It's late-I'm going to DASH OFF home.
senses.example_zh: 很晚了，我要赶紧回家了。

senses.example: He DASHED OFF the report in a couple of hours.
senses.example_zh: 他几个小时就匆匆写完了报告。

senses.example: The truth only DAWNED ON me much later.
senses.example_zh: 直到很久以后我才明白真相。

senses.example: Trevor spent a long time looking at flats before he bought one, but eventually DECIDED ON one near his work.
senses.example_zh: 特雷弗花了很长时间看公寓，但最终选定了工作附近的一套。

senses.example: Jane spent a long time looking at houses before she bought one, but eventually DECIDED UPON one near her office.
senses.example_zh: 简花了很长时间看房子，但最终选定了办公室附近的一套。

senses.en: Become quieter or inaudible (of a sound).
senses.example: The last notes DIED AWAY and the audience burst into applause.
senses.example_zh: 最后的音符渐渐消失，观众爆发出掌声。

senses.en: When the parts of a plant above ground die, but the roots remain alive.
senses.example: The plant DIES BACK in the winter.
senses.example_zh: 这种植物在冬天枯萎。

senses.example: It was on the front pages of all the papers for a few days, but the interest gradually DIED DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 这件事在各大报纸的头版登了几天，但兴趣逐渐减弱了。

senses.example: I'm DYING FOR the weekend-this week's been so hard.
senses.example_zh: 我非常渴望周末——这周太辛苦了。

senses.example: Most of theelm trees in the UK DIED OFF when Dutch elm disease arrived.
senses.example_zh: 荷兰榆树病到来时，英国大多数榆树都相继死去。

senses.example: Some scientists say that the dinosaurs DIED OUT when a comet hit the earth and caused a nuclear winter.
senses.example_zh: 一些科学家说，恐龙是在彗星撞击地球并引发核冬天时灭绝的。

senses.example: We were starving so we really DUG IN when the food finally did arrive.
senses.example_zh: 我们饿坏了，所以食物终于上来时，我们真的开始大吃起来。

senses.example: Anticipating an artillery barrage, we quickly DUG IN.
senses.example_zh: 预料到会有炮击，我们迅速挖壕固守。

senses.example: She DUG INTO her handbag and pulled out a bunch of keys.

senses.example_zh: 他假装生病，这样就不用去上学了。

senses.example_zh: 你的孩子们在新学校表现如何？

senses.example: They were MAKING OUT at the party last night.

senses.example_zh: 在这张照片里我勉强能辨认出一个飞碟的轮廓。

senses.en: Be able to see or hear something.

senses.example_zh: 你能听清她在说什么吗？

senses.example_zh: 他们总是吵架，但很快就和好了。

senses.example_zh: 我认定他们是保守派，但他们非常开明。

senses.en: Tick, cross out or otherwise mark something to show that it has been dealt with.
senses.example: I MARKED OFF the items on the list as I finished them.
senses.example_zh: 我完成清单上的项目后就划掉它们。

senses.en: Draw lines to enclose an area.
senses.example: They MARKED OUT the pitch.
senses.example_zh: 他们划出了球场。

senses.example: His dedication MARKED him OUT FOR great things.
senses.example_zh: 他的奉献精神预示着他前途无量。

senses.en: Stand out because of certain qualities.
senses.example: Her speed MARKS her OUT FROM the rest of the group.
senses.example_zh: 她的速度使她在人群中脱颖而出。

senses.example: They MARK the goods UP by 25% before they sell them.

senses.example_zh: 许多宗教鼓励信徒在内部通婚。

senses.example_zh: 当她与外族通婚时，她的父母与她断绝了关系，拒绝和她说话。

senses.en: Crush something until it becomes a paste.
senses.example: He MASHED UP some bananas for the dessert.
senses.example_zh: 他捣碎了一些香蕉做甜点。

senses.en: Mix sources of audio, video or other computer sources..
senses.example: She MASHED UP the songs into a single track.
senses.example_zh: 她把歌曲混搭成了一首单曲。

senses.example_zh: 他弄坏了我的MP3播放器，还弄丢了我的文件。

senses.example_zh: 她刷爆了信用卡。

senses.example_zh: 如果你把我们的作品与竞争对手的相比，它看起来并不好。

senses.example_zh: 裁缝为我的西装量好了布料。

senses.en: Weigh or measure an exact amount.

senses.example_zh: 她称量出一百克粉末。

senses.example: The estate agent MEASURED UP all the rooms.
senses.example_zh: 房地产经纪人测量了所有房间。

senses.en: Be good enough, meet the required standard.
senses.example: She didn't MEASURE UP in her probationary period, so we didn't extend her contract.
senses.example_zh: 她在试用期表现不合格，所以我们没有续签她的合同。

senses.example: They made her a director, but she didn't MEASURE UP.
senses.example_zh: 他们让她当了主管，但她能力不够。

senses.en: Find out the size of something.
senses.example: They MEASURED UP the room.
senses.example_zh: 他们测量了房间的尺寸。

senses.en: Be good enough or worthy of something.
senses.example: I hope to MEASURE UP TO the confidence you have in me.
senses.example_zh: 我希望不辜负你对我的信任。

senses.example: They MET WITH some problems they hadn't anticipated.
senses.example_zh: 他们遇到了一些未曾预料到的问题。

senses.example_zh: 他们把金像熔化，铸成了金条。

senses.example: She is always MESSING me AROUND and never does what she promises.

senses.en: Have a sexual relationship outside marriage or a permanent relationship.

senses.example_zh: 他一直和一个女同事偷情。

senses.en: Try to improve something, usually making things worse.

senses.example_zh: 电脑本来运行正常，直到他们开始瞎折腾。

senses.example: They MESSED her OVER when she applied for the job.
senses.example_zh: 她申请那份工作时，他们亏待了她。

senses.example_zh: 他们搞砸了讨论，合同告吹了。

senses.example: They MESSED UP the room and left stuff all over the place.
senses.example_zh: 他们把房间弄得乱七八糟，东西扔得到处都是。

senses.en: Cause mental, physical or emotional problems.

senses.example_zh: 他服用了大量LSD，这让他身心严重受损。

senses.en: Become involved in something damaging or dangerous.

senses.example_zh: 他一直沾染可卡因。

senses.example: Don't MESS WITH me or there will be trouble.
senses.example_zh: 别惹我，否则会有麻烦。

senses.example: He's been MESSING WITH some dangerous people.
senses.example_zh: 他一直和一些危险人物厮混。

senses.en: Try to repair or improve, usually unsuccessfully.
senses.example: She's been MESSING WITH it for hours and it still doesn't work.
senses.example_zh: 她摆弄了好几个小时，但还是不能用。

senses.example_zh: 他们对任何违法者都施以严厉惩罚。

senses.example_zh: 很多人四处闲逛等公交车。

senses.en: Not do something enjoyable or rewarding.

senses.example_zh: 会很棒的；你要是不来就错过了。

senses.example: Make sure you don't MISS anyone OUT when you call their names.
senses.example_zh: 点名时确保不要漏掉任何人。

senses.en: Lose a chance, fail to achieve.
senses.example: Trudy MISSED OUT ON the promotion.
senses.example_zh: 特鲁迪错失了晋升机会。

senses.example: I always MIX those two sisters UP because they look so like each other.
senses.example_zh: 我总是把那两姐妹弄混，因为她们长得太像了。

senses.example_zh: 他们制作了一个样品，向我们展示会是什么样子。

senses.en: Spend time doing little or nothing.

senses.example_zh: 他们辞职后，留下他来收拾烂摊子。

senses.example: After the battle, it took them a couple of weeks to MOP UP the remaining rebels.
senses.example_zh: 战斗结束后，他们花了几周时间肃清残余叛军。

senses.en: Eat a sauce with bread to finish it.
senses.example: The sauce was so delicious that I ordered some bread to MOP it UP.
senses.example_zh: 酱汁太美味了，我点了些面包把它蘸干净。

senses.en: Remove a liquid that has been spilt.
senses.example: I used a cloth to MOP UP the coffee I had knocked over.
senses.example_zh: 我用一块布擦干了我打翻的咖啡。

senses.example: She didn't get the job and has been MOPING ABOUT all afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 她没得到那份工作，整个下午都闷闷不乐地走来走去。

senses.example: He's been MOPING AROUND since his girlfriend left him.
senses.example_zh: 自从女朋友离开后，他一直闷闷不乐地走来走去。

senses.example_zh: 我上大学期间债务不断增加。

senses.example_zh: 电视播新闻时，我总是生气并开始大声抱怨。

senses.example_zh: 既然许可已经批准，施工现在可以继续进行了。

senses.example: The police told the people watching to MOVE ALONG.
senses.example_zh: 警察让围观的人走开。

senses.example: The project's MOVING ALONG and everything should be ready on time.
senses.example_zh: 项目进展顺利，一切应该能按时准备好。

senses.en: Leave the area where you have been living.
senses.example: I MOVED AWAY when the factory shut down.
senses.example_zh: 工厂倒闭后我就搬走了。

senses.en: Stop doing or using something to change to something different.
senses.example: They're MOVING AWAY FROM Windows and are using Linux.
senses.example_zh: 他们不再使用Windows，转而使用Linux。

senses.en: Move a student to a lower level.
senses.example: He was finding the course too difficult so they MOVED him DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 他觉得课程太难，所以他们把他降到了低一级。

senses.example: The house was empty for ages, but some new tenants MOVED IN a few weeks ago.
senses.example_zh: 这房子空了很久，但几周前一些新租户搬了进来。

senses.example_zh: 他观察时，鬣狗开始悄悄逼近那只倒霉的角马。

senses.example_zh: 房子一准备好他们就搬了进去。

senses.example_zh: 她跳槽到了另一家公司，薪水高得多。

senses.example_zh: 警察驱散了人群，因为他们阻碍了交通。

senses.example_zh: 我变道超车超过了那辆公交车。

senses.example_zh: 如果你有雄心壮志，就不能混日子。

senses.example_zh: 我们不知道会面临什么，只是勉强应付过去了。

senses.example_zh: 我的清洁工弄乱了我的书，我什么都找不到。

senses.en: Mistake a person or thing for someone or something else because they look similar.
senses.example: I MUDDLE her and her sister UP.
senses.example_zh: 我把她和她妹妹弄混了。

senses.example: I have to MUG UP before the exam.
senses.example_zh: 考试前我得突击复习。

senses.example: I need to MUG UP ON my history for the test.
senses.example_zh: 我需要为考试突击复习历史。

senses.en: Think about an issue or problem.
senses.example: She said that she'd had to MULL IT OVER before deciding what was
senses.example_zh: 她说她不得不仔细考虑后才决定做什么。

senses.en: Become involved in something when your involvement is not wanted.

senses.example_zh: 我们试图把他排除在委员会之外，但他强行介入了。

senses.en: Become involved in something despite opposition to your involvement.
senses.example: She MUSCLED IN ON the deal even though we wanted to do it without her.
senses.example_zh: 尽管我们想自己完成这笔交易，她还是强行参与了进来。

senses.en: Become involved even though there is opposition to your involvement.
senses.example: They are MUSCLING INTO our market and there is very little we can do to stop them.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在强行进入我们的市场，我们几乎无法阻止。

senses.example: They used their contacts in local government to MUSCLE the competitors OUT.
senses.example_zh: 他们利用在地方政府的关系强行排挤了竞争对手。

senses.example_zh: 他在小题大做，所以我叫他滚开。

senses.example_zh: 我的老板总是因为我上班迟到几分钟而不断指责我。

senses.example_zh: 他们难以成功签订合同。

senses.example_zh: 我无法完全理解他们的想法有什么问题，但我确信它行不通。

senses.example_zh: 我在第一次面试中就成功获得了那份工作。

senses.example_zh: 我是以我在战争中牺牲的叔叔的名字命名的。

senses.example_zh: 我不确定申请哪所大学，但我已经把名单缩小到三所了。

senses.example_zh: 我打算谨慎行事，不参加河上旅行。

senses.example_zh: 我迅速出去买点牛奶。

senses.example: She'll be back in a minute-she's just NIPPED OUT to the shops.
senses.example_zh: 她一会儿就回来——她刚迅速去了商店。

senses.example_zh: 我在演讲中打瞌睡了。

senses.example_zh: 议会草率通过了该法案。

senses.en: Look for something hidden or secret.

senses.example_zh: 警察正在四处打探，看看能否找到不利于该团伙的证据。

senses.example: The boss keeps NOSING AROUND our office when we are out at lunch.
senses.example_zh: 老板在我们出去吃午饭时不断在我们的办公室四处打探。

senses.en: Find out, discover-usually information, secrets, etc.
senses.example: He NOSED OUT their plans.
senses.example_zh: 他打探出了他们的计划。

senses.example_zh: 另一位候选人以几票之差险胜了他。

senses.en: Write something short like a phone number for future reference..
senses.example: She NOTED DOWN my fax number so that she could send me the documents when she got to the office.
senses.example_zh: 她记下了我的传真号码，以便到办公室后给我发送文件。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem.
senses.example: The management and unions had a meeting to NUT things OUT.
senses.example_zh: 管理层和工会开会解决问题。

senses.example: Didn't it OCCUR TO you to help me when you saw how much trouble I was in?
senses.example_zh: 当你看到我陷入困境时，你难道没想到要帮我吗？

senses.en: Start to talk freely about something.
senses.example: She hates to OPEN UP and discuss her feelings.
senses.example_zh: 她讨厌敞开心扉讨论自己的感受。

senses.en: Open a shop or business for the day.
senses.example: They OPEN UP at seven in the morning.
senses.example_zh: 他们早上七点开门营业。

senses.example: Before they joined the WTO, they had to OPEN UP their markets.
senses.example_zh: 在加入世贸组织之前，他们不得不开放市场。

senses.example: She was OPERATED ON for eight hours.
senses.example_zh: 她接受了八小时的手术。

senses.example: IOPTED FOR an endowment mortgage and lost a lot of money.
senses.example_zh: 我选择了捐赠按揭，损失了很多钱。

senses.en: Choose to be part or a member of something.
senses.example: If you want them to notify you of updates, you have to OPT IN.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想让他们通知你更新，你必须选择加入。

senses.en: Choose to be a member or part of something.
senses.example: I OPTED INTO the scheme.
senses.example_zh: 我选择加入该计划。

senses.en: Choose not to be part of something.
senses.example: The UK OPTED OUT of a lot of EU legislation on working hours and conditions.
senses.example_zh: 英国选择退出了许多关于工作时间和条件的欧盟立法。

senses.example: She OWES her success TO hard work and determination.
senses.example_zh: 她的成功归功于努力工作和决心。

senses.example: Nobody OWNED UP to breaking the window.
senses.example_zh: 没有人承认打破了窗户。

senses.example: I PACKED AWAY the suitcases in the loft after we had emptied them.
senses.example_zh: 我们清空手提箱后，我把它们收拾好放到了阁楼里。

senses.example: I'm trying to PACK IN smoking.
senses.example_zh: 我正在努力戒烟。

senses.example: She PACKED her boyfriend IN.
senses.example_zh: 她甩了她的男朋友。

senses.example: They really PACK them IN at the club-it was so crowded it was impossible to move.
senses.example_zh: 他们真的把俱乐部挤满了——太拥挤了，简直无法移动。

senses.example: The photocopier has PACKED IN again.
senses.example_zh: 复印机又出故障了。

senses.en: Stop doing something (used as an imperative).
senses.example: The kids were making a fuss, so I told them to PACK IT IN.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们吵吵闹闹的，所以我叫他们住手。

senses.example: His boss PACKED him OFF to a regional office.
senses.example_zh: 他的老板把他打发到分公司去了。

senses.example: The stadium was PACKED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 体育场里座无虚席。

senses.example: You should PACK UP smoking.
senses.example_zh: 你应该戒烟。

senses.example: We had nothing left to do, so we PACKED UP early.
senses.example_zh: 我们没什么可做的了，所以提前收工了。

senses.example: My printer PACKED UP last night-I'll have to get a new one.
senses.example_zh: 我的打印机昨晚坏了——我得买台新的。

senses.en: Collect things and put them where you keep them.
senses.example: At the end of the presentation, I PACKED UP my laptop.
senses.example_zh: 演示结束后，我把笔记本电脑收了起来。

senses.example: I'm too tired to come home; can I PAD DOWN here tonight?
senses.example_zh: 我太累了回不了家；今晚我能在这儿睡吗？

senses.en: Make a text longer by including extra content, often content that isn't particularly relevant.
senses.example: I couldn't think of much to write, so I PADDED the essay OUT with a few lengthy quotes.
senses.example_zh: 我想不出太多可写的，所以用几段冗长的引文把文章拉长了。

senses.example: They PAIRED OFF shortly after starting university.
senses.example_zh: 他们上大学后不久就开始恋爱了。

senses.en: Introduce people, hoping they will start a relationship.
senses.example: I tried to PAIR him OFF with my sister.
senses.example_zh: 我试图把他和我妹妹撮合在一起。

senses.example: The class PAIRED OFF to practise the exam interviews.
senses.example_zh: 全班两人一组练习考试面试。

senses.example: I PAIRED OFF WITH Trish for the test.
senses.example_zh: 我和特里什配对参加测试。

senses.example: We PAIRED UP for the last activity
senses.example_zh: 我们在最后一项活动中两人一组。

senses.en: Be friendly and spend time with someone.
senses.example: We used to PAL ABOUT when we were at school.
senses.example_zh: 我们上学时经常一起玩。

senses.en: Be friendly and spend time with someone.
senses.example: We PALLED AROUND at university.
senses.example_zh: 我们在大学时经常一起玩。

senses.example: We PALLED UP when I started working with her.
senses.example_zh: 我开始和她一起工作时，我们成了朋友。

senses.en: Get someone to accept something that isn't true.
senses.example: He tried to PALM me OFF with a pathetic excuse.
senses.example_zh: 他试图用一个蹩脚的借口搪塞我。

senses.en: Pretend something is better than it is in order to sell it.
senses.example: He tried to PALM his computer OFF as the latest model.
senses.example_zh: 他试图把他的电脑当作最新型号骗卖。

senses.example: I don't know how things will PAN OUT now the company's been taken over.
senses.example_zh: 公司被收购后，我不知道事情会如何发展。

senses.en: Try to conceal a problem without really fixing it.
senses.example: The government tried to PAPER OVER the problems in the proposal, but the press were very critical.
senses.example_zh: 政府试图掩盖提案中的问题，但媒体非常批评。

senses.en: If you pare something back, you reduce the size or numbers..
senses.example: They have had to PARE BACK the services they offer as their funding was reduced.
senses.example_zh: 由于资金减少，他们不得不削减提供的服务。

senses.example: They have PARED DOWN the number of employees as they haven't been doing well.
senses.example_zh: 由于业绩不佳，他们削减了员工数量。

senses.en: Give something away, especially when you don't want to.
senses.example: I found it very hard to PART WITH my old CDs when I digitized my collection.
senses.example_zh: 当我把收藏数字化时，我发现很难舍弃我的旧CD。

senses.example: The teacher PASSED the handout AROUND.
senses.example_zh: 老师分发了讲义。

senses.example: Although not qualified, he managed to PASS AS a doctor for years.
senses.example_zh: 尽管没有资格，他多年来一直冒充医生。

senses.example: Sadly, Georgia's uncle PASSED AWAY yesterday after a short illness.
senses.example_zh: 不幸的是，乔治亚的叔叔在短暂患病后于昨天去世了。

senses.example: I felt awful when the teacher started to PASS BACK the exam papers.
senses.example_zh: 当老师开始发回试卷时，我感到很糟糕。

senses.example: I was just PASSING BY when I saw the accident.
senses.example_zh: 我正好路过，看到了那起事故。

senses.example: I was PASSING BY her house the other day when I heard about it.
senses.example_zh: 前几天我顺路去她家时听说了这件事。

senses.example: The chance for promotion PASSED me BY.
senses.example_zh: 晋升的机会与我擦肩而过。

senses.en: Transmit information or give property to younger generations.
senses.example: The tales were PASSED DOWN for centuries without changing ay of the words.
senses.example_zh: 这些故事流传了几个世纪，一个字都没有改变。

senses.en: Be accepted as something, usually when not.
senses.example: You'd be surprised at what PASSES FOR good cooking in many restaurants.
senses.example_zh: 你会惊讶地发现，许多餐馆里所谓的“好菜”是什么样子。

senses.en: Convince something that something is real.
senses.example: I managed to PASS OFF the fake money in the market.
senses.example_zh: 我成功地在市场上把假币花出去了。

senses.example: The demonstration PASSED OFF peacefully.
senses.example_zh: 示威游行和平地结束了。

senses.example: I'll PASS the message ON when she gets here.
senses.example_zh: 等她来了我会把消息转告给她。

senses.example: I think I'll PASS ON dinner tonight-I'm not hungry.
senses.example_zh: 今晚的晚餐我就不去了——我不饿。

senses.example: Her husband PASSED ON last year.
senses.example_zh: 她丈夫去年去世了。

senses.example: Let's PASS ON TO the next item on the agenda.
senses.example_zh: 我们接着讨论议程上的下一项吧。

senses.example: He got so drunk that he PASSED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 他喝得烂醉，昏了过去。

senses.example: The protesters PASSED OUT leaflets to the growing crowd.
senses.example_zh: 抗议者向越聚越多的人群散发传单。

senses.en: Ignore someone and give a job, reward, etc, to someone more junior.
senses.example: They PASSED him OVER and made his assistant the new director.
senses.example_zh: 他们忽略了他，让他的助手当上了新主管。

senses.example: Let's PASS OVER what they said and get on.
senses.example_zh: 我们别理会他们说的话，继续吧。

senses.example: They PASSED ROUND copies of the handbook.
senses.example_zh: 他们把手册的副本传给大家看。

senses.en: Visit a place without stopping or only stopping briefly.
senses.example: I didn't see much as I was only PASSING THROUGH the town.
senses.example_zh: 我只是路过这个镇子，所以没看到什么。

senses.en: Give ownership or responsibility to someone.
senses.example: The shares PASSED TO his daughter when he died.
senses.example_zh: 他去世后，股份传给了他的女儿。

senses.en: Become owner of or responsible for something.
senses.example: The property will PASS TO her when they die.
senses.example_zh: 他们去世后，这处房产将归她所有。

senses.example: She PASSED UP the opportunity to go to university because she'd been offered a job.
senses.example_zh: 她放弃了上大学的机会，因为有人给了她一份工作。

senses.example: The police PATTED them DOWN for weapons but found nothing.
senses.example_zh: 警察拍身搜查他们身上有没有武器，但什么也没找到。

senses.en: Create or assemble something quickly without much planning.
senses.example: They PATCHED TOGETHER a coalition after the election.
senses.example_zh: 选举后他们仓促拼凑了一个联盟。

senses.example: I tried to PATCH things UP after the argument, but they wouldn't speak to me.
senses.example_zh: 争吵后我试图修补关系，但他们不肯跟我说话。

senses.en: Give an injured person basic medical treatment.
senses.example: After the accident, they PATCHED her UP and sent her to hospital.
senses.example_zh: 事故发生后，他们给她做了应急处理，然后把她送往医院。

senses.example: I PAID BACK the twenty pounds I'd borrowed.
senses.example_zh: 我还了借的那二十英镑。

senses.example: I'm going to PAY him BACK for that insult.
senses.example_zh: 我要为那次侮辱报复他。

senses.example: The British government can't PAY DOWN the national debt.
senses.example_zh: 英国政府无法偿还国债。

senses.example: I PAID twenty pounds FOR the book.
senses.example_zh: 我花二十英镑买了这本书。

senses.example: I PAID the cash INTO my account.
senses.example_zh: 我把现金存入了我的账户。

senses.example: The mortgage will be PAID OFF in twenty-five years.
senses.example_zh: 抵押贷款将在二十五年内还清。

senses.en: Produce a profitable or successful result.
senses.example: Their patience PAID OFF when he finally showed up and signed the contract.
senses.example_zh: 他们的耐心得到了回报，他终于出现并签了合同。

senses.example: The food wasn't very nice, so I PECKED AT it to look polite.
senses.example_zh: 食物不太好吃，所以我小口小口地吃，以显得有礼貌。

senses.en: Leave a group by moving in a different direction.
senses.example: Some of the crowd PEELED AWAY to get out of the crush.
senses.example_zh: 一些人离开人群，以免被挤到。

senses.en: Leave a group by moving in a different direction.
senses.example: They PEELED AWAY FROM the crowd and went down a side road.
senses.example_zh: 他们离开人群，拐上了一条小路。

senses.en: Leave a group by moving in a different direction.
senses.example: When the police blocked the road, a few protesters PEELED OFF and left the march.
senses.example_zh: 当警察封锁道路时，一些抗议者脱离队伍，离开了游行。

senses.en: Leave a group by moving in a different direction.
senses.example: They PEELED OFF FROM the demonstration when the police arrived.
senses.example_zh: 警察一到，他们就脱离了示威队伍。

senses.example: Fearing the police, he PEELED OUT in a cloud of tire smoke.
senses.example_zh: 由于害怕警察，他猛踩油门，在轮胎冒烟中飞驰而去。

senses.example: I PEGGED AWAY for weeks before my exams.
senses.example_zh: 考试前我坚持苦干了好几个星期。

senses.example: We PEGGED the tent DOWN to stop the wind blowing it about.
senses.example_zh: 我们把帐篷用桩固定住，以免被风吹得乱晃。

senses.example: After a long illness, she finally PEGGED IT yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 久病之后，她昨天终于去世了。

senses.example: I PEGGED the washing OUT after it stopped raining.
senses.zh: 把洗好的衣物晾到外面
senses.example_zh: 雨停后，我把洗好的衣物晾到了外面。

senses.example: He PEGGED OUT last night from a heart attack.
senses.example_zh: 他昨晚因心脏病发作去世了。

senses.example: I'll PENCIL Thursday night IN, but if anything comes up, give me a ring..
senses.example_zh: 我先把周四晚上暂定下来，但如果有什么事情，给我打个电话。

senses.example: You need to PEP your writing UP.
senses.example_zh: 你需要让你的文章更有趣。

senses.en: Make someone more enthusiastic, energetic or interested.
senses.example: Her talk PEPPED us UP.
senses.example_zh: 她的讲话使我们振作起来。

senses.en: Feel better or happier, make someone feel better or happier.
senses.example: She was ill in bed with flu, but she PERKED UP a bit when some friends dropped by.
senses.example_zh: 她因流感卧病在床，但几个朋友来访时，她精神好了一些。

senses.example: Everyone was keen at first, but the enthusiasm PETERED OUT when they saw how long it would take.
senses.example_zh: 起初大家都很积极，但当他们看到要花那么长时间时，热情就逐渐消退了。

senses.example: They are PHASING IN the reforms over the next two years.
senses.example_zh: 他们将在未来两年内逐步引入这些改革。

senses.example: They have introduced a compact edition of the newspaper and are PHASING OUT the broadsheet edition over the next few months.
senses.example_zh: 他们推出了报纸的紧凑版，并将在未来几个月内逐步淘汰大报版。

senses.example: I wasn't very hungry so I just PICKED AT my food.
senses.example_zh: 我不太饿，所以只是没胃口地吃了一点。

senses.example: There were a few problems that could be PICKED AT, but it was generally good.
senses.example_zh: 有几个问题可以挑剔，但总体上是好的。

senses.en: Target individuals to change a group.
senses.example: There were many rebels against the policy, but the government PICKED OFF the leaders.
senses.example_zh: 有许多人反对这项政策，但政府逐个对付了领头者。

senses.en: Bother, annoy, criticize or make fun of someone.
senses.example: My friends always PICK ON me because I don't sing well.
senses.example_zh: 我的朋友们总是因为我唱歌不好而取笑我。

senses.example: She PICKED OUT the ones she wanted to take and left the rest.
senses.example_zh: 她挑出了想拿的那些，剩下的留下了。

senses.example: The victim couldn't PICK OUT her attacker from the photos the police showed her.
senses.example_zh: 受害者无法从警方给她看的照片中辨认出袭击她的人。

senses.en: Search something that is disordered for something.
senses.example: The police have been PICKING THROUGH the wreckage for clues.
senses.example_zh: 警方一直在废墟中翻找线索。

senses.example: Sales PICKED UP a bit during the Christmas period.
senses.example_zh: 圣诞节期间销售有所好转。

senses.example: She PICKED UP Spanish in six months.
senses.example_zh: 她六个月内就学会了西班牙语。

senses.example: While you're in town, can you PICK UP my trousers from the Dry Cleaner?
senses.example_zh: 你进城的时候，能顺便从干洗店取一下我的裤子吗？

senses.example: When we rent a holiday cottage in Cornwall, we can't PICK UP Channel 5.
senses.example_zh: 我们在康沃尔租度假小屋时，收不到第五频道。

senses.en: Collect (a person). This differs from the 'collect a thing' meaning -as that means 'collect and bring back' whereas this means either (i) 'collect and drop off on your way' or (ii) 'collect and bring to the same destination'..
senses.example: i) Can you PICK me UP and take me to The George when you go to the party?ii) Can you PICK UP some friends of mine on your way to the party? They're going too.
senses.example_zh: i) 你去参加聚会时，能来接我并带我去乔治家吗？ii) 你能在去聚会的路上接我的几个朋友吗？他们也要去。

senses.en: Tidy a mess someone else has made.
senses.example: I always have to PICK UP AFTER him because he leaves things all over the office.
senses.example_zh: 我总是得跟在他后面收拾，因为他把东西扔得办公室到处都是。

senses.en: Correct someone when they say something wrong.
senses.example: My teacher PICKS UP ON any mistake I make and corrects me.
senses.example_zh: 我老师会指出我犯的任何错误并纠正我。

senses.en: Notice something that most people don't.
senses.example: He's very quick to PICK UP ON new trends.
senses.example_zh: 他非常快地注意到新趋势。

senses.example: The government has PICKED UP ON the reports in the media.
senses.example_zh: 政府对媒体报道作出了反应。

senses.en: Comment on something said earlier in a conversation.
senses.example: I'd like to PICK UP ON the point that Jill made.
senses.example_zh: 我想接着吉尔刚才说的那一点谈一谈。

senses.en: Recover from a fall or problem.
senses.example: It took him a long time to PICK HIMSELF UP after his wife left him.
senses.example_zh: 妻子离开他之后，他花了很长时间才振作起来。

senses.en: Used to tell someone to get lost or leave you alone.
senses.example: He told them to PIG OFF and leave him in peace.
senses.example_zh: 他叫他们滚开，让他清静一下。

senses.example: The food was great, so I really PIGGED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 食物很棒，所以我大吃特吃了一顿。

senses.en: Enter a place quickly, in a disorganised way.
senses.example: The coach stopped and we all PILED IN.
senses.example_zh: 长途汽车停了下来，我们一拥而上。

senses.en: Enter a place quickly, in a disorganised way.
senses.example: We PILED INTO the shop when it opened.
senses.example_zh: 商店开门时，我们一拥而入。

senses.en: Add or give more or something.
senses.example: Work's crazy-they keep PILING ON the pressure.
senses.example_zh: 工作忙疯了——他们不断施加压力。

senses.en: Exaggerate or talk in a way to affect someone's feelings.
senses.example: It wasn't very serious, but they PILED ON the guilt.
senses.example_zh: 事情并不严重，但他们过分渲染了内疚感。

senses.en: Leave a place quickly, in a disorganised way.
senses.example: The train eventually arrived and we all PILED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 火车终于到了，我们一拥而出。

senses.example: Work just keeps on PILING UP and I really can't manage to get it all done.
senses.example_zh: 工作不断堆积，我真的没法全部完成。

senses.en: Accumulate in a pile or heap.
senses.example: The ironing's PILING UP as I hate doing it.
senses.example_zh: 要熨的衣服越堆越多，因为我讨厌熨衣服。

senses.en: Get a fixed idea, opinion, etc, from someone..
senses.example: I've asked him to set a date, but he's a hard man to PIN DOWN and won't give a definite answer.
senses.example_zh: 我要求他定个日期，但他是个很难让他明确表态的人，不肯给出确切答复。

senses.example: The government can't PIN DOWN where the leak came from.
senses.example_zh: 政府无法查明泄密来源。

senses.example: The police tried to PIN the crime ON him.
senses.example_zh: 警方试图把罪责归咎于他。

senses.en: Fix something to a wall, or other vertical surface, with a pin.
senses.example: I PINNED the notice UP on the board
senses.example_zh: 我把通知钉在了布告板上。

senses.en: Suffer physically because of grief, stress, worry, etc.
senses.example: He's been PINING AWAY since his wife died and is a shadow of his former self.
senses.example_zh: 自从妻子去世后，他一直憔悴不堪，已不复当年模样。

senses.example: The lecturer asked the students to PIPE DOWN and pay attention.
senses.example_zh: 讲师让学生们安静下来，认真听讲。

senses.example: At first, no one answered, then finally someone PIPED UP.
senses.example_zh: 起初没人回答，最后终于有人开口了。

senses.example: The war PITTED neighbour AGAINST neighbour.
senses.example_zh: 那场战争使邻里之间反目成仇。

senses.example: He PITTED OUT in the twentieth lap.
senses.example_zh: 他在第二十圈时进站了。

senses.en: Try to persuade someone to give your work, business, a job, etc.
senses.example: He PITCHED FOR the job, but they gave it to someone else.
senses.example_zh: 他努力争取那份工作，但他们给了别人。

senses.en: Work together to help achieve an objective.
senses.example: We were behind schedule, but the others PITCHED IN and we got it done in time.
senses.example_zh: 我们进度落后了，但其他人一起帮忙，我们按时完成了。

senses.example: The shareholders PITCHED INTO the management about their pay rises at the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 股东们在会上猛烈抨击管理层给自己加薪。

senses.en: Put a young plant that has been grown in a pot or greenhouse into the ground.
senses.example: They need to be PLANTED OUT in the spring.
senses.example_zh: 它们需要在春天移栽到地里。

senses.en: Put food onto a plate to serve.
senses.example: PLATE UP and drizzle with salsa verde.
senses.example_zh: 装盘，淋上绿酱。

senses.en: Pretend to agree or accept something in order to keep someone happy or to get more information.
senses.example: I disagreed with the idea but I had to PLAY ALONG because everyone else liked it.
senses.example_zh: 我不同意这个想法，但不得不假装同意，因为其他人都喜欢。

senses.example: The children were PLAYING AROUND and being annoying.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在胡闹，很烦人。

senses.example: I PLAYED AROUND a lot at college.
senses.example_zh: 我在大学时经常拈花惹草。

senses.example: He just PLAYS AT being a lawyer-he never wins a case.
senses.example_zh: 他只是假装当律师——他从未赢过一场官司。

senses.en: Be sexually unfaithful when away from home.
senses.example: He travels abroad a lot and his wife thinks he PLAYS AWAY.
senses.example_zh: 他经常出国旅行，他妻子认为他在外偷情。

senses.en: Listen to or watch something you've recorded.
senses.example: We PLAYED the recording BACK to see if it was OK.
senses.example_zh: 我们回放了录音，看看是否正常。

senses.en: Try to make something seem less important.
senses.example: The Government has tried to PLAY DOWN the importance of the minister's resignation.
senses.example_zh: 政府试图淡化部长辞职的重要性。

senses.en: Play a game to decide who the winner is.
senses.example: As both teams had the same points, they PLAYED OFF to decide the winner.
senses.example_zh: 由于两队积分相同，他们加赛一场以决出胜负。

senses.en: Make people compete against each other so that you benefit.
senses.example: He PLAYED them OFF against each other to get the best deal.
senses.example_zh: 他挑拨他们相互竞争，以获得最好的交易。

senses.en: Continue playing a sport though there might be a reason to stop.
senses.example: It looked like a foul, but the referee told them to PLAY ON.
senses.example_zh: 看起来像是犯规，但裁判让他们继续比赛。

senses.example: The band PLAYED ON for another hour.
senses.example_zh: 乐队又继续演奏了一个小时。

senses.example: They are just PLAYING ON our fears to get us to do what they want.
senses.example_zh: 他们只是利用我们的恐惧来让我们做他们想做的事。

senses.example: The advert PLAYS ON the slogan
senses.example_zh: 这则广告利用了那条标语的双关含义。

senses.example: Let's see how things PLAY OUT.
senses.example_zh: 让我们看看事情如何发展。

senses.en: Pretend that something is real and reduce its effect.
senses.example: Computer games allow people to PLAY OUT their violent urges.
senses.example_zh: 电脑游戏让人们宣泄他们的暴力冲动。

senses.example: Rain stopped them PLAYING the game OUT.
senses.example_zh: 下雨使他们无法把比赛进行到底。

senses.example: When he hooked the swordfish, his line rapidly PLAYED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 当他钓到剑鱼时，他的鱼线迅速放了出去。

senses.example: The children PLAYED UP all evening and drove the babysitter mad.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们整个晚上都在调皮捣蛋，把保姆逼疯了。

senses.example: I'm PLAYING UP TO my boss at the moment because I want the promotion.
senses.example_zh: 我目前正在讨好我的老板，因为我想升职。

senses.example: He's got a reputation for being trouble and PLAYS UP TO it.
senses.example_zh: 他有个爱惹麻烦的名声，而他对此也乐得迎合。

senses.example: They are PLAYING UPON people's concerns to get their way.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在利用人们的担忧来达到自己的目的。

senses.en: Touch and move something to occupy your hands.

senses.example_zh: 他不停地摆弄自己的胡子。

senses.en: Not eat much of a meal.
senses.example: I wasn't hungry, so I just PLAYED WITH the food.
senses.example_zh: 我不饿，所以只是拨弄着食物。

senses.example: We PLAYED WITH the idea, but decided against it.
senses.example_zh: 我们随便考虑过这个想法，但决定不这么做。

senses.en: Plead guilty to get a reduced sentence or fine.

senses.example_zh: 那位CEO认罪求轻判，并把欺诈归咎于首席财务官。

senses.en: Re-invest money you have made into a business.

senses.en: Read something that is difficult or takes a lot of time.

senses.example_zh: 面试时他紧张地拉扯着袖口。

senses.example: They PLUCKED UP the courage to complain.
senses.example_zh: 他们鼓起勇气去投诉。

senses.example_zh: 他插上电视电源，然后开到最大音量。

senses.example_zh: 我选了牛排薯条。

senses.example_zh: 我拍松枕头，然后躺下。

senses.example: She PLUMPED HERSELF DOWN next to me and started asking me what had happened.
senses.example_zh: 她在我旁边一屁股坐下，开始问我发生了什么事。

senses.example: He POINTED OUT that I only had two weeks to get the whole thing finished.
senses.example_zh: 他指出，我只有两周时间来完成整个事情。

senses.en: Move things around or search in a casual way to try to find something.
senses.example: I POKED ABOUT in my CD collection to see if I could find it.
senses.example_zh: 我在我的CD收藏里翻找，看看能不能找到它。

senses.en: Move things around or search in a casual way to try to find something.
senses.example: I POKED AROUND in my desk to see if the letter was there.
senses.example_zh: 我在书桌里翻找，看看那封信在不在。

senses.example_zh: 我不得不为这顿饭掏了五十美元。

senses.en: Get too tired to do something.
senses.example: I was going to write my essay, but I POOPED OUT and went to bed instead.
senses.example_zh: 我本来打算写论文，但累得不行，就上床睡觉了。

senses.example: We were supposed to meet yesterday, but she POOPED OUT ON me at the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 我们本来昨天要见面的，但她最后一刻放了我鸽子。

senses.example: We were POOTLING ALONG at thirty miles an hour.
senses.example_zh: 我们以每小时三十英里的速度悠闲地行驶着。

senses.example: He POPPED IN for a coffee on his way home.
senses.example_zh: 他在回家的路上顺便来喝了杯咖啡。

senses.example: He's always POPPING OFF when things don't suit him.
senses.example_zh: 事情不顺他意时，他总是大声抱怨。

senses.en: Go out for a short time.
senses.example: He's just POPPED OFF for a break but should be back in a few minutes.
senses.example_zh: 他刚出去休息一下，但几分钟后应该就回来。

senses.en: Go out for a short time.

senses.example_zh: 我正要去趟商店。需要我顺便带点什么吗？

senses.example_zh: 我按回车键时，对话框弹了出来。

senses.example: I'm going to have to work late tonight because something has POPPED UP.
senses.example_zh: 今晚我得加班，因为突然有事。

senses.en: Read, look at or study carefully.

senses.example_zh: 她仔细研读报告，寻找错误。

senses.en: Spend time doinglittle things for pleasure.

senses.example_zh: 周六早上，如果天气好，我会在花园里悠闲地做些琐事。

senses.en: Spend some time doing little things for pleasure.
senses.example: I POTTERED AROUND, sorting out my CDS and a few other things.
senses.example_zh: 我悠闲地整理CD和其他一些东西。

senses.example_zh: 整天大雨倾盆，所以我们只能待在室内。

senses.example_zh: 他滔滔不绝地说出无用的统计数据。

senses.en: Cut the electricity supply to a computer or electronic device.
senses.example: I POWERED DOWN my computer and went for lunch.
senses.example_zh: 我关掉电脑，去吃午饭了。

senses.en: Cut the electricity to a computer or device to turn it off.
senses.example: You mustn't POWER it OFF while it is updating.
senses.example_zh: 更新时你绝不能关掉电源。

senses.en: Turn a computer or electronic device on so that it is ready to use.
senses.example: I POWERED UP my laptop and started work.
senses.example_zh: 我打开笔记本电脑，开始工作。

senses.example: Geoff just PRATTLED ON instead of giving a straight answer.
senses.example_zh: 杰夫只是喋喋不休，而不是直接回答。

senses.example: They PRESSED AHEAD with the elections despite the violence.
senses.example_zh: 尽管发生暴力事件，他们仍继续推进选举。

senses.en: Apply pressure to get permission or to obtain something.
senses.example: The workers are PRESSING FOR better pay and conditions.
senses.example_zh: 工人们正在迫切要求更好的工资和条件。

senses.en: Continue or go ahead with a project, process, plan, etc.
senses.example: The government are PRESSING FORWARD WITH the new law.
senses.example_zh: 政府正在推进新法律。

senses.example: When the line was breached, reserve troops were PRESSED INTO service.
senses.example_zh: 防线被突破时，预备部队被强行征用。

senses.example: We PRESSED ON to get to our destination before night fell.
senses.example_zh: 我们继续前进，以便在夜幕降临前到达目的地。

senses.en: Pressure someone to accept something offered.

senses.example_zh: 他们硬要给我们这些邀请，很难拒绝。

senses.example: They PREY UPON people's fears about immigration.
senses.example_zh: 他们利用人们对移民的恐惧。

senses.en: Include the affects of possible future events when assessing the value of something.
senses.example: Speculators have PRICED IN the risk of a war breaking out.
senses.example_zh: 投机者已将爆发战争的风险计入价格。

senses.example: In rural areas where they have a monopoly, some garages PRICE UP fuel because there's nowhere else to buy it.
senses.example_zh: 在垄断的农村地区，一些加油站抬高燃料价格，因为别无他处可买。

senses.en: Make a hard copy of a computer document.
senses.example: He PRINTED OUT the letter and checked through it carefully.
senses.example_zh: 他把信打印出来，仔细检查了一遍。

senses.en: Support something, both physically and financially, politically, etc..
senses.example: The council have PROPPED UP the museum for years with grants.
senses.example_zh: 委员会多年来一直拨款资助这家博物馆。

senses.en: Work out or anticipate someone's intentions.
senses.example: We have to try to PSYCH OUT our rivals.
senses.example_zh: 我们必须设法摸清对手的意图。

senses.example: Boxers try to PSYCH their opponents OUT before the fight to gain an advantage.
senses.example_zh: 拳击手在赛前试图吓住对手以取得优势。

senses.example: I PSYCHED myself UP for the exam.
senses.example_zh: 我让自己为考试做好心理准备。

senses.en: Move your lips into position to receive a kiss.
senses.example: She PUCKERED UP when he leant forwards to kiss her.
senses.example_zh: 当他俯身要吻她时，她撅起了嘴唇。

senses.example: The lorry was going slowly but we managed to PULL AHEAD.
senses.example_zh: 那辆卡车开得很慢，但我们还是设法超了过去。

senses.example: My tutor PULLED my essay APART.
senses.example_zh: 我的导师把我的论文批得体无完肤。

senses.example: A fight broke out in the pub and it was hard to PULL the people involved APART.
senses.example_zh: 酒吧里发生了打斗，很难把参与的人拉开。

senses.example: It PULLED me APART to see them arguing so much.
senses.example_zh: 看到他们吵得那么厉害，让我很难过。

senses.en: When a vehicle moves from a place.
senses.example: The car PULLED AWAY from the lights at high speed.
senses.example_zh: 那辆车高速驶离了红绿灯。

senses.en: Score a goal or point when losing.
senses.example: They were two-nil down until five minutes before the end, when they PULLED BACK a goal.
senses.example_zh: 他们一直以0比2落后，直到终场前五分钟才扳回一球。

senses.en: Move away from a place, especially when talking about soldiers.
senses.example: They have PULLED the troops BACK from the front line.
senses.example_zh: 他们已把部队从前线撤了回来。

senses.example: She PULLED BACK when he tried to kiss her.
senses.example_zh: 当他试图吻她时，她往后缩了缩。

senses.example_zh: 他们退出了这笔交易。

senses.example: They PULLED the old cinema DOWN to build a new shopping mall.
senses.example_zh: 他们拆掉了旧电影院，要建一座新购物中心。

senses.example: Losing her job PULLED her DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 失业让她很消沉。

senses.example: He's PULLING DOWN a fortune.
senses.example_zh: 他赚了一大笔钱。

senses.example: Who will you be PULLING FOR in the final?
senses.example_zh: 决赛中你会支持谁？

senses.en: When a train arrives at a station.

senses.example_zh: 火车进站了，我们冲过去接她下车。

senses.example: Their last tour PULLED IN millions of fans.
senses.example_zh: 他们上次巡演吸引了数百万粉丝。

senses.en: Stop a car by the side of the road.
senses.example: I PULLED IN to let the passengers out.
senses.example_zh: 我靠边停车让乘客下车。

senses.en: Areest or take someone to a police station for questioning.
senses.example: The police PULLED them IN after the trouble.
senses.example_zh: 出事后，警方把他们带回警局问话。

senses.en: Manage to do something difficult or tricky.

senses.example_zh: 没人认为她能做成，但她最终成功了。

senses.example_zh: 绿灯亮时，那辆车起步开走了。

senses.example_zh: 太阳下山时，我套上了一件套头衫。

senses.example: The train was PULLING OUT when I got there.

senses.example: People want the government to PULL the troops OUT.
senses.example_zh: 人们希望政府撤军。

senses.en: Stop by the side of the road.

senses.example_zh: 警察让那辆车靠边停车。

senses.example_zh: 警察让那辆车靠边停车，并对司机进行了酒精测试。

senses.en: Recover from and illness or problem.
senses.example: At one stage it looked as if she was going to die, but she PULLED THROUGH in the end.
senses.example_zh: 有一刻她看起来快不行了，但最终还是挺了过来。

senses.en: Close a door or window that has been left open.
senses.example: Could you PULL the door TO, please?
senses.example_zh: 请把门掩上，好吗？

senses.example: If we all PULL TOGETHER, we'll have it finished in no time.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们齐心协力，很快就能完成。

senses.example: The cab PULLED UP outside my house and I got out.
senses.example_zh: 出租车在我家门外停下，我下了车。

senses.en: Inform someone that they are wrong.
senses.example: He PULLED me UP because I had got my facts wrong.
senses.example_zh: 他纠正了我，因为我把事实搞错了。

senses.en: Become calm or regain control of your emotions.
senses.example: He was so angry that he couldn't PULL HIMSELF TOGETHER.
senses.example_zh: 他气得无法镇定下来。

senses.en: Get in a queue without waiting.
senses.example: She just PUSHED IN the queue in front of me at the supermarket checkout.
senses.example_zh: 在超市收银台，她直接插到了我前面。

senses.example: He foundit difficult to PUT ACROSS what he wanted to say at the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 他发现很难在会议上表达清楚他想说的话。

senses.en: Put something back in the correct place.
senses.example: He PUT the dictionary BACK on the shelf after he'd finished the crossword.
senses.example_zh: 做完填字游戏后，他把字典放回了书架上。

senses.example: The judge PUT him AWAY for ten years for robbery.
senses.example_zh: 法官因抢劫罪判他入狱十年。

senses.en: Rearrange something for a later time.

senses.example_zh: 年度大会已推迟到7月17日。

senses.example_zh: 我试着每个月存点钱，为暑假做准备。

senses.en: Kill an animal because it's old, ill, etc..
senses.example: He had his dog PUT DOWN because it was in a lot of pain from its tumours.
senses.example_zh: 他让狗安乐死了，因为它饱受肿瘤疼痛的折磨。

senses.example: PUT the gun DOWN slowly and keep your hands where I can see them.
senses.example_zh: 慢慢把枪放下，手放在我能看见的地方。

senses.example: PUT me DOWN FOR 50p per mile.
senses.example_zh: 我承诺每英里捐50便士。

senses.example: He didn't score many, but we can PUT that DOWN TO inexperience
senses.example_zh: 他得分不多，但我们可以把这归因于缺乏经验。

senses.example: They had to PUT IN a whole new central heating system because the house was so cold.
senses.example_zh: 他们不得不安装一套全新的中央供暖系统，因为房子太冷了。

senses.example: He PUT IN FOR a transfer to the new branch.
senses.example_zh: 他申请调到新分公司。

senses.example: The concert's been PUT OFF until next month because the singer's got a throat infection.
senses.example_zh: 音乐会推迟到了下个月，因为歌手喉咙感染了。

senses.example: I was really PUT OFF by the way he eats his mouth open.
senses.example_zh: 他张着嘴吃饭的样子让我很反感。

senses.example: He's PUT ON a lot of weight since he gave up smoking.
senses.example_zh: 他戒烟后体重增加了很多。

senses.example: I am not PUTTING you ON.
senses.example_zh: 我没有骗你。

senses.example: I PUT my coat ON before we went out.
senses.example_zh: 我们出门前我穿上了外套。

senses.example: Several charities PUT OUT an appeal on TV for money for thevictims of the flooding in Mozambique.
senses.example_zh: 几家慈善机构在电视上发出呼吁，为莫桑比克洪灾的受害者募捐。

senses.example: Would it be PUTTING you OUT greatly if I asked to change to another day.
senses.example_zh: 如果我要求改到另一天，会太麻烦你吗？

senses.example: He PUT OUT his cigarette before entering the building.
senses.example_zh: 他进楼前熄灭了香烟。

senses.example: They PUT OVER a clever practical joke on us.
senses.example_zh: 他们对我们成功实施了一个巧妙的恶作剧。

senses.example: Could you PUT me THROUGH to extension 259 please.
senses.example_zh: 请帮我接通分机259。

senses.example: She PUT $250 TOWARDS the cost of the repairs and we had to pay the rest.
senses.example_zh: 她出了250美元用于维修费用，剩下的我们得自己付。

senses.en: Allow someone to stay at your house for a night or a few days..
senses.example: She PUT me UP for the night because I'd missed the last bus and there were no night buses running.
senses.example_zh: 她留我住了一晚，因为我错过了末班车，而且没有夜班车。

senses.example: The government has PUT tuition fees for undergraduate students UP again.
senses.example_zh: 政府再次提高了本科生的学费。

senses.en: Show skill or determination in a contest, competition, fight, etc.
senses.example: They PUT UP a great fight but lost.
senses.example_zh: 他们奋力拼搏，但输了。

senses.example: His friends PUT him UPTO stealing it.
senses.example_zh: 他的朋友们怂恿他偷了它。

senses.example: I can't PUT UP WITH my neighbour's noise any longer; it's driving me mad.
senses.example_zh: 我再也受不了邻居的噪音了，它快把我逼疯了。

senses.en: Argue with someone about a specific subject.
senses.example: The girl's mother was QUARRELING OUT with her daughter about the party.
senses.example_zh: 女孩的母亲正为派对的事和她争吵。

senses.example: I am not QUARRELLING WITH their idea, but I think there are other possibilities.
senses.example_zh: 我不是不同意他们的想法，但我认为还有其他可能性。

senses.example: I QUEERED the exam UP.
senses.example_zh: 我把考试考砸了。

senses.example: The audience QUIETENED DOWN when the lights were switched off in the auditorium and the play was ready to begin.
senses.example_zh: 礼堂的灯熄灭，演出即将开始时，观众安静了下来。

senses.en: Stop working, associating or being friends with someone, especially when they need support.
senses.example: They QUIT ON me just when things got rough.
senses.example_zh: 事情一变得艰难，他们就抛弃了我。

senses.example: My phone has QUIT ON me-can I borrow yours?
senses.example_zh: 我的手机坏了——能借你的用一下吗？

senses.example: They RACED OFF when the police arrived.
senses.example_zh: 警察一到，他们就迅速离开了。

senses.en: Used to tell someone to go away because they're annoying you.
senses.example: He told her to RACK OFF.
senses.example_zh: 他叫她滚开。

senses.example: I'm tired-I'm goingto RACK OUT.
senses.example_zh: 我累了——我要去睡一会儿。

senses.example: He's RACKED UP a number of convictions for speeding.
senses.example_zh: 他因超速被多次定罪。

senses.example: They RACKED UP the car in an accident.
senses.example_zh: 他们在事故中把车撞坏了。

senses.example: Bombs RAINED DOWN ON the city all night.
senses.example_zh: 炸弹整夜如雨点般落在这座城市。

senses.en: Be postponed or stopped by rain (usually passive).
senses.example: The match was RAINED OFF.
senses.example_zh: 比赛因雨取消了。

senses.en: Be postponed or stopped by rain (usually passive).
senses.example: The game was RAINED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 比赛因雨取消了。

senses.example: She's RAKING IN thousands a day.
senses.example_zh: 她一天赚数千美元。

senses.example: It's the only shop in the area and they're RAKING IT IN.
senses.example_zh: 这是该地区唯一的商店，他们赚得盆满钵满。

senses.en: Cheat someone by charging them too much.
senses.example: They RAKE tourists OFF all the time.
senses.example_zh: 他们总是宰游客。

senses.en: Talk, think, etc, about something negative in the past.
senses.example: They keep RAKING OVER the rows we had last year.
senses.example_zh: 他们老是重提我们去年吵过的架。

senses.en: Bring something back to people's attention.
senses.example: The press have RAKED UP some scandals from her past.
senses.example_zh: 媒体重提了她过去的一些丑闻。

senses.en: Talk at length without getting to the point.
senses.example: Quit RAMBLING ON-I’m tired of listening to you.
senses.example_zh: 别东拉西扯了——我听腻了。

senses.en: Increase price, speed or power of something.
senses.example: The company has RAMPED its prices UP because of higher oil prices.
senses.example_zh: 由于油价上涨，公司提高了价格。

senses.example: She RAPPED OUT the command.
senses.example_zh: 她厉声发出了命令。

senses.example: She RATTED ON her neighbours to the police becausethey were smuggling alcohol from France.
senses.example_zh: 她向警方告发了邻居，因为他们从法国走私酒。

senses.example: He always RATS ON his promises.
senses.example_zh: 他总是食言。

senses.example: He RATTED me OUT to the police.
senses.example_zh: 他向警方告发了我。

senses.example: I RATTED THROUGH the papers on my desk but couldn't find the letter.
senses.example_zh: 我匆忙翻找桌上的文件，但没找到那封信。

senses.example: The media are trying to RATCHET UP the pressure on the president.
senses.example_zh: 媒体试图加大对总统的压力。

senses.example: She RATTLED OFF loads of statistics which nobody could understand.
senses.example_zh: 她快速说出了一大堆没人能理解的统计数据。

senses.en: Stretch your arm to get something.
senses.example: I REACHED OUT and caught the ball.
senses.example_zh: 我伸出手接住了球。

senses.example: They are REACHING OUT FOR major economic reforms.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在努力实现重大经济改革。

senses.example: I REACHED OUT TO you when I was in trouble and you were a great help.
senses.example_zh: 我遇到麻烦时向你求助，你帮了大忙。

senses.example: Charities are REACHING OUT TO those who lost their homes in the floods.
senses.example_zh: 慈善机构正在向洪水中失去家园的人提供帮助。

senses.en: Try to communicate and establish good relations people.
senses.example: The candidates are REACHING OUT TO the poor to get their votes.
senses.example_zh: 候选人正在主动与穷人沟通以争取选票。

senses.en: Read a aloud for someone to write down.
senses.example: I READ OFF the figures and she wrote them down in her notebook.
senses.example_zh: 我朗读了数字，她记在了笔记本上。

senses.example: The teacher READ OUT the names of the students who'd passed.
senses.example_zh: 老师朗读了通过考试的学生名单。

senses.example: I've been READING UP ON Japan as I'm going to live there next year.
senses.example_zh: 我一直在研读关于日本的资料，因为我明年要去那里生活。

senses.en: Come to a conclusion or solution after some thought.
senses.example: He REASONED OUT the answer to the math problem.
senses.example_zh: 他推理出了数学题的答案。

senses.example: Jeff says we can RECKON ON there being at least fifty people there tonight.
senses.example_zh: 杰夫说我们预计今晚至少会有五十个人在那里。

senses.en: Catch a fish on a line and pull the line to land.
senses.example: He REELED IN a ten-pound salmon.
senses.example_zh: 他钓上了一条十磅重的鲑鱼。

senses.en: Attract people, especially customers, to get them to do what you want them to.
senses.example: They hope the discounts will REEL people IN.
senses.example_zh: 他们希望折扣能吸引人们。

senses.example: The minister REELED OFF a load of figures to support her position.
senses.example_zh: 部长快速说出了一大堆数据来支持她的立场。

senses.en: Score a lot of points or win a lot of games one after the other.
senses.example: They REELED OFF five victories and became the champions.
senses.example_zh: 他们连续赢了五场比赛，成为了冠军。

senses.example: I REELED OUT the hose and watered the lawn.
senses.example_zh: 我展开水管，给草坪浇水。

senses.en: Control someone or something to stop them causing more trouble.
senses.example: They had to REIN the minister IN after her dreadful performance on TV.
senses.example_zh: 她在电视上表现糟糕后，他们不得不约束那位部长。

senses.en: Let, grant a service or allow usage for a fee.
senses.example: They RENTED their house OUT while the were abroad.
senses.example_zh: 他们出国期间把房子租了出去。

senses.en: Go away on a bike, horse, etc.
senses.example: She got on her motorbike and RODE OFF.
senses.example_zh: 她骑上摩托车离开了。

senses.example: His reputation is RIDING ON this deal working out.
senses.example_zh: 他的声誉取决于这笔交易能否成功。

senses.example: They managed to RIDE OUT the recession.
senses.example_zh: 他们设法安然度过了经济衰退。

senses.en: Move higher on the body (of clothes).
senses.example: Her skirt RODE UP when she sat down.
senses.example_zh: 她坐下时裙子往上移了。

senses.example: I phoned and left a message this morning but she still hasn't RUNG me BACK.
senses.example_zh: 我早上打电话留了言，但她还没有给我回电话。

senses.en: Telephone to inform or confirm something.
senses.example: I RANG IN and told them Iwould be late.
senses.example_zh: 我打电话告诉他们我会迟到。

senses.example: Dave RANG OFF guiltily when he saw his boss coming.
senses.example_zh: 戴夫看到老板过来，心虚地挂断了电话。

senses.example: Two shots RANG OUT and then we heard a scream.
senses.example_zh: 两声枪响，然后我们听到一声尖叫。

senses.en: Telephone a number of people, usually to try to get some information.
senses.example: I RANG ROUND to see if anyone knew where she'd gone.
senses.example_zh: 我打电话问了一圈，看有没有人知道她去了哪里。

senses.example: Helen RANG me UP earlier.
senses.example_zh: 海伦早些时候给我打了电话。

senses.example: They RANG UP several victories.
senses.example_zh: 他们赢得了数场胜利。

senses.en: Enter figures into a till or cash register.
senses.example: They RANG UP the bill for the groceries.
senses.example_zh: 他们把食品杂货的账单输入了收银机。

senses.en: When a place is full of a loud sound.
senses.example: The room RANG WITH their laughter.
senses.example_zh: 房间里回荡着他们的笑声。

senses.en: Charge excessively or obtain money unfairly.
senses.example: Tourists get RIPPED OFF a lot when they don't speak the language.
senses.example_zh: 游客不会说当地语言时经常被宰。

senses.example: The army ROLLED BACK when they came under attack.
senses.example_zh: 军队遭到攻击后撤退了。

senses.example: The government want to ROLL BACK the freedom of the press.
senses.example_zh: 政府想削减新闻自由。

senses.example: The years ROLLED BY.
senses.example_zh: 岁月流逝。

senses.example: They ROLLED IN very drunk at three o'clock in the morning.
senses.example_zh: 他们凌晨三点醉醺醺地到了。

senses.en: Arrive in large numbers, for military vehicles.
senses.example: The tanks ROLLED IN and took control of the capital city.
senses.example_zh: 坦克涌入并控制了首都。

senses.example: The competition ROLLED ON despite the administrative problems.
senses.example_zh: 尽管有管理问题，比赛还是继续进行。

senses.en: Said when you can't wait for something nice in the future.
senses.example: Roll on Friday! It's been a dreadful week.
senses.example_zh: 快点到周五吧！这周太糟糕了。

senses.en: Launch or introduce a new product, initiative, etc..
senses.example: The company ROLLED OUT its takeover plans last week.
senses.example_zh: 公司上周推出了收购计划。

senses.en: To appear in large numbers for an event.
senses.example: Thousands ROLLED UP to see the stars at the film premiere.
senses.example_zh: 成千上万的人涌来看电影首映式上的明星。

senses.en: An imperative used to attract people to a public event.
senses.example: Roll up! Come and see the circus tonight.
senses.example_zh: 快来看啊！今晚来看马戏表演。

senses.example: In the first race, the favourite ROMPED IN.
senses.example_zh: 在第一场比赛中，最受欢迎的马轻松获胜。

senses.example: We ROMPED THROUGH the tasks because they were so simple.
senses.example_zh: 我们轻松完成了任务，因为它们太简单了。

senses.en: To keep a mother and baby together after the birth.
senses.example: Nowadays, most hospitals have a policy of ROOMING IN mothers and their babies.
senses.example_zh: 如今，大多数医院都实行母婴同室的政策。

senses.en: Look in a placeto try to find something.
senses.example: He ROOTED ABOUT in his briefcase, trying to find a pen.
senses.example_zh: 他在公文包里翻找，想找支笔。

senses.en: Look in a place to try to find something.
senses.example: I ROOTED AROUND my flat trying to find the letter.
senses.example_zh: 我在公寓里翻找那封信。

senses.example: Everyone was ROOTING FOR Arsenal to win the Champions League.
senses.example_zh: 大家都支持阿森纳赢得欧冠。

senses.example: The police ROOTED OUT the informer.
senses.example_zh: 警方揪出了那个告密者。

senses.en: Find the source of a problem and remove it.
senses.example: They are trying to ROOT OUT the troublemakers.
senses.example_zh: 他们正试图铲除那些捣乱分子。

senses.en: Dig a plant out of the ground.
senses.example: He ROOTED UP the plants and replanted them.
senses.example_zh: 他把植物连根挖出，重新栽种。

senses.example: The teacher ROPED her students IN to carry her stuff when she had to change classroom.
senses.example_zh: 老师把她的学生拉来帮忙搬东西，因为她得换教室。

senses.en: Get someone to help or become involved, usually when they don't want to.
senses.example: I got ROPED INTO helping them set the stall up.
senses.example_zh: 我被拉去帮他们摆摊。

senses.en: Extend ropes or barriers across or around an area.
senses.example: The celebrity entrance was ROPED OFF from the general public.
senses.example_zh: 名人入口用绳子隔开，与公众分开。

senses.example: The mugger ROUGHED him UP when he refused to hand his wallet over.
senses.example_zh: 劫匪在他拒绝交出钱包时殴打了他。

senses.example: Winning the FA Cup ROUNDED OFF a wonderful season for Arsenal.
senses.example_zh: 赢得足总杯为阿森纳的精彩赛季画上了圆满句号。

senses.example: The prime minister refused to ROW BACK and lost the vote.
senses.example_zh: 首相拒绝让步，结果输掉了投票。

senses.example: They're not friends, but we RUB ALONG.
senses.example_zh: 他们不是朋友，但我们相处得还不错。

senses.en: Dry or clean something with a cloth.
senses.example: She RUBBED the horse DOWN with a towel after riding it.
senses.example_zh: 她骑完马后用毛巾把马擦干。

senses.en: Massage or rub someone to help them relax.
senses.example: The trainer RUBBED her DOWN after the race.
senses.example_zh: 比赛后教练给她按摩放松。

senses.en: Apply a substance like cream or ointment and rub it until it is absorbed.
senses.example: He applied the steroid cream and RUBBED it IN.
senses.example_zh: 他涂上类固醇药膏并揉搓至吸收。

senses.en: Emphasise how bad a situation is to make someone feel worse.
senses.example: Even though the minister had resigned, the press RUBBED IT IN by publishing more details of the scandal.
senses.example_zh: 尽管部长已经辞职，媒体还是哪壶不开提哪壶，公布了丑闻的更多细节。

senses.en: Pass a quality or characteristic to people.
senses.example: His enthusiasm RUBS OFF ON everyone around him.
senses.example_zh: 他的热情感染了周围的每个人。

senses.en: Delete ink or pencil with an eraser.
senses.example: He RUBBED OUT the figure and wrote the correct one in.
senses.example_zh: 他擦掉那个数字，写上了正确的。

senses.example: The gangsters RUBBED him OUT for stealing from them.
senses.example_zh: 因为偷了他们的东西，黑帮把他干掉了。

senses.en: Touch someone in a sensual or sexual way.
senses.example: The cat RUBBED UP AGAINST my leg purring.
senses.example_zh: 猫蹭着我的腿，发出咕噜声。

senses.example: I need to RUB UP ON my Portuguese before I go to Brazil.
senses.example_zh: 去巴西之前我需要复习一下葡萄牙语。

senses.example: The police have RULED OUT suicide and are treating it as a case of murder.
senses.example_zh: 警方已经排除了自杀的可能，正将此案作为谋杀案处理。

senses.example: I RAN ACROSS an old friend in the library.
senses.example_zh: 我在图书馆偶遇了一位老朋友。

senses.example: The police RAN AFTER the guy who'd stolen it, but he was too fast for them.
senses.example_zh: 警察追赶那个偷东西的家伙，但他跑得太快了。

senses.en: Try to become romanticallyinvolved with someone.
senses.example: He was RUNNING AFTER her for ages never managed to get a date.
senses.example_zh: 他追求她很久，但一直没能约到她。

senses.example: Opinion is RUNNING AGAINST his policies and he has very little support.
senses.example_zh: 舆论正变得不利于他的政策，他几乎没有什么支持。

senses.en: Go away, leave (often as an imperative).
senses.example: Theykept disturbing him, so he told them to RUN ALONG and leave him in peace.
senses.example_zh: 他们一直打扰他，所以他叫他们走开，让他清静一下。

senses.en: Be very busy doing many things.
senses.example: I'm exhausted-I've been RUNNING AROUND all day.
senses.example_zh: 我累坏了——我整天都在四处奔忙。

senses.example: He RAN AWAY from his attackers.
senses.example_zh: 他逃离了袭击者。

senses.en: Leavehome because of problems with other family members or to elope.
senses.example: She RAN AWAY to avoid a forced marriage.
senses.example_zh: 她离家出走来逃避包办婚姻。

senses.en: Hit a pedestrian with a vehicle.
senses.example: The minicab RAN him DOWN on the zebra crossing.
senses.example_zh: 那辆微型出租车在斑马线上把他撞倒了。

senses.example: You should only recharge the battery when it has fully RUN DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 你应该只在电池完全耗尽时才充电。

senses.example: They're always RUNNING me DOWN and I am sick and tired of it.
senses.example_zh: 他们总是贬低我，我对此感到厌烦透顶。

senses.en: Find the source or origin of something.
senses.example: The police RAN DOWN all the leads they had and caught them.
senses.example_zh: 警方追查了所有线索，抓住了他们。

senses.example: She's thinking about RUNNING FOR the presidency.
senses.example_zh: 她正在考虑竞选总统。

senses.en: Arrest, take to police station for questioning.
senses.example: They RAN him IN last night.
senses.example_zh: 他们昨晚逮捕了他。

senses.en: Drive a new car carefully in order not to damage the engine.
senses.example: She RAN the car IN for a thousand miles.
senses.example_zh: 她小心地磨合新车，开了一千英里。

senses.example: We RAN IN and chatted for an hour.
senses.example_zh: 我们顺道拜访，聊了一个小时。

senses.example: He RAN a graph IN next to the text.
senses.example_zh: 他在正文旁边插入了一张图表。

senses.example: The project has RUN INTO millions of dollars without any prospect of a return on this investment.
senses.example_zh: 该项目已耗资数百万美元，却看不到任何投资回报的前景。

senses.example: I RAN INTO James in a bar in the City on Friday.
senses.example_zh: 周五我在金融城的一家酒吧里偶遇了詹姆斯。

senses.example: Could you RUN OFF two hundred copies of this report, please.
senses.example_zh: 请你把这份报告复印两百份好吗？

senses.example: The van RUNS ON diesel.
senses.example_zh: 这辆货车以柴油为动力。

senses.example: We've RUN OUT OF sugar; I'm going to the shops for some.
senses.example_zh: 我们的糖用完了；我要去商店买一些。

senses.example: Could you RUN OVER that point again; I'm afraid I didn't quite understand it.
senses.example_zh: 你能再快速解释一下那一点吗？恐怕我没太听懂。

senses.example: The driver couldn't stop in time and RAN the fox OVER when it ran in front of his car.
senses.example_zh: 司机来不及刹车，当狐狸跑到车前时把它撞倒了。

senses.example: The meeting RAN OVER by twenty minutes.
senses.example_zh: 会议超时了二十分钟。

senses.en: Practise a dramatic work like a play quickly.
senses.example: The cast RAN THROUGH the play the day before it opened to the public.
senses.example_zh: 演员们在向公众开放的前一天快速排练了这出戏。

senses.en: Stab or wound deeply with a knife, sword, etc..
senses.example: The musketeer RAN his enemy THROUGH with a sword and killed him.
senses.example_zh: 火枪手用剑刺穿了他的敌人，杀死了他。

senses.example: Whenever he gets into debt, he RUNS TO his parents for help.
senses.example_zh: 每当他负债时，他就求助于父母。

senses.example: His musical tastes RUN TO the Residents, who are hated by most people.
senses.example_zh: 他的音乐品味倾向于Residents乐队，而大多数人讨厌他们。

senses.en: Have enough money to buy something, often negative.
senses.example: Things are a bit tight and won't RUN TO going abroad for a holiday.
senses.example_zh: 手头有点紧，不够钱去国外度假。

senses.en: Move quickly to where someone is.
senses.example: He RAN UP next to me and started shouting.
senses.example_zh: 他跑向我旁边，开始大喊大叫。

senses.example: They RAN UP the Union Jack.
senses.example_zh: 他们升起了英国国旗。

senses.en: Do or make something very quickly.
senses.example: He RAN UP a few examples for them to look at.
senses.example_zh: 他快速制作了几个例子供他们参考。

senses.en: Spend a lot of money on credit.
senses.example: He RAN UP a lot of bills at the hotel.
senses.example_zh: 他在酒店积欠了许多账单。

senses.example: They RAN UP AGAINSTa lot of opposition to the construction.
senses.example_zh: 他们遭遇了许多反对建设的意见。

senses.example: Robert was sitting in his car and a guy RAN UP ON him and shot through the car but missed.
senses.example_zh: 罗伯特正坐在车里，一个家伙悄悄接近他，朝车里开枪但没打中。

senses.example: She RUNS WITH some dodgy characters.
senses.example_zh: 她与一些不三不四的人为伍。

senses.en: Leave a place in a hurry.
senses.example: They RUSHED AWAY when the police arrived.
senses.example_zh: 警察来时他们匆忙离开了。

senses.example: They don't want to be RUSHED INTO giving an answer and have asked for more time.
senses.example_zh: 他们不想仓促给出答案，要求更多时间。

senses.example: Zac RUSHED OFF to get to his medical appointment.
senses.example_zh: 扎克匆忙离去，赶着去看医生。

senses.en: Release or put something on sale quickly.
senses.example: They RUSHED the single OUT after it started getting airplay.
senses.example_zh: 单曲开始播出后，他们赶制发行了它。

senses.en: Make something quickly without much preparation.
senses.example: We RUSTLED UP dinner from what was in the fridge.
senses.example_zh: 我们用冰箱里的东西匆忙凑合了一顿晚餐。

senses.en: Put a saddle on and prepare an animal to ride.
senses.example: She SADDLED UP the horse and rode off.
senses.example_zh: 她给马备好鞍，然后骑走了。

senses.en: Give someone a task or responsibility that is difficult or hard work.
senses.example: They SADDLED me WITH preparing the visit.
senses.example_zh: 他们让我承担准备这次访问的任务。

senses.en: Not go to school or work, or leave early when you shouldn't.
senses.example: I was bored so I SAGGED OFF work early and went home.
senses.example_zh: 我觉得无聊，就提前偷懒下班回家了。

senses.example: He SAILED INTO me for turning up an hour late.
senses.example_zh: 他因为我迟到了一小时而痛斥我。

senses.example: He SAILED THROUGH the final test.
senses.example_zh: 他轻松通过了期末考试。

senses.example: The townspeople SALLIED FORTH to fight the invading army.
senses.example_zh: 镇民们出发去抗击入侵的军队。

senses.example: Though it was pouring with rain, we SALLIED OUT to meet her.
senses.example_zh: 尽管下着倾盆大雨，我们还是出发去见她。

senses.example: She's making a lot of money, but SALTS it AWAY rather than spending it.
senses.example_zh: 她挣很多钱，但都存起来而不是花掉。

senses.en: Reduce or avoid consumption to cut costs.
senses.example: I use Skype to SAVE ON my phone bills.
senses.example_zh: 我用Skype来节省电话费。

senses.en: For money for a particular purpose.
senses.example: He's SAVING UP to buy a car.
senses.example_zh: 他正在攒钱买车。

senses.en: Collect or store something for future use.
senses.example: I'm SAVING UPthe receipts to claim on them all at once.
senses.example_zh: 我正在积攒收据，以便一次性报销。

senses.en: To remove something by cutting it with a saw.
senses.example: He SAWED OFF the legs of the chair.
senses.example_zh: 他锯掉了椅子的腿。

senses.en: Cut into pieces with a saw.
senses.example: We SAWED the plank UP to make the shelves.
senses.example_zh: 我们把木板锯成小块来做架子。

senses.en: Make something smaller than originally planned.
senses.example: They had to SCALE BACK the project because of the costs.
senses.example_zh: 由于成本问题，他们不得不缩减项目规模。

senses.en: Make something smaller than originally planned.
senses.example: They have had to SCALE DOWN the project because of the costs.
senses.example_zh: 由于成本问题，他们不得不缩减项目规模。

senses.example: They are SCALING UP the programme because it has been so successful.
senses.example_zh: 由于非常成功，他们正在扩大该项目的规模。

senses.en: Frighten someone some much that they go away.
senses.example: The cat SCARED the birds AWAY.
senses.example_zh: 猫把鸟吓跑了。

senses.en: Make someone so frightened that he or she away.
senses.example: The vicious Doberman guard-dog SCARED the burglars AWAY.
senses.example_zh: 凶猛的杜宾犬看门狗把窃贼吓跑了。

senses.en: Look in different places for something.
senses.example: The company is SCOUTING ABOUT for new staff.
senses.example_zh: 公司正在四处寻找新员工。

senses.en: Look in different places for something.
senses.example: We SCOUTED AROUND to find the best price.
senses.example_zh: 我们四处寻找最优惠的价格。

senses.example: The researcher spent months SCOUTING OUT the answer.
senses.example_zh: 研究人员花了几个月时间搜寻答案。

senses.en: Look in different places for something.
senses.example: I SCOUTED ROUND for a bargain.
senses.example_zh: 我四处寻找便宜货。

senses.en: Try to find someone for a task or requirement.
senses.example: We'd better SCOUT UP a replacement for her.
senses.example_zh: 我们最好物色一个人来替代她。

senses.example: I've been SCRAPING ALONG on temporary work since I lost my job.
senses.example_zh: 自从失业后，我一直靠打零工勉强糊口。

senses.example: I thought I was going to fail, but SCRAPED BY with 51%.
senses.example_zh: 我以为我会不及格，但以51分勉强通过了。

senses.en: Just get enough to succeed, pass or be accepted.
senses.example: The government SCRAPED IN with 51% of the votes cast.
senses.example_zh: 政府以51%的选票勉强获胜。

senses.en: Be accepted somewhere, but only just.
senses.example: She got mediocre grades and just SCRAPED INTO university.
senses.example_zh: 她成绩平平，勉强进入了大学。

senses.en: Pass a test but only just.
senses.example: I did no revision and only just SCRAPED THROUGH the final exams.
senses.example_zh: 我没有复习，只是勉强通过了期末考试。

senses.en: Manage to collect enough of something you need, usually money.
senses.example: I had to search my flat for money to SCRAPE TOGETHER what I needed.
senses.example_zh: 我不得不翻遍公寓找钱，才勉强凑齐了所需。

senses.en: Manage to collect enough of something you need, usually money.
senses.example: It took me ages to SCRAPE UP the money for the tickets.
senses.example_zh: 我花了很长时间才勉强凑齐买票的钱。

senses.en: Separate a part of a room with something like a curtain, screen, etc..
senses.example: We SCREENED OFF the area where we had the discussion from the rest of the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 我们用屏风把讨论区与会议其他部分隔开。

senses.example: Applicants without the right qualifications were SCREENED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 资格不符的申请者被筛选掉了。

senses.example: The sun cream SCREENS OUT UV light.
senses.example_zh: 防晒霜能遮挡紫外线。

senses.example: There are so many notices and signs that I have started SCREENING them OUT.
senses.example_zh: 通知和标志太多了，我已经开始忽略它们了。

senses.example: He spent the afternoon SCREWING AROUD and got nothing done.
senses.example_zh: 他一下午都在闲混，什么也没做成。

senses.example: He SCREWED AROUND a lot at university.
senses.example_zh: 他在大学时乱搞男女关系。

senses.example: The IRS really SCREWED him OVER.
senses.example_zh: 美国国税局可把他坑惨了。

senses.example: David SCREWED UP his oral exam but still managed to scrape a pass.
senses.example_zh: 大卫口试考砸了，但勉强及格。

senses.example: I'll SEE ABOUT whether we can manage it.
senses.example_zh: 我会考虑一下我们能否办到。

senses.example: Her secretary SAW me INTO her office.
senses.example_zh: 她的秘书把我领进了她的办公室。

senses.example: A cat came into the back garden but the dog soon SAW it OFF.
senses.example_zh: 一只猫进了后花园，但狗很快把它赶走了。

senses.en: Go to the airport, station, etc., to say goodbye to someone.
senses.example: I went to the station to SEE them OFF.
senses.example_zh: 我去车站为他们送行。

senses.en: Accompany a guest to your front door when they are leaving your house.
senses.example: Are you sure you're going? I'll get your coats and SEE you OUT.
senses.example_zh: 你确定要走吗？我去拿你的外套，送你出去。

senses.en: Continue with something to the end.
senses.example: They had a lot of difficulties in implementing the project, but the team SAW it THROUGH successfully.
senses.example_zh: 他们在实施项目时遇到了很多困难，但团队成功坚持完成了。

senses.en: Realise someone is lying or being deceitful.
senses.example: The police quickly SAW THROUGH her disguise and arrested her.
senses.example_zh: 警方很快识破了她的伪装并逮捕了她。

senses.example: He SAW TO the arrangements and everything ran smoothly and efficiently.
senses.example_zh: 他处理了安排事宜，一切顺利高效地进行。

senses.en: Sell a business or part of it.
senses.example: They SOLD OFF their research subsidiary.
senses.example_zh: 他们出售了研究子公司。

senses.en: Sell something cheaply because you need the money or don't need it.
senses.example: She SOLD OFF her furniture before she emigrated.
senses.example_zh: 她移民前把家具都廉价卖掉了。

senses.example: We managed to SELL him ON the expansion plans.
senses.example_zh: 我们成功说服他接受了扩张计划。

senses.en: Buy something then sell it to someone else.
senses.example: We buy them wholesale and SELL them ON to the public.
senses.example_zh: 我们批发买入，然后转售给公众。

senses.en: Have no more of somethingleft because it has been bought.
senses.example: The tickets for the Primal Scream concert at the Brixton Academy SOLD OUT in a couple of hours.
senses.example_zh: 原始呐喊乐队在布里克斯顿学院的演唱会门票几小时内就售罄了。

senses.en: Lose all artistic integrity in return for commercial success.
senses.example: Most bands SELL OUT when they sign to a major record label, and forget all their principles when pursuing chart success.
senses.example_zh: 大多数乐队在签约大唱片公司后就背叛了原则，为了追求排行榜成功而忘记了一切。

senses.en: Sell a house or business to move somewhere or do something different.
senses.example: We want to SELL UP and move to the country.
senses.example_zh: 我们想变卖家产搬到乡下去。

senses.example: I SENT my food BACK because it was overcooked.
senses.example_zh: 我把食物退回去了，因为煮得太老了。

senses.en: Ask someone to come and help.
senses.example: I had to SEND FOR a plumber because the radiator was leaking.
senses.example_zh: 我不得不派人去请水管工，因为暖气片漏水了。

senses.en: Order people into a place to handle a problem.
senses.example: The police were SENT IN to quell the riot as the protesters had started burning cars andwrecking shops.
senses.example_zh: 警察被派去平息骚乱，因为抗议者开始烧车砸店。

senses.example: If you want to enter the competition, you have to SEND IN for an entry form.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想参加比赛，必须写信索取报名表。

senses.en: Expel a sports player from a match.
senses.example: The football striker was SENT OFF for arguing with the referee's decision.
senses.example_zh: 那名足球前锋因与裁判争论判罚而被罚下场。

senses.example: I must SEND this letter OFF today otherwise it won't get there in time.
senses.example_zh: 我今天必须把这封信寄出去，否则就不能及时寄到了。

senses.example: I SENT OFF FOR some jeans that I liked in the catalogue.
senses.example_zh: 我邮购了一些在目录上喜欢的牛仔裤。

senses.en: Send something to a lot of people.
senses.example: They SENT OUT a mailshot to all their existing customers.
senses.example_zh: 他们向所有现有客户寄发了广告邮件。

senses.example: We couldn't be bothered to cook, so we SENT OUT FOR a pizza.
senses.example_zh: 我们懒得做饭，就叫了披萨外卖。

senses.example: The mischievous schoolboy was standing at the front of the class, SENDING the teacher UP, when the teacher opened the door behind him.
senses.example_zh: 那个淘气的男生站在教室前面滑稽地模仿老师，这时老师从后面推门进来了。

senses.example: We SET ABOUT the cleaning and got it done before lunchtime.
senses.example_zh: 我们开始打扫，午饭前就完成了。

senses.example: The gang SET ABOUT her as she left the bank.
senses.example_zh: 她离开银行时，那帮人袭击了她。

senses.en: Distinguish, be better than or different from others.
senses.example: The quality of their work SETS them APART from their rivals.
senses.example_zh: 他们的工作质量使他们从竞争对手中脱颖而出。

senses.en: Overturn a court verdict or decision.
senses.example: The Appeal Court SET ASIDE the guilty verdict because the evidence was unsatisfactory and declared her not guilty.
senses.example_zh: 上诉法院撤销了有罪判决，因为证据不充分，并宣布她无罪。

senses.example: The car repairs SET me BACK eight hundred pounds.
senses.example_zh: 汽车修理花了我八百英镑。

senses.example: The accident SET the project BACK several months.
senses.example_zh: 事故使项目延误了几个月。

senses.example: He SET FORTH his ideas in his autobiography.
senses.example_zh: 他在自传中阐述了自己的想法。

senses.example: We SET FORTH at daybreak for the summit of the mountain.
senses.example_zh: 我们黎明时出发去山顶。

senses.example: Winter has SET IN; it's started snowing.
senses.example_zh: 冬天已经来临，开始下雪了。

senses.example: Terrorists SET OFF a car bomb in the city centre last night. Fortunately, no-one was hurt or killed.
senses.example_zh: 恐怖分子昨晚在市中心引爆了一枚汽车炸弹。幸运的是，没有人受伤或死亡。
