senses.example: The smoke SET the fire alarm OFF.
senses.example_zh: 烟雾触发了火灾警报。

senses.example: We SET OFF for work at seven-thirty.
senses.example_zh: 我们七点半出发去上班。

senses.example: The company SET OFF its overseas debts against it profits at home.
senses.example_zh: 公司用海外债务抵消了国内利润。

senses.en: Provide a visual contrast that looks good.
senses.example: The dark frame SETS the pale drawing OFF well.
senses.example_zh: 深色画框很好地衬托了这幅浅色画。

senses.example: The pay freeze SET OFF a wave of strikes.
senses.example_zh: 工资冻结引发了一波罢工潮。

senses.example: He was SET ON when he left the bar.
senses.example_zh: 他离开酒吧时遭到了袭击。

senses.example: The figures are SET OUT in the council's annual report.
senses.example_zh: 这些数字在委员会的年度报告中展示了出来。

senses.example: The explorers SET OUT for the South Pole yesterday morning.
senses.example_zh: 探险者们昨天早上出发去南极。

senses.example: The contract SETS OUT all the details of the agreement.
senses.example_zh: 合同列出了协议的所有细节。

senses.example: If we all SET TO, we should be able to finish this in a few hours.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们都起劲地干，应该能在几个小时内完成。

senses.en: Prepare equipment, software, etc., for use.
senses.example: The technician SET UP the computer network perfectly.
senses.example_zh: 技术员完美地设置了计算机网络。

senses.example: They SET UP a dot com company, floated it a couple of years later on the Stock Exchange and made an absolute fortune.
senses.example_zh: 他们创立了一家网络公司，几年后在证券交易所上市，赚了一大笔钱。

senses.en: Provide someone the money needed to live.
senses.example: Winning the lottery SET them UP for life.
senses.example_zh: 中了彩票让他们一辈子生活无忧。

senses.example: The police SET them UP.
senses.example_zh: 警察陷害了他们。

senses.example: They SET UPON her when she was in the car park.
senses.example_zh: 她在停车场时，他们袭击了她。

senses.en: Start living a fixed and routine life.
senses.example: After years of partying and drinking, she finally got married and SETTLED DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 在多年聚会和饮酒之后，她终于结婚并安定下来。

senses.example: We were upset not to win and had to SETTLE FOR the second prize.
senses.example_zh: 我们没赢很失望，只能接受二等奖。

senses.example: It took him a while to SETTLE IN when he moved to Japan.
senses.example_zh: 他搬到日本后花了一段时间才适应。

senses.example: They couldn't agree at first on a name for their daughter, but finally SETTLED ON Alice.
senses.example_zh: 他们起初对女儿的名字意见不一，但最终决定叫爱丽丝。

senses.example: Let's SETTLE UP for the dinner the other night.
senses.example_zh: 我们把前几天晚餐的账结了吧。

senses.en: Change information to make it more attractive to the reader or listener.
senses.example: The government denied that they had SEXED UP the report to make the front page.
senses.example_zh: 政府否认他们为了上头条而美化了报告。

senses.en: Live with someone when you are in a relationship..
senses.example: They SHACKED UP a few months after they started going out.
senses.example_zh: 他们开始约会几个月后就同居了。

senses.example: We had to SHACK UP with friends while our house was being decorated.
senses.example_zh: 房子装修期间，我们不得不暂住在朋友家。

senses.en: Make a part of a picture darker.
senses.example: She SHADED IN the area under the tree.
senses.example_zh: 她把树下区域涂暗了。

senses.example: The police SHOOK the house DOWN looking for drugs.
senses.example_zh: 警察彻底搜查了房子寻找毒品。

senses.en: Extort or cheat money from someone.
senses.example: He SHOOK the guy DOWN with some story about needing the money for an operation.
senses.example_zh: 他编了个需要钱做手术的故事敲诈了那家伙。

senses.example: It took me ages to SHAKE OFF the cough.
senses.example_zh: 我花了很长时间才摆脱咳嗽。

senses.en: Shake clothes, cloths, etc to remove dirt or creases.
senses.example: He took the tablecloth outside and SHOOK it OUT after dinner.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭后，他把桌布拿到外面抖了抖。

senses.example: The news of her death really SHOOK me UP.
senses.example_zh: 她去世的消息让我非常震惊。

senses.en: Make major changes to improve or save a company, organisation, etc.
senses.example: The management are SHAKING things UP and getting rid of a lot of workers.
senses.example_zh: 管理层正在进行大幅改组，裁掉很多员工。

senses.en: Mix things in a container by shaking hard.
senses.example: Pour the ingredients into a container and SHAKE them UP.
senses.example_zh: 把原料倒入容器中摇匀。

senses.example: Things are SHAPING UP at work-everything's going well again.
senses.example_zh: 工作上的事情进展顺利——一切又都好起来了。

senses.en: Improve to reach an acceptable standard.
senses.example: If they don't start SHAPING UP, they're going to lose their jobs.
senses.example_zh: 如果他们不开始改进，就会丢掉工作。

senses.example: He has SHAVED OFF his moustache and looks much younger.
senses.example_zh: 他剃掉了胡子，看起来年轻多了。

senses.example: He SHAVED a few thousand OFF the budget for the year.
senses.example_zh: 他从年度预算中削减了几千英镑。

senses.en: Spend money on something, especially when you think it's too expensive.
senses.example: I had to SHELL OUT a hundred pounds on the dinner.
senses.example_zh: 我不得不为这顿饭掏了一百英镑。

senses.en: Send someone away, often because of a problem.
senses.example: He was causing a lot of trouble, so they SHIPPED him OFF to another branch
senses.example_zh: 他惹了很多麻烦，所以他们把他打发到了另一个分公司。

senses.example: We SHIPPED the order OUT two days ago.
senses.example_zh: 我们两天前就发出了订单。

senses.example: If you've finished your work, I'm ready to SHIP OUT.
senses.example_zh: 如果你完成了工作，我准备出发了。

senses.example: He SHOT AWAY as soon as the bell rang for the end of the lesson.
senses.example_zh: 下课铃一响，他就迅速离开了。

senses.example: I'm SHOOTING BACK home to pick up some things I forgot to bring with me.
senses.example_zh: 我正赶回家去取一些我忘记带的东西。

senses.example: I’m SHOOTING FOR nothing less than the presidency.
senses.example_zh: 我的目标至少是当总统。

senses.example: I'll have to SHOOT OFF as soon as the lesson finishes, otherwise I'll miss my train.
senses.example_zh: 下课后我得赶紧走，否则就赶不上火车了。

senses.en: Go out for a short time.
senses.example: I'm SHOOTING OUT to the shops for a paper.
senses.example_zh: 我出去一下，到商店买份报纸。

senses.example: The share prices of internet companies have been SHOOTING UP lately.
senses.example_zh: 互联网公司的股价最近一直在飙升。

senses.example: The heroin-user would SHOOT UP in shop doorways.
senses.example_zh: 那个海洛因使用者会在商店门口注射毒品。

senses.example: The gangsters SHOT UP the pub.
senses.example_zh: 歹徒们开枪扫射了那家酒吧。

senses.example: Johnny has SHOT UP since I last saw him
senses.example_zh: 自从我上次见到约翰尼，他长高了很多。

senses.en: Look around for the best price, quality, etc..
senses.example: If you SHOP AROUND, you can find some real bargains for air tickets.
senses.example_zh: 如果你多比较几家，就能找到一些真正的便宜机票。

senses.example: The battery SHORTED OUT when it got wet.
senses.example_zh: 电池受潮后短路了。

senses.en: Make so much noise to stop someone being heard.
senses.example: His efforts to raise the issue were SHOUTED DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 他试图提出这个问题，但被大声喝止了。

senses.en: Say something loudly, often to attract someone's attention.
senses.example: She SHOUTED OUT my name.
senses.example_zh: 她大声喊出了我的名字。

senses.en: Take someone to a place to show them certain parts.
senses.example: The estate agent SHOWED us AROUND the house but we didn't like it much.
senses.example_zh: 房地产经纪人带我们参观了房子，但我们不太喜欢。

senses.en: Take someone into an office or other room.
senses.example: The secretary SHOWED me IN to speak to the manager.
senses.example_zh: 秘书把我领进去见经理。

senses.en: Behave in a way so as to attract attention.
senses.example: The children were SHOWING OFF and irritated me.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们在炫耀，让我很恼火。

senses.en: Display something you are proud of.
senses.example: He wanted to SHOW OFF his new sound system.
senses.example_zh: 他想炫耀他的新音响系统。

senses.en: Make the qualities of another thing more apparent.
senses.example: The shirt really SHOWED OFF his new tie.
senses.example_zh: 这件衬衫很好地衬托了他的新领带。

senses.en: Take someone to out of a room or building.
senses.example: Her secretary SHOWED me OUT after the interview.
senses.example_zh: 面试结束后，她的秘书把我送了出去。

senses.example: He SHOWED us OVER the scene of the accident
senses.example_zh: 他带我们参观了事故现场。

senses.en: Take someone to a place to show them certain parts.
senses.example: The guide SHOWED them ROUND the historic part of the city.
senses.example_zh: 导游带他们参观了这座城市的历史遗迹。

senses.en: When a feeling can be seen despite attempts to conceal it.
senses.example: His anger SHOWED THROUGH despite his smile.
senses.example_zh: 尽管他面带微笑，但他的愤怒还是流露了出来。

senses.example: Very few SHOWED UP at the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 很少有人出席会议。

senses.example: The downturn in sales SHOWED UP in the company's accounts.
senses.example_zh: 销售下滑在公司的账目中显现出来。

senses.en: Make someone feel embarrassed or ashamed.
senses.example: He SHOWED us UP when he arrived drunk and started arguing.
senses.example_zh: 他喝醉了酒来，还开始争吵，让我们很难堪。

senses.en: Disregard something, not consider it important or harmful.
senses.example: He SHRUGGED OFF the criticism and carried on the same way.
senses.example_zh: 他对批评不屑一顾，依然我行我素。

senses.example: Many people have been SHUT AWAY in psychiatric hospitals for disagreeing with the government.
senses.example_zh: 许多人因为与政府意见不合而被关进精神病院。

senses.example: The shop SHUT DOWN when the out-of-town supermarket opened.
senses.example_zh: 城外的超市开业后，这家商店就关门了。

senses.example: You should close all programs before you SHUT a computer DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 在关闭计算机之前，你应该关闭所有程序。

senses.example: I SHUT the cat IN until it was time to go to the vet.
senses.example_zh: 我把猫关在里面，直到该带它去看兽医的时候。

senses.example: They SHUT the water OFF while they did the repairs.
senses.example_zh: 他们修理时关闭了水。

senses.example: You have to SHUT your feelings OUT to deal with it.
senses.example_zh: 你必须把感情排除在外才能应对这件事。

senses.en: Not allow a player or team to score.
senses.example: The Dodgers SHUT OUT the Giants 3-0.
senses.example_zh: 道奇队以3比0完封巨人队。

senses.en: Exclude someone from an activity, etc.
senses.example: He's been SHUT OUT OF the discussions.
senses.example_zh: 他被排除在讨论之外。

senses.example: He told us to SHUT UP and start working.
senses.example_zh: 他叫我们闭嘴，开始干活。

senses.en: Close for a period of time.
senses.example: They SHUT the shop UP for a fortnight while they were on holiday.
senses.example_zh: 他们度假期间把店关了半个月。

senses.example: She's SHUT herself AWAY to revise for her exams.
senses.example_zh: 她把自己关起来复习备考。

senses.en: Avoid doing somethingbecause you lack confidence.
senses.example: Many learners SHY AWAY FROM using phrasal verbs.
senses.zh: 回避；因缺乏信心而避免
senses.example_zh: 许多学习者回避使用动词短语。

senses.example: The lecturer SIDED WITH her students and got sacked for her pains.
senses.example_zh: 讲师站在学生一边，结果因此被解雇了。

senses.example: He SIDLED UP TO me and whispered his name.
senses.example_zh: 他悄悄凑到我身边，低声说出了自己的名字。

senses.en: Examine a lot of things carefully.
senses.example: We had to SIFT THROUGH thousands of files before we found what we were looking for.
senses.example_zh: 我们不得不翻查数千份文件，才找到我们要找的东西。

senses.en: Give away legal or property rights.
senses.example: He SIGNED AWAY his rights to compensation when he signed the contract.
senses.example_zh: 他签合同时签字放弃了索赔权。

senses.en: Write a signature on behalf on someone.
senses.example: My boss was out for the day, so I SIGNED her letters FOR her.
senses.example_zh: 我老板那天外出了，所以我代她签了信。

senses.example: We SIGNED IN and went straight to bed.
senses.example_zh: 我们登记入住后就直接睡觉了。

senses.en: Open a computer program that requires a name and password.
senses.example: I SIGNED IN and started chatting online.
senses.example_zh: 我登录后开始网上聊天。

senses.en: Write your name when entering a place.
senses.example: You have to SIGN IN before you can enter the club.
senses.example_zh: 进入俱乐部前你必须签到。

senses.en: Open a particular computer program that requires a name and password.
senses.example: I SIGN INTO MSN Messenger automatically when I boot up.
senses.example_zh: 我开机时会自动登录MSN Messenger。

senses.example: I'll SIGN OFF now, but will write again next week.
senses.example_zh: 我现在就写到这儿，下周再写。

senses.en: Close a claim for unemployment benefit.
senses.example: I SIGNED OFF when I got my new job.
senses.example_zh: 我找到新工作后就注销了失业救济。

senses.example: I'm SIGNING OFF now and going home-I'm shattered.
senses.example_zh: 我现在要收工回家了——我累坏了。

senses.en: Give someone a letter to be away from work.
senses.example: My doctor SIGNED me OFF for a month with back problems.
senses.example_zh: 医生因我背部问题给我开了一个月的病假。

senses.example: The director SIGNED OFF ON the plans to increase sales.
senses.example_zh: 主管正式批准了增加销售的计划。

senses.en: Open a claim for unemployment benefit.
senses.example: I had to SIGN ON when I lost my job.
senses.example_zh: 我失业后不得不申请失业救济。

senses.example: I've SIGNED ON to help at the village fete.
senses.example_zh: 我已报名参加村里游园会的帮忙工作。

senses.example: He SIGNS ON the same way every show.
senses.example_zh: 他每次节目都以同样的方式开始广播。

senses.example: We've SIGNED ON two new teachers.
senses.example_zh: 我们雇了两名新教师。

senses.en: Sign a document joining or agreeing to something.
senses.example: He's SIGNED ON WITH Manchester United for the next three years.
senses.example_zh: 他已与曼联签约三年。

senses.en: Close a computer program that requires a name and password.
senses.example: I SIGNED OUT and then shut the computer down.
senses.example_zh: 我退出登录，然后关掉了电脑。

senses.en: Sign something to show you have borrowed something.
senses.example: Could you SIGN those books OUT, please?
senses.example_zh: 请你把那些书登记借出好吗？

senses.en: Close a particular computer program that requires a name and password.
senses.example: I SIGNED OUT OF MSN Messenger and shut the computer down.
senses.example_zh: 我退出了MSN Messenger，然后关掉了电脑。

senses.en: Give your name to do something.
senses.example: I've SIGNED UP as a volunteer.
senses.example_zh: 我已报名当志愿者。

senses.example: I SIGNED UP for their newsletter.
senses.example_zh: 我订阅了他们的新闻简报。

senses.example: She's SIGNED WITH EMI for the next few years.
senses.example_zh: 她已与EMI签约几年。

senses.example: He told them to SIMMER DOWN because they were disturbing the class next door.
senses.example_zh: 他叫他们安静下来，因为他们打扰了隔壁班上课。

senses.en: To sing when a piece of music is being played or performed by someone else..
senses.example: I SANG ALONG when they played it on the radio.
senses.example_zh: 他们在收音机上播放这首歌时，我跟着唱了。

senses.example: When you hear your name, SING OUT!
senses.example_zh: 听到你的名字时，大声回答！

senses.example: Everyone SANG OUT during the chorus.
senses.example_zh: 合唱部分每个人都大声唱。

senses.example: We can't hear you-SING UP.
senses.example_zh: 我们听不见——唱大声点。

senses.en: Select or choose one from a group.
senses.example: Many people applied for the job but we will SINGLE OUT the best one.
senses.example_zh: 许多人申请这份工作，但我们会挑出最好的那个。

senses.example: The truth finally SANK IN about her death when it was broadcast on TV.
senses.example_zh: 当她的死讯在电视上播出时，真相终于被大家理解了。

senses.en: Sit and do nothing, especially when you should be working.
senses.example: We spent the afternoon SITTING ABOUT chatting instead of doing any work.
senses.example_zh: 我们下午闲坐着聊天，什么工作都没做。

senses.example: They just SAT AROUND while the others did all the work.
senses.example_zh: 其他人都在干活，他们却只是闲坐着。

senses.en: Wait for something to happen without making any effort.
senses.example: We SAT BACK and waited for them to make the first mistake.
senses.example_zh: 我们袖手旁观，等着他们先犯错。

senses.example: I SAT BACK and enjoyed the show.
senses.example_zh: 我放松地坐着欣赏表演。

senses.example: I can't SITBY while they are punished wrongly.
senses.example_zh: 我不能坐视他们被冤枉受罚。

senses.example: The nurse SAT me DOWN in a chair.
senses.example_zh: 护士扶我坐到椅子上。

senses.en: Pose for an artist or photographer.
senses.example: The Queen SAT FOR another official portrait.
senses.example_zh: 女王又坐着让人画了一幅官方肖像。

senses.en: Look after children while their parents are out.
senses.example: She SITS FOR her neighbors when they go out.
senses.example_zh: 邻居外出时，她帮忙照看孩子。

senses.en: Occupy a building to protest about something.
senses.example: The students SAT IN the Library as a protest against the increase in tuition fees.
senses.example_zh: 学生们在图书馆静坐，抗议学费上涨。

senses.en: Take on someone's responsibilities while they are absent.
senses.example: Her deputy's SITTING IN FOR her while she's away.
senses.example_zh: 她不在时，由副手代替她。

senses.example: She SAT IN ON the meeting and took notes but said nothing.
senses.example_zh: 她列席会议，做了笔记但没发言。

senses.example: She's SAT ON the finance committee from the beginning.
senses.example_zh: 她从一开始就是财政委员会的成员。

senses.en: To handle somebody firmly who behaves impertinently, conceitedly.
senses.example: If his girlfriend finds out, she'll get mad and SIT ON him.
senses.example_zh: 要是他女朋友发现了，她会很生气并斥责他。

senses.en: Hold information back or keep it secret.
senses.example: The government have been SITTING ON the report because it was so critical.
senses.example_zh: 政府一直压着那份报告，因为批评太尖锐了。

senses.example: I had to SIT the game OUT because I was ill.
senses.example_zh: 我因为生病，只好不参加那场比赛。

senses.example: WE SAT OVER dinner discussing the plans.
senses.example_zh: 我们边吃晚饭边讨论计划，吃了很久。

senses.en: Stay till the end of something dull.
senses.example: I was bored and wanted to leave halfway through, but we SAT THROUGH the film.
senses.example_zh: 我觉得无聊，中途想走，但还是耐着性子看完了电影。

senses.example: It's hard to see how their new plan SITS WITH the promises they made.
senses.example_zh: 很难看出他们的新计划如何与他们所做的承诺协调一致。

senses.en: Assess a situation or person carefully..
senses.example: The doorstaff SIZED UP everyone entering the club.
senses.example_zh: 门卫打量着每个进俱乐部的人。

senses.en: Make something bigger or produce bigger products.
senses.example: Soft drinks manufacturers have SIZED UP their products in recent years.
senses.example_zh: 近年来，软饮料制造商加大了产品尺寸。

senses.example: She SKINNED UP a fat spliff.
senses.example_zh: 她卷了一根粗大麻烟。

senses.example: Who's going to SKIN UP?
senses.example_zh: 谁来卷大麻烟？

senses.en: Avoid doing work or other duty.
senses.example: I pretended I was ill and SKIVED OFF on Monday.
senses.example_zh: 我假装生病，周一偷懒没去。

senses.en: Reduce one's effort, perform less enthusiasm and energy.
senses.example: Students usually begin the term well, then SLACK OFF near the end of the semester.
senses.example_zh: 学生通常学期初表现很好，临近学期末就懈怠了。

senses.example: Work SLACKENS OFF during the holiday period.
senses.example_zh: 假期期间工作变得清闲了。

senses.example: The concert was terrible and all the papers SLAGGED the band OFF.
senses.example_zh: 音乐会糟透了，所有报纸都猛烈批评了这支乐队。

senses.example: That travel magazine is totally SLANTED TOWARD the ultra-rich.
senses.example_zh: 那本旅游杂志完全偏向超级富豪。

senses.example: Let’s SLEEP IN tomorrow morning-we won’t have another chance for weeks.
senses.example_zh: 明天早上我们睡个懒觉吧——接下来几周都不会有机会了。

senses.en: Sleep in order to recover from excess alcohol, drugs, etc..
senses.example: She went to bed TO SLEEP OFF the effects of the tequila.
senses.example_zh: 她上床睡觉，以消除龙舌兰酒的影响。

senses.example: My boss said she'd have to SLEEP ON it when I asked her for a raise.
senses.example_zh: 我向老板要求加薪时，她说要考虑一晚再决定。

senses.en: Spend the night at someone else's house.
senses.example: The au pair made tea for the friends who were SLEEPING OVER.
senses.example_zh: 保姆为那些在朋友家过夜的孩子们沏了茶。

senses.example: I SLEPT THROUGH the storm even though the wind blew some slates off the roof.
senses.example_zh: 尽管风把屋顶的一些石板瓦吹掉了，我还是没被暴风雨吵醒。

senses.en: Cut, remove an amount or part of something.
senses.example: They CUT 10% OFF the original price.
senses.example_zh: 他们从原价中削减了10%。

senses.en: Cut completely into pieces or slices.
senses.example: I SLICED the cake UP and handed it round to the people there.
senses.example_zh: 我把蛋糕切成片，递给在场的人。

senses.en: Lose an opportunity or the chance of winning, succeeding, etc.
senses.example: Their hopes of getting back into the game SLIPPED AWAY after the second goal.
senses.example_zh: 第二个进球后，他们扳回比赛的希望破灭了。

senses.example: The year has SLIPPED AWAY and it is hard to believe it's over.
senses.example_zh: 一年转眼就过去了，很难相信已经结束了。

senses.example: The years SLIP BY as you get older.
senses.example_zh: 随着年龄增长，岁月飞逝。

senses.en: Lose an opportunity or the chance of winning, succeeding, etc.
senses.example: He didn't follow the offer up and let it SLIP BY.
senses.example_zh: 他没有跟进那个提议，让它溜走了。

senses.en: Be enjoyable to drink or eat.
senses.example: The cold beer SLIPPED DOWN a treat after the walk.
senses.example_zh: 散步后，冰啤酒喝起来特别爽。

senses.en: Try to include something discreetly when speaking.
senses.example: He SLIPPED IN a mention of his exam results to remind us how well he did.
senses.example_zh: 他随口提到自己的考试成绩，提醒我们他考得多好。

senses.example: I got out of my suit and SLIPPED INTO my pyjamas.
senses.example_zh: 我脱下西装，迅速换上睡衣。

senses.en: Acquire bad habits or fall into a bad or negative state or condition.
senses.example: The economy SLIPPED INTO recession and shows no signs of recovery.
senses.example_zh: 经济陷入衰退，且没有复苏的迹象。

senses.example: It was very boring so we SLIPPED OFF before it finished.
senses.example_zh: 太无聊了，所以我们没等结束就悄悄溜走了。

senses.example: I SLIPPED my shoes OFF when I entered.
senses.example_zh: 我进门时脱掉了鞋子。

senses.example: We SLIPPED OFF TO the pub.
senses.example_zh: 我们悄悄溜去了酒吧。

senses.example: I SLIPPED my coat ON and rushed outside.
senses.example_zh: 我迅速穿上外套，冲了出去。

senses.example: The party was really dull so we SLIPPED OUT and went to the pub instead.
senses.example_zh: 派对太无聊了，所以我们悄悄溜出去，去了酒吧。

senses.example: The waitress SLIPPED UP and didn't bring us what we had ordered.
senses.example_zh: 女服务员犯了错，没有给我们上我们点的东西。

senses.example: I SLOBBED ABOUT all day as I couldn't be bothered to do any work.
senses.example_zh: 我整天懒散着，因为懒得做任何工作。

senses.example: I spent the day SLOBBING AROUND at home.
senses.example_zh: 我在家懒散地度过了一天。

senses.en: Leave somewhere without letting others know.
senses.example: The lecture sounded really boring, so I SLOPED OFF and went to the pub.
senses.example_zh: 讲座听起来很无聊，所以我溜走去酒吧了。

senses.example: The government is increasing its powers but is SLOUGHING OFF responsibility for its failures.
senses.example_zh: 政府正在增加权力，却推卸对其失败的责任。

senses.en: Lose or shed outer layers of skin.
senses.example: Snakes SLOUGH OFF their old skin.
senses.example_zh: 蛇会蜕去旧皮。

senses.en: Ignore or trivialize an injury or insult.
senses.example: He SLOUGHED OFF the pain and continued running.
senses.example_zh: 他对疼痛置之不理，继续跑步。

senses.example: The car SLOWED DOWN when they saw the police.
senses.example_zh: 看到警察时，汽车减速了。

senses.example: It is important to slow down, rest, and eat sensibly.
senses.example_zh: 放慢节奏、休息和合理饮食很重要。

senses.example: The negotiations were SLOWED UP by the arguments.
senses.example_zh: 争论使谈判进度减慢了。

senses.example: They SLUGGED IT OUT for hours but never came to an agreement.
senses.example_zh: 他们激烈争论了几个小时，但从未达成一致。

senses.en: Appear to have a negative quality.
senses.example: The government's decision SMACKS OF hypocrisy.
senses.example_zh: 政府的决定带有虚伪的意味。

senses.example: The police SMASHED the door DOWN to get into the house.
senses.example_zh: 警察砸开了门，进入房子。

senses.en: Break something by hitting it repeatedly.
senses.example: He SMASHED the windscreen IN.
senses.example_zh: 他砸碎了挡风玻璃。

senses.example: The burglars SMASHED UP the office as there was no money to steal.
senses.example_zh: 窃贼因为没有钱可偷，就把办公室砸了个稀巴烂。

senses.en: Force someone out of a place they're hiding in.
senses.example: The police SMOKED the gang OUT and arrested them.
senses.example_zh: 警方把那个团伙熏了出来，然后逮捕了他们。

senses.en: Consume, take, buy something other peoplemay want.
senses.example: They SNAFFLED UP all the food before we got there.
senses.example_zh: 我们还没到，他们就把所有食物都抢光了。

senses.example: He SNAPPED OFF a bit of chocolate from the bar and gave it to me..
senses.example_zh: 他从巧克力棒上掰下一块给了我。

senses.example: I was feeling depressed and knew I had to SNAP OUT OF it.
senses.example_zh: 我当时很沮丧，知道自己必须振作起来。

senses.example: He had taken ages so I told him to SNAP TO IT and get it finished.
senses.example_zh: 他拖了很久，所以我叫他快点干完。

senses.en: Get, acquire or buy something quickly.
senses.example: Collectors SNAPPED UP every copy the day it was released.
senses.example_zh: 收藏家们在发行当天就把每一本都抢购一空。

senses.example: My line was all SNARLED UP after I caught that last fish.
senses.example_zh: 我钓上最后那条鱼后，鱼线全缠在一起了。

senses.example: Although the thieves tried to SNEAK OUT after dark, we were ready for them.
senses.example_zh: 尽管小偷们试图天黑后偷偷溜走，但我们已做好了准备。

senses.example: Dave tried to SNEAK UP ON the guard, but was seen anyway.
senses.example_zh: 戴夫试图悄悄接近警卫，但还是被发现了。

senses.en: Look around to see how good something is or to try to find something better.
senses.example: I SNIFFED AROUND to see if I could find a better deal.
senses.example_zh: 我四处打探，看看能不能找到更划算的交易。

senses.example: A job opportunity like that is not to be SNIFFED AT.
senses.example_zh: 像那样的工作机会可不能小看。

senses.en: Find something by smell (usually for dogs).
senses.example: Customs use dogs to SNIFF OUT illegal drugs being smuggled in.
senses.example_zh: 海关用狗嗅出走私进来的非法毒品。

senses.en: Find out information, especially when people don't want anyone to know.
senses.example: Our rivals are trying to SNIFF OUT our plans for expansion.
senses.example_zh: 我们的竞争对手正试图打探出我们的扩张计划。

senses.en: Divulge secrets, inform authorities about someone.
senses.example: Reggie was caught after someone SNITCHED ON him to the teacher.
senses.example_zh: 有人向老师告发了雷吉，之后他就被抓住了。

senses.en: Extinguish a small flame by covering it.
senses.example: I SNUFFED OUT the candles before I went to bed.
senses.example_zh: 我睡觉前把蜡烛掐灭了。

senses.example: He got SNUFFED OUT in a gang war.
senses.example_zh: 他在一场帮派火并中被干掉了。

senses.example: I messed up the first question, which SNUFFED OUT my chances of getting a good grade.
senses.example_zh: 我第一题就搞砸了，这让我得高分的希望一下子破灭了。

senses.en: Stop showing the effects of alcohol or drugs.
senses.example: Keith SOBERED UP a bit when we left the pub and walked home.
senses.example_zh: 我们离开酒吧走回家时，基思清醒了一些。

senses.example: The bombardment SOFTENED UP their defenses; I think we can move in tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 轰炸削弱了他们的防御；我想我们明天可以推进了。

senses.en: Do things to please someone in the hope that they will do what you want.
senses.example: I paid for everything to SOFTEN them UP before they made the decision.
senses.example_zh: 我付了所有费用来讨好他们，好让他们做决定。

senses.en: Continue even when things get difficult.
senses.example: Life got hard for my dog when he went blind, but he just SOLDIERED ON and never complained.
senses.example_zh: 我的狗失明后生活变得艰难，但它只是坚持下去，从不抱怨。

senses.example: Has the firm SORTED OUT its tax problems yet?
senses.example_zh: 公司解决税务问题了吗？

senses.example: He SOUNDED OFF about the quality of the food.
senses.example_zh: 他大声抱怨食物的质量。

senses.en: Check what someone thinks about an issue, idea, etc..
senses.example: You should SOUND her OUT to get her opinion before you go ahead with the plan.
senses.example_zh: 在实施计划之前，你应该探探她的口风，听听她的意见。

senses.example: The council is SPAFFING AWAY our taxes on bonuses and consultants.
senses.example_zh: 市议会在奖金和顾问上挥霍我们的税款。

senses.en: Cause something, usually unpleasant, to happen.
senses.example: The riot was SPARKED OFF by the police raid on the club.
senses.example_zh: 这场骚乱是由警方突袭俱乐部引发的。

senses.example: They SPARKED UP in a no smoking area.
senses.example_zh: 他们在禁烟区点起了烟。

senses.example: People are afraid to SPEAK OUT in oppressive political regimes.
senses.example_zh: 在专制的政治体制下，人们不敢公开发表意见。

senses.example: They couldn't hear the speaker and asked him to SPEAK UP a bit.
senses.example_zh: 他们听不见演讲者说话，便请他大声一点。

senses.example: He won't understand you unless you SPELL everything OUT for him.
senses.example_zh: 除非你给他详细解释一切，否则他不会明白。

senses.en: Write or say the individual letters that make up a word.
senses.example: I had to SPELL my surname OUT to him as he didn't know how to spell it.
senses.example_zh: 我不得不把我的姓拼写给他听，因为他不知道如何拼写。

senses.example: The volcano is SPEWING OUT lava and hot gases.
senses.example_zh: 火山正在喷出熔岩和热气。

senses.example: He SPEWED UP when he was drunk.
senses.example_zh: 他喝醉时吐了。

senses.en: When large numbers of people leave a place at the same time.
senses.example: The crowd SPILLED OUT onto the streets after the match had ended.
senses.example_zh: 比赛结束后，人群涌到了街上。

senses.en: Come or flow out of a box, container, etc.
senses.example: The container was cracked and the chemicals SPILLED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 容器裂了，化学品洒了出来。

senses.example: I let my frustration SPILL OUT.
senses.example_zh: 我让我的沮丧情绪宣泄出来。

senses.en: When something bad has a wider impact on other people or situations.
senses.example: The protests and demonstrations have SPILLED OVER into neighbouring states.
senses.example_zh: 抗议和示威活动已经波及到了邻国。

senses.en: Flow over the edge or top of a container.
senses.example: I forgot to turn the tap off and the water SPILLED OVER.
senses.example_zh: 我忘了关水龙头，水溢出来了。

senses.example: The research SPUN OFF a number of new products as well as solving the problem.
senses.example_zh: 这项研究在解决问题的同时，还衍生出了许多新产品。

senses.en: Form a separate company from part of an existing one.
senses.example: They SPUN OFF the retail division last year.
senses.example_zh: 他们去年把零售部门分拆了出去。

senses.en: Create a TV show using characters from a popular show.
senses.example: They SPUN it OFF from the main show, but it didn't really attract many viewers.
senses.example_zh: 他们从主剧中衍生出了这部剧，但它并没有真正吸引很多观众。

senses.example: The car hit the water and SPUN OUT.
senses.example_zh: 汽车撞到水面后失控打转。

senses.en: Make something last as long as possible.
senses.example: I SPUN the work OUT to make as much money from the job as I could.
senses.example_zh: 我拖延了工作，以便从这份工作中尽可能多地赚钱。

senses.en: Remove someone secretly from a place.
senses.example: They SPIRITED her AWAY before the police arrived.
senses.example_zh: 他们在警察到来之前秘密带走了她。

senses.en: Remove someone secretly from a place.
senses.example: They SPIRITED him OFF before any trouble started.
senses.example_zh: 他们在任何麻烦开始之前秘密带走了他。

senses.en: An informal way of telling someone to say something they are unwilling to say.
senses.example: Hurry up, SPIT IT OUT! I can't wait all day for the truth.
senses.example_zh: 快点，快说！我不能整天等着听真相。

senses.example: He SPAT her name OUT when he saw her arrive.
senses.example_zh: 当他看到她到来时，他愤怒地说出了她的名字。

senses.example: Apollo 13 SPLASHED DOWN after a harrowing flight.
senses.example_zh: 阿波罗13号在经历了一次惊险的飞行后溅落在海上。

senses.en: Spend a lot of money on something that is not essential.
senses.example: We went to an expensive restaurant and SPLASHED OUT to celebrate
senses.example_zh: 我们去了一家昂贵的餐厅，挥霍了一番以庆祝。

senses.en: Spend a lot of money on something.
senses.example: I SPLASHED OUT ON a new camera.
senses.example_zh: 我挥霍买了一台新相机。

senses.example: The teacher SPLIT the class UP into groups of four.
senses.example_zh: 老师把班级分成了四人一组。

senses.example: They are always SPLITTING UP and then getting back together again.
senses.example_zh: 他们总是分手然后又复合。

senses.example: He's been SPOILING FOR an argument all day.
senses.example_zh: 他一整天都渴望吵架。

senses.example: I'll SPONGE it DOWN before putting it away.
senses.example_zh: 我会在收起来之前用海绵把它擦洗干净。

senses.en: Accept freefood and support without any shame or qualms.
senses.example: Let’s go to New York, we can always SPONGE OFF my brother there.
senses.example_zh: 我们去纽约吧，我们总是可以揩我兄弟的油。

senses.en: Accept or get money without doing any work.
senses.example: A lot of people are SPONGING ON the state by claiming benefits they're not entitled to.
senses.example_zh: 很多人通过申领他们无权享受的福利来揩国家的油。

senses.en: Return to original position after being bent, forced or when pressure is removed.
senses.example: The lock SPRINGS BACK when the key is turned.
senses.example_zh: 钥匙转动时，锁会弹回。

senses.example: She is going to SPRING FOR all their medical bills.
senses.example_zh: 她打算慷慨支付他们所有的医疗费用。

senses.example: He SPRANG FROM the bushes when I walked past.
senses.example_zh: 当我走过时，他突然从灌木丛中冒出来。

senses.example: His anger SPRINGS FROM his feelings of insecurity.
senses.example_zh: 他的愤怒源于他的不安全感。

senses.example: They SPRUNG a birthday party ON me at work.
senses.example_zh: 他们在工作中突然给我举办了一个生日派对。

senses.example: Charity shops are SPRINGING UP in the recession.
senses.example_zh: 在经济衰退期间，慈善商店如雨后春笋般涌现。

senses.en: To smarten, make something neat and tidy.
senses.example: We SPRUCED the flat UP before we put it on the market.
senses.example_zh: 我们在把公寓挂牌出售之前把它整理了一番。

senses.example: The thought of the bonus SPURRED her ON to complete the work on time.
senses.example_zh: 想到奖金，她受到激励，按时完成了工作。

senses.example: There are few things I have to SQUARE AWAY before I can leave.
senses.example_zh: 在我离开之前，还有几件事必须处理好。

senses.en: Confront someone or prepare to fight them.
senses.example: The two drunks SQUARED OFF and the barman had to intervene before a fight brokeout.
senses.example_zh: 两个醉汉摆开架势准备打架，酒保不得不在打起来之前介入。

senses.en: Confront someone or prepare to fight them.
senses.example: They SQUARED OFF AGAINST the police when they arrived.
senses.example_zh: 警察到达时，他们摆开架势准备对抗。

senses.example: Can I SQUARE UP with you for last night?
senses.example_zh: 我可以和你结清昨晚的账吗？

senses.en: Confront someone or prepare to fight them.
senses.example: The companies are SQUARING UP for a fight.
senses.example_zh: 这些公司正摆开架势准备一争高下。

senses.example: They need to SQUARE UP TO what they did wrong if we are to make any progress.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们想取得进展，他们需要正视自己犯的错误。

senses.example: What he said doesn't SQUARE WITH what the others said.
senses.example_zh: 他说的和其他人说的不一致。

senses.en: Check with someone that something is OK.
senses.example: I'll have to CHECK that WITH my boss before I can confirm it.
senses.example_zh: 在确认之前，我得先和老板核实一下。

senses.en: Get more people into a space than normal or comfortable.
senses.example: Four of us had to SQUEEZE UP in the back of the car.
senses.example_zh: 我们四个人不得不挤在汽车后座。

senses.example: I STACKED UP the boxes.
senses.example_zh: 我把箱子堆叠起来。

senses.example: Work STACKED UP while I was away on holiday.
senses.example_zh: 我外出度假期间，工作堆积了起来。

senses.example: I've been STACKING UP a lot of air miles.
senses.example_zh: 我一直在积攒大量的航空里程。

senses.example: The budget figures don't STACK UP.
senses.example_zh: 这些预算数字不合逻辑。

senses.en: Build up the number of planes waiting to land at an airport.
senses.example: Planes were STACKING UP while the airport was closed after the bomb threat.
senses.example_zh: 机场因炸弹威胁关闭期间，飞机在空中盘旋等待降落。

senses.example: The new model doesn't STACK UP AGAINST the old one.
senses.example_zh: 新型号比不上旧型号。

senses.example: They haven't STAFFED the project UP yet.
senses.example_zh: 他们还没有为这个项目配备人员。

senses.example: The government has started a campaign to STAMP OUT drugs in schools.
senses.example_zh: 政府发起了一场运动，旨在根除校园毒品。

senses.en: Spend time in a place waiting or doing nothing or very little.
senses.example: We STOOD ABOUT drinking coffee before the lecture.
senses.example_zh: 讲座开始前，我们闲站着喝咖啡。

senses.en: Spend time in a place waiting or doing nothing or very little.
senses.example: We STOOD AROUND for an hour waiting for them to turn up.
senses.example_zh: 我们闲站了一个小时，等他们出现。

senses.en: Leave a position so that someone else can take it.
senses.example: The prime minister should STAND ASIDE and let a new leader head the party.
senses.example_zh: 首相应该让位，让新领导人来领导该党。

senses.example: We STOOD BACK while he lit the firework.
senses.example_zh: 他点烟花时，我们退后了。

senses.en: Try to understand something by taking a different perspective.
senses.example: We need to STAND BACK and look at the problem differently.
senses.zh: 退一步思考，从不同角度看待
senses.example_zh: 我们需要退一步，从不同角度看待这个问题。

senses.example: He STOOD BY her throughout the trial as he believed her to be innocent.
senses.example_zh: 整个审判过程中他都支持她，因为他相信她是无辜的。

senses.en: Be ready and waiting for something to happen.
senses.example: The emergency services were STANDING BY waiting for the plane to land.
senses.example_zh: 紧急服务部门待命，等待飞机降落。

senses.en: Leave a job or position so that someone else can take it.
senses.example: The minister announced her intention to STAND DOWN at the next election.
senses.example_zh: 部长宣布她打算在下届选举时辞职。

senses.en: Finish being asked questions in a court.
senses.example: The judge told the witness to STAND DOWN after the questioning.
senses.example_zh: 法官在询问结束后让证人退庭。

senses.example: I'm not going to STAND FOR their rudeness any longer.
senses.example_zh: 我再也不会容忍他们的粗鲁了。

senses.en: The words represented by certain initials.
senses.example: 'WHAT do the letters BBC STAND FOR? ' 'British Broadcasting Corporation.'
senses.example_zh: “BBC 这几个字母代表什么？”“英国广播公司。”

senses.example: She had to STAND IN FOR the editor while he was on holiday.
senses.example_zh: 编辑休假时，她不得不临时替代他。

senses.example: She STOOD OUT from the crowd in selection and was offered the job.
senses.example_zh: 她在选拔中脱颖而出，得到了那份工作。

senses.en: Move from a sitting or lying down to a vertical position.
senses.example: Everybody STOOD UP when the judge entered the court.
senses.example_zh: 法官进入法庭时，所有人都站了起来。

senses.example: He agreed to meet me last night, but he STOOD me UP.
senses.example_zh: 他答应昨晚和我见面，但他放了我鸽子。

senses.example: He's the kind of manager who will always STAND UP FOR his staff.
senses.example_zh: 他是那种总是会支持自己员工的经理。

senses.en: Keep your principles when challenged by an authority.
senses.example: She STOOD UP TO the police when they tried to corrupt her.
senses.example_zh: 当警察试图贿赂她时，她勇敢地抵抗了。

senses.example: This coat will STAND UP TO the roughest weather conditions.
senses.example_zh: 这件外套经得起最恶劣的天气条件。

senses.en: Look at someone until they cannot look at you.
senses.example: He was angry but I STARED him DOWN and he left without saying much.
senses.example_zh: 他很生气，但我盯得他不敢对视，他没说什么就走了。

senses.example: They STARTED OFF the meeting an attack on our performance.
senses.example_zh: 他们以对我们表现的攻击开始了会议。

senses.en: Begin life, a career or existence.
senses.example: She STARTED OFF as a receptionist and ended up as the CEO.
senses.example_zh: 她最初是一名接待员，最终成为了首席执行官。

senses.example: We STARTED OFF early because we knew the journey would take all day.
senses.example_zh: 我们很早就出发了，因为知道旅程会花一整天。

senses.example: I was trying to be serious, but their comment STARTED me OFF.
senses.example_zh: 我试图严肃，但他们的话让我笑了起来。

senses.en: Help someone to start a piece or work or activity.
senses.example: I STARTED her OFF ON the project then left her to finish it.
senses.example_zh: 我帮她开始了这个项目，然后让她自己完成。

senses.example: It's time to START ON that bottle of wine.
senses.example_zh: 是时候开始喝那瓶酒了。

senses.example: The manager was furious and STARTED ON her staff for not trying hard enough.
senses.example_zh: 经理非常愤怒，斥责员工不够努力。

senses.example: He STARTED ON AT me for being late.
senses.example_zh: 他因为我迟到而指责我。

senses.example: We STARTED OUT early in the morning.
senses.example_zh: 我们一大早就出发了。

senses.en: Begin life, existence or a career.
senses.example: What had STARTED OUT AS a protest quickly turned into a full-blown rebellion.
senses.example_zh: 起初只是一场抗议，很快演变成了一场全面的叛乱。

senses.example: I didn't START OUT TO become the boss-it just happened.
senses.example_zh: 我并没有打算成为老板——只是顺其自然。

senses.example: It's a mess-I think we should just START OVER.
senses.example_zh: 一团糟——我想我们应该重新开始。

senses.example: The firm STARTED UP on a shoestring budget.
senses.example_zh: 这家公司以极少的预算起家。

senses.example: There was a pause, then the noise STARTED UP again.
senses.example_zh: 停顿了一下，然后噪音又开始了。

senses.example: The car STARTED UP first time.
senses.example_zh: 汽车第一次就启动了。

senses.example: I STARTED the car UP.
senses.example_zh: 我发动了汽车。

senses.en: Sit or stand upright because someone has surprised you.
senses.example: He STARTED UP when I entered the room and tried to hide what he was doing.
senses.example_zh: 我进屋时他惊得站了起来，试图藏起他正在做的事。

senses.en: Store or hide something in a safe place.
senses.example: I STASHED some money AWAY behind some books.
senses.example_zh: 我把一些钱藏在了书后面。

senses.example: The police STOVE the front door IN and arrested them.
senses.example_zh: 警察破门而入，逮捕了他们。

senses.example: The medicine STAVED OFF the worst of the disease.
senses.example_zh: 药物延缓了疾病最严重的发作。

senses.example: He said he didn't like them coming and wanted them to STAY AWAY.
senses.example_zh: 他说他不喜欢他们来，希望他们离远点。

senses.example: He told them to STAYAWAY FROM him.
senses.example_zh: 他告诉他们离他远点。

senses.example: I'm going to STAY IN and chill tonight; I can't be bothered to go out.
senses.example_zh: 今晚我要待在家里放松；我懒得出去。

senses.example: She STAYED ON after she graduated to do a Master's degree.
senses.example_zh: 她毕业后继续留下来攻读硕士学位。

senses.example: We STAYED OUT all night.
senses.example_zh: 我们在外面待了一整夜。

senses.example: I STAYED OVER at a friend's house last night because of the train strike.
senses.example_zh: 因为火车罢工，我昨晚在朋友家过夜。

senses.example: The children STAYED UP until way past their bedtime.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们熬夜到远远超过就寝时间。

senses.en: Leave a place quietly or secretly.
senses.example: We didn't want to wake them, so we STOLE AWAY in the middle of the night.
senses.example_zh: 我们不想吵醒他们，所以半夜悄悄离开了。

senses.en: Leave in a stealthy or quiet manner.
senses.example: Not wanting to attract attention, she STOLE OUT early.
senses.example_zh: 不想引起注意，她早早地悄悄出去了。

senses.en: Be gradually overcome by an emotion or feeling.
senses.example: A feeling of pride STOLE OVER me as I watched.
senses.example_zh: 我看着时，一种自豪感渐渐涌上心头。

senses.example: The lights were off and everything was quiet so we STOLE UP as quietly as we could.
senses.example_zh: 灯关着，一切都很安静，所以我们尽可能悄悄地靠近。

senses.en: Approach a place or someone quietly or secretly.
senses.example: We STOLE UP ON them so that they couldn't sound the alarm.
senses.example_zh: 我们悄悄接近他们，这样他们就不能发出警报了。

senses.example: He's trying to STEER CLEAR OF his lecturer because he hasn't finished his assignment yet.
senses.example_zh: 他试图避开他的讲师，因为他还没完成作业。

senses.example: The trouble STEMS FROM their refusal to discuss the matter.
senses.example_zh: 麻烦源于他们拒绝讨论此事。

senses.en: Leave a job or position so that someone else can take over.
senses.example: Everyone thinks that the prime minister should STEP ASIDE so that someone new can lead the party into the election.
senses.example_zh: 大家都认为首相应该让位，以便新人能带领党参加选举。

senses.en: Look at something from a different perspective.
senses.example: We should STEP BACK and try to see how our customers will view the scheme.
senses.zh: 退一步思考，从不同角度看待
senses.example_zh: 我们应该退一步，试着看看顾客会如何看待这个方案。

senses.en: Leave a job or position so that someone can take over.
senses.example: The CEO STEPPED DOWN after the share price dropped.
senses.example_zh: 股价下跌后，首席执行官辞职了。

senses.example: Production is being STEPPED DOWN because demand has dropped.
senses.example_zh: 由于需求下降，生产正在减少。

senses.example: When I had the accident, a lot of people STEPPED FORWARD to help me.
senses.example_zh: 我出事故时，很多人主动站出来帮助我。

senses.example: I had to STEP IN when they started fighting.
senses.example_zh: 他们开始打架时，我不得不介入。

senses.en: An imperative used to tell someone to go faster, especially when driving.
senses.example: I told the taxi driver to STEP ON IT as I was late for the meeting.
senses.example_zh: 我告诉出租车司机开快点，因为我开会要迟到了。

senses.en: Leave a place for a very short time.
senses.example: They've STEPPED OUT for a cigarette.
senses.example_zh: 他们出去抽根烟。

senses.example: Don't STEP TO those guys; they'll kill you.
senses.example_zh: 别去挑衅那些家伙，他们会杀了你。

senses.example: He tried to STEP TO her in the bar.
senses.example_zh: 他试图在酒吧里和她搭讪。

senses.example: The police have STEPPED UP the pressure on beggars working the Underground.
senses.example_zh: 警方加大了对在地铁里乞讨者的压力。

senses.en: Stay in a place for some time.
senses.example: He's late, but I'll STICK AROUND for another few minutes before I leave.
senses.example_zh: 他迟到了，但我会再等几分钟再走。

senses.example: She found the course very tough but she STUCK AT it and did well in the end.
senses.example_zh: 她觉得这门课程很难，但她坚持了下来，最终取得了好成绩。

senses.en: Support someone when they are having difficulties.
senses.example: No one STUCK BY him when the scandal became public.
senses.example_zh: 丑闻公开后，没有人支持他。

senses.en: Support a plan, opinion or decision.
senses.example: They are STICKING BYtheir claims.
senses.example_zh: 他们坚持自己的说法。

senses.en: Write something quickly or without thinking about it.
senses.example: I couldn't answer the test so I just STUCK anything DOWN that I could remember.
senses.example_zh: 我答不出试卷，就匆匆写下了我能记住的任何东西。

senses.example: I STUCK the label DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 我把标签贴上了。

senses.example: She STUCK IT TO me for turning up half an hour late.
senses.example_zh: 她因为我迟到半小时而指责我。

senses.example: My boss always STICKS IT TO me when she's in a bad mood.
senses.example_zh: 我老板心情不好时总是苛待我。

senses.example: He's so much better than the others that he STICKS OUT.
senses.example_zh: 他比其他人优秀得多，所以很突出。

senses.example: He STUCK his tongue OUT at me.
senses.example_zh: 他向我吐舌头。

senses.en: Continue doing something difficult or unpleasant.
senses.example: I STUCK it OUT even though I hated every minute of it.
senses.example_zh: 尽管我每一分钟都讨厌，但我还是坚持到底了。

senses.example: We're STICKING OUT FOR a 5% increase.
senses.example_zh: 我们坚持要求加薪5%。

senses.example: The Prime Minister decided to STICK TO the original plan despite the criticism in the media.
senses.example_zh: 尽管媒体批评，首相还是决定坚持原计划。

senses.en: Restrict or limit and not change.
senses.example: I STUCK TO the path and didn't take the shortcut.
senses.example_zh: 我沿着小路走，没有抄近道。

senses.example: If we don't STICK TOGETHER, things will be much worse for all of us-we need some unity.
senses.example_zh: 如果我们不团结一致，情况对我们所有人来说都会糟糕得多——我们需要团结。

senses.example: The static electricity made my hair STICK UP.
senses.example_zh: 静电使我的头发竖了起来。

senses.example: They STUCK the bank UP and stole tens of thousands.
senses.example_zh: 他们持械抢劫了银行，偷走了数万英镑。

senses.example: You have to STICK UP FOR yourself here, because no one will back you.
senses.example_zh: 在这里你必须捍卫自己，因为没有人会支持你。

senses.example: We'd better STICK WITH our original idea.
senses.example_zh: 我们最好坚持原来的想法。

senses.example: He told the children to STICK WITH him in the station.
senses.example_zh: 他告诉孩子们在车站要跟着他。

senses.example: The details have STUCK WITH me ever since.
senses.example_zh: 从那以后，这些细节一直萦绕在我心头。

senses.en: Continue with something difficult or unpleasant.
senses.example: I STUCK WITH the job though I found it very stressful.
senses.example_zh: 尽管我觉得工作压力很大，但我还是坚持做了下去。

senses.example: My back STIFFENS UP in cold weather.
senses.example_zh: 我的背在寒冷天气里会变僵硬。

senses.example: They used starch to STIFFEN the collars UP.
senses.example_zh: 他们用淀粉使衣领变硬。

senses.example: He STIRRED things UP by complaining to senior management about his line manager.
senses.example_zh: 他向高级管理层抱怨他的直线经理，从而挑起了事端。

senses.en: Sew something so that it is closed.
senses.example: I STITCHED UP the hole in my sleeve.
senses.example_zh: 我把袖子上的洞缝好了。

senses.example: We get the contract STITCHED UP this week.
senses.example_zh: 我们这周把合同敲定了。

senses.en: Cheat someone or make them look guilty when they aren't.
senses.example: The police STITCHED them UP because they couldn't find any evidence against them.
senses.example_zh: 警方陷害了他们，因为找不到任何不利于他们的证据。

senses.example: He lost his temper and STOMPED OFF home.
senses.example_zh: 他发了脾气，气冲冲地回家去了。

senses.example: They STOMP ON their competitors.
senses.example_zh: 他们粗暴地对待竞争对手。

senses.en: Visit someone for a short time..
senses.example: Why don't you STOP AROUND my place on your way back?
senses.example_zh: 你回来的时候为什么不来我这儿坐坐？

senses.example: I'll STOP BACK this afternoon when you're free.
senses.example_zh: 今天下午你有空的时候我会再过来。

senses.en: Stay somewhere when other people leave.
senses.example: I STOPPED BEHIND at the end of the lecture to ask a couple of questions.
senses.example_zh: 讲座结束后我留了下来，问了几个问题。

senses.example: I must STOP BY the supermarket and pick up some things for dinner.
senses.example_zh: 我必须顺便去趟超市，买些晚饭用的东西。

senses.example: I was feeling tired so I STOPPED IN last night.
senses.example_zh: 我觉得累了，所以昨晚待在家里。

senses.example: I STOPPED IN at my aunt's after work.
senses.example_zh: 下班后我顺便去了姑姑家。

senses.example: We STOPPED OFF for lunch about halfway there, then carried on driving.
senses.example_zh: 我们在途中停下来吃了午饭，然后继续开车。

senses.en: Be out late, especially when you are expected home.
senses.example: Her parents were annoyed because she STOPPED OUT all night.
senses.example_zh: 她父母很生气，因为她在外面待了一整夜。

senses.en: Stay somewhere when on a journey.
senses.example: I STOPPED OVER in Bangkok for a couple of days on my way back from Tokyo.
senses.example_zh: 从东京回来的路上，我在曼谷停留了几天。

senses.example: I STOPPED UP last night watching the film.
senses.example_zh: 昨晚我看电影熬夜了。

senses.example: I STOPPED UP the bottle with a cork.
senses.example_zh: 我用软木塞堵住了瓶子。

senses.example: They had a row and he STORMED OFF.
senses.example_zh: 他们吵了一架，他气冲冲地走了。

senses.example: He lost his temper and STORMED OUT OF the bar. (If you don't mention the place, you can just say 'He stormed out')
senses.example_zh: 他发了脾气，气冲冲地离开了酒吧。

senses.en: Hide in a vehicle to travel without people knowing.
senses.example: She STOWED AWAY on the plane but was caught when it landed.
senses.example_zh: 她偷乘飞机，但飞机降落时被抓住了。

senses.en: Store something in a safe place.
senses.example: We STOWED it AWAY in the garage to keep it dry.
senses.example_zh: 我们把它存放在车库里，以防受潮。

senses.example: I'm always having to STRAIGHTEN OUT the wires connected to my computer.
senses.example_zh: 我总是得把连接电脑的电线弄直。

senses.example: I had to STRAIGHTEN OUT things after the mess they had made.
senses.example_zh: 他们搞得一团糟之后，我不得不处理这些事情。

senses.example: There are a few issues I'd like to STRAIGHTEN OUT first.
senses.example_zh: 有几个问题我想先澄清一下。

senses.example: Starting work has STRAIGHTENED him OUT and calmed him down.
senses.example_zh: 开始工作使他改邪归正，冷静了下来。

senses.example: She STRAIGHTENED UP when her boss walked in.
senses.example_zh: 老板走进来时，她站直了身子。

senses.example: I STRAIGHTENED UP the room before they arrived.
senses.example_zh: 他们到来之前，我收拾了一下房间。

senses.en: Attack, take action against someone who has hurt you.
senses.example: At first, he ignored them, but when things got very serious, he STRUCK BACK.
senses.example_zh: 起初他无视他们，但当事情变得非常严重时，他进行了反击。

senses.example: A hitman STRUCK him DOWN as he entered the building.(This verb is often used in the passive-He was struck down as he entered the building.)
senses.example_zh: 他进入大楼时，一个杀手把他打死了。

senses.example: I was STRUCK DOWN with food poisoning.(This verb is mostly used in the passive.)
senses.example_zh: 我因食物中毒病倒了。

senses.example: The Appeal Court STRUCK DOWN the lower court's ruling.
senses.example_zh: 上诉法院废除了下级法院的裁决。

senses.en: Remove someone's professional licence to practise.
senses.example: The Medical Council STRUCK him OFF for malpractice.
senses.example_zh: 医疗委员会因他渎职而吊销了他的行医执照。

senses.example: I STRUCK ON the solution when I was out with my dog.
senses.example_zh: 我遛狗时突然想到了解决办法。

senses.en: Start doing something new and different.
senses.example: After doing the same job for five years, I decided to STRIKE OUT and change careers.
senses.example_zh: 做了五年同样的工作后，我决定开始新的尝试，改变职业。

senses.example: When he pushed me, I STRUCK OUT.
senses.example_zh: 他推我时，我挥拳打了过去。

senses.example: We got up early and STRUCK OUT for our final destination.
senses.example_zh: 我们早早起床，朝最终目的地出发。

senses.example: As they arrived, I STRUCK their names OUT on the list I had.
senses.example_zh: 他们到达时，我在名单上划掉了他们的名字。

senses.example: I tried to get the government to support us but I STRUCK OUT.
senses.example_zh: 我试图让政府支持我们，但失败了。

senses.example: He STRUCK UP a conversation with me in the bar.
senses.example_zh: 他在酒吧里和我搭讪起来。

senses.example: The band STRUCK UP and everyone turned to listen.
senses.example_zh: 乐队开始演奏，大家都转过头来听。

senses.example: It took us a long time to STRIKE UPON a solution.
senses.example_zh: 我们花了很长时间才突然想到一个解决办法。

senses.example: They kept saying they were interested, but they were just STRINGING me ALONG
senses.example_zh: 他们一直说感兴趣，但只是在骗我。

senses.en: Accompany someone because you haven't got anything better to do.
senses.example: Is it alright if I STRING ALONG with you tonight?
senses.example_zh: 今晚我跟着你一起去，好吗？

senses.en: Make something last as long as possible.
senses.example: There was half an hour to go, so I STRUNG the questions OUT as long as I could.
senses.example_zh: 还剩半小时，所以我把问题尽量拖长。

senses.en: Put words together into a coherent text.
senses.example: I was so nervous in the interview that I could hardly STRING a sentence TOGETHER.
senses.example_zh: 面试时我太紧张了，几乎连一句话都说不连贯。

senses.example: The rebels STRUNG the soldiers UP after they captured them.
senses.example_zh: 叛军俘虏士兵后把他们绞死了。

senses.example: He STUBBED his cigarette OUT in a saucer because he couldn't find an ashtray.
senses.example_zh: 他把香烟在碟子里掐灭，因为找不到烟灰缸。

senses.en: Make a mistake, do badly, spoil.
senses.example: I STUFFED the exam UP.
senses.example_zh: 我把考试考砸了。

senses.example: You'll never guess what I STUMBLED ACROSS when I was packing my stuff.
senses.example_zh: 你绝对猜不到我收拾东西时偶然发现了什么。

senses.example: I STUMBLED UPON these photos when I was clearing my room up.
senses.example_zh: 我打扫房间时偶然发现了这些照片。

senses.example: He didn't want to pay me back, but I got him to STUMP UP in the end.
senses.example_zh: 他不想还我钱，但最后我还是让他掏了腰包。

senses.example: Everyone around her was taking drugs and she got SUCKED IN.
senses.example_zh: 她周围所有人都在吸毒，她也被卷了进去。

senses.example: The country got SUCKED INTO the war.
senses.example_zh: 这个国家被卷入了战争。

senses.example: He is always SUCKING UP to try to get the boss's approval.
senses.example_zh: 他总是拍马屁，想得到老板的认可。

senses.example: He's always SUCKING UP TO our boss.
senses.example_zh: 他总是巴结我们的老板。

senses.en: Get dressed or put on a uniform for an activity or task.
senses.example: They SUITED UP and went to the interview
senses.example_zh: 他们穿上正装去参加面试。

senses.example: At the end of the lecture, she SUMMED UP the main points again.
senses.example_zh: 讲座结束时，她又总结了一遍要点。

senses.en: Get the energy or courage to do something.
senses.example: Andrea couldn't SUMMON UP the enthusiasm to apply for the position.
senses.example_zh: 安德烈娅鼓不起劲去申请那个职位。

senses.example: It took her ages to SUSS OUT what was going on.
senses.example_zh: 她花了很长时间才弄明白发生了什么事。

senses.en: Move in a dramatic or affected manner.
senses.example: He SWANNED ABOUT at the party.
senses.example_zh: 他在派对上招摇地走来走去。

senses.en: Move in a dramatic or affected manner.
senses.example: She SWANNED AROUND trying to impress people.
senses.example_zh: 她招摇地走来走去，想给人留下印象。

senses.en: Enter in a dramatic or attention-seeking manner.
senses.example: He SWANNED IN surrounded by photographers.
senses.example_zh: 他在摄影师的簇拥下招摇地走了进来。

senses.en: Leave somewhere in a defiant or pompous manner.
senses.example: He didn't like the way the spoke to him so he SWANNED OFF angrily.
senses.example_zh: 他不喜欢对方跟他说话的方式，就气冲冲地扬长而去。

senses.example: I SWEAR BYtheir products-they're the best on the market.
senses.example_zh: 我非常信赖他们的产品——它们是市场上最好的。

senses.example: He SWORE DOWN that he hadn't done it.
senses.example_zh: 他发誓说他没有做那件事。

senses.example: She SWEPT THROUGH the exams.
senses.example_zh: 她轻松通过了考试。

senses.example: The disease SWEPT THROUGH the population.
senses.example_zh: 疾病迅速在人群中蔓延。

senses.example: They SWUNG AROUND to our idea after reading the press reports.
senses.example_zh: 看了新闻报道后，他们迅速转而支持我们的想法。

senses.example: He SWUNG ROUND to see what had made the noise.
senses.example_zh: 他迅速转过身去看是什么发出了声响。

senses.example: He SWUNG AT me but missed.
senses.example_zh: 他挥拳打我，但没打中。

senses.en: Visit a person or place on your way somewhere.
senses.example: I will SWING BY this afternoon and pick you up.
senses.example_zh: 我今天下午会顺路过去接你。

senses.example: They were against it at first then SWUNG ROUND and supported it.
senses.example_zh: 他们起初反对，但后来改变了主意并支持它。

senses.example: She SWUNG ROUND and greeted them.
senses.example_zh: 她迅速转过身来迎接他们。

senses.en: Take business, support or votes from someone.
senses.example: The candidate SYPHONED OFF a lot of votes because of his anti-war stance.
senses.example_zh: 这位候选人因其反战立场而抽走了大量选票。

senses.example: The minister had been SYPHONING OFF funds from his department for years.
senses.example_zh: 这位部长多年来一直挪用部门的资金。

senses.example: They TACKED ON a new ending to the film when they found that test audiences didn't like the original.
senses.example_zh: 当发现试映观众不喜欢原版结局时，他们给电影附加了一个新结局。

senses.en: Add or attach something that wasn't planned to something.
senses.example: I TACKED a quick message ONTO the end of the letter after I'd printed it.
senses.example_zh: 信打印出来后，我在末尾附加了一条简短留言。

senses.en: Accompany someone, especially if they haven't specifically invited you.
senses.example: You're off to the cinema; can we TAG ALONG?
senses.example_zh: 你们要去电影院；我们能跟着去吗？

senses.en: Add an additional point to something written or spoken.
senses.example: He TAGGED ON a few comments after reading my report.
senses.example_zh: 他看了我的报告后补充了几条评论。

senses.en: Add an additional point to something written or spoken.
senses.example: He TAGGED his ideas ONTO the end of my report.
senses.example_zh: 他把自己的想法附加到了我的报告末尾。

senses.en: Add a keyword link or bookmark to a blog entry or webpage.
senses.example: The post was TAGGED WITH keywords.
senses.example_zh: 这篇帖子被添加了关键词标签。

senses.example: His voice TAILED AWAY when he was speaking about what he'd done wrong.
senses.example_zh: 当谈到自己做的错事时，他的声音逐渐消失了。

senses.example: The traffic TAILED BACK for several miles after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 事故发生后，交通拥堵绵延数英里。

senses.example: The voices TAILED OFF when she entered.
senses.example_zh: 她进来时，说话声逐渐消失了。

senses.example: Profits TAILED OFF sharply in the last quarter of the year as a result of the increase in the price of oil.
senses.example_zh: 由于油价上涨，去年最后一个季度的利润急剧下降。

senses.example: He TAKES AFTER his mother.
senses.example_zh: 他长得像他母亲。

senses.example: She TOOK thephotocopier APART to see what had got stuck in it.
senses.example_zh: 她把复印机拆开，看看里面卡了什么。

senses.en: Get someone alone to talk to them.
senses.example: The teacher TOOK her ASIDE and said that she'd failed the exam.
senses.example_zh: 老师把她拉到一边，告诉她考试没及格。

senses.example: The police TOOK the protestors AWAY.
senses.example_zh: 警察带走了抗议者。

senses.example: That song always TAKES me BACK to when I was at university.
senses.example_zh: 那首歌总是让我回忆起大学时光。

senses.en: Retract a statement, admit that something was wrong.
senses.example: I had to TAKE BACK everything bad I'd said about them when I learned how they'd helped out.
senses.example_zh: 当我得知他们如何帮忙后，我不得不收回所有说过的坏话。

senses.en: Make notes or write down in full.
senses.example: The police TOOK DOWN his answers to their questions.
senses.example_zh: 警察记录了他对问题的回答。

senses.example: People TAKE DOWN their Christmas decorations twelve days after Christmas.
senses.example_zh: 人们在圣诞节后十二天取下圣诞装饰。

senses.example: The lecture was rather boring and I didn't TAKE IN much of what the lecturer said.
senses.example_zh: 讲座相当无聊，我没理解多少讲师讲的内容。

senses.example: She TOOK me IN her story until someone told me the truth.
senses.example_zh: 她编的故事骗了我，直到有人告诉我真相。

senses.example: The jacket was far too big around the shoulders, so I had it TAKEN IN so that I could wear it.
senses.example_zh: 这件夹克肩部太宽了，所以我让人改小以便能穿。

senses.example: The family TOOK IN the three homeless kittens.
senses.example_zh: 这家人收留了三只无家可归的小猫。

senses.example: He's good at criticising others, but can't TAKE IT himself.
senses.example_zh: 他善于批评别人，但自己却承受不了批评。

senses.example: Whenever things go wrong, he always shouts and TAKES IT OUT ON me, even if I had nothing to do with the problem.
senses.example_zh: 每当事情出错，他总是对我大喊大叫，把气撒在我身上，即使我与问题无关。

senses.en: Take responsibility, often without consulting other people.
senses.example: I TOOK IT UPON MYSELF to make sure he got up on time.
senses.example_zh: 我擅自承担起确保他准时起床的责任。

senses.example: The software house really TOOK OFF when they produced thelatest version of their DTP package.
senses.example_zh: 这家软件公司推出最新版桌面出版软件后真的迅速发展起来。

senses.en: Reduce the price of an item.
senses.example: They've TAKEN ten percent OFF designer frames for glasses.
senses.example_zh: 他们给设计师眼镜框降价了百分之十。

senses.en: When a plane departs or leaves the ground.
senses.example: The flight for Dublin TOOK OFF on time.
senses.example_zh: 飞往都柏林的航班准时起飞了。

senses.example: It was hot, so I TOOK my jacket OFF.
senses.example_zh: 天气很热，所以我脱掉了夹克。

senses.en: Allow passengers on a ship or plane.
senses.example: The plane stopped at Zurich to TAKE ON some passengers.
senses.example_zh: 飞机在苏黎世停下来让一些乘客登机。

senses.example: She TOOK ON the task of indexing the book.
senses.example_zh: 她承担了为这本书编索引的任务。

senses.example: The council has had to TAKE ON twenty extra employees to handle their increased workload.
senses.example_zh: 委员会不得不额外雇用二十名员工来应对增加的工作量。

senses.example: I TOOK OUT all the books I needed for my essay from the library.
senses.example_zh: 我从图书馆借出了写论文所需的所有书。

senses.en: Borrow money from a bank or other official lender.
senses.example: Jackie and Anil TOOK OUT a mortgage to buy a bigger flat.
senses.example_zh: 杰基和阿尼尔贷款买了一套更大的公寓。

senses.example: The dentist TOOK OUT all of my wisdom teeth before they started causing any problems.
senses.example_zh: 牙医在我所有智齿开始引起问题之前把它们拔掉了。

senses.en: Go out socially with someone, especially a date.
senses.example: He TOOK her OUT to a restaurant last Friday night.
senses.example_zh: 上周五晚上他带她去了一家餐厅。

senses.example: I TOOK OUT some health insurance before I went backpacking around Latin America.
senses.example_zh: 我去拉丁美洲背包旅行前购买了一些健康保险。

senses.example: The gang TOOK him OUT after he spoke to the police.
senses.example_zh: 他向警方告密后，黑帮把他干掉了。

senses.en: Assume control of a company or organisation.
senses.example: The bank was TAKEN OVER bya Hong Kong bank that needed to buy a bank to get into the British market.
senses.example_zh: 这家银行被一家需要收购银行以进入英国市场的香港银行接管了。

senses.en: Start a job or position that someone had occupied before you.
senses.example: She TOOK OVER responsibility for the project last month.
senses.example_zh: 她上个月接手了这个项目的负责工作。

senses.example: He TOOKme THROUGH the procedures before we started.
senses.example_zh: 在我们开始之前，他带我详细了解了流程。

senses.example: He's TAKEN TO wearing a baseball cap since his hair started thinning more noticeably.
senses.example_zh: 自从头发明显变稀疏后，他就养成了戴棒球帽的习惯。

senses.en: Fill or occupy time or space.
senses.example: An awful lot of my time at work is TAKEN UP with pointless bureaucracy nowadays.
senses.example_zh: 如今，我工作中大量时间都被毫无意义的官僚事务占用了。

senses.example: The trousers were too long so I TOOK them UP to make them fit.
senses.example_zh: 裤子太长了，所以我把它改短了以合身。

senses.en: Start a new hobby, pastime, etc..
senses.example: He TOOK UP squash as he felt he had to lose some weight.
senses.example_zh: 他开始打壁球，因为他觉得必须减减肥了。

senses.example: He TALKED them AROUND to accepting his point of view.
senses.example_zh: 他说服他们接受了他的观点。

senses.en: Talk about a problem or issue without really dealing with it.
senses.example: They TALKED AROUND the issue without reaching a conclusion.
senses.example_zh: 他们绕来绕去地谈这个问题，但没有得出结论。

senses.en: Talk to someone and not give them a chance to reply or listen to them.
senses.example: There's no point trying to convince them-they'll just TALK AT you until you give up.
senses.example_zh: 试图说服他们是没用的——他们只会对你喋喋不休，直到你放弃。

senses.en: Respond rudely to a person in authority.
senses.example: The teacher was cross because the pupil TALKED BACK to her.
senses.example_zh: 老师很生气，因为那个学生跟她顶嘴。

senses.en: Try to make something sound less important.
senses.example: The company CEO TALKED DOWN the recent fall in shares.
senses.example_zh: 公司首席执行官对最近股价下跌轻描淡写。

senses.en: Persuade someone not to jump off a high place to kill themselves.
senses.example: A man was threatening to jump off the building but the police TALKED him DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 一名男子威胁要从楼上跳下，但警察劝他下来了。

senses.en: Talk in a way to show your superiority not communicate.
senses.example: She's a dreadful teacher and TALKS DOWN TO her students instead of teaching them.
senses.example_zh: 她是个糟糕的老师，总是居高临下地对学生说话，而不是教导他们。

senses.example: She didn't want to let me go, but I finally managed to TALK her INTO it.
senses.example_zh: 她不想让我去，但我最终说服了她。

senses.en: Discuss a problem or issue to find a solution.
senses.example: They had a meeting to TALK OUT how people felt.
senses.example_zh: 他们开了个会，讨论大家的感受以找到解决办法。

senses.en: Persuade someone not to do something.
senses.example: He was going to drive home after drinking half a bottle of wine, but his friends TALKED him OUT OF it.
senses.example_zh: 他喝了半瓶酒后打算开车回家，但朋友们说服他放弃了。

senses.example: We TALKED OVER the problems in our relationship, but couldn't sort things out.
senses.example_zh: 我们讨论了关系中的问题，但没能解决。

senses.example: She TALKED them AROUND to accepting her point of view.
senses.example_zh: 她说服他们接受了她的观点。

senses.en: Talk about a problem or issue without really dealing with it.
senses.example: WE TALKED ROUND the issue but didn't reach a conclusion.
senses.example_zh: 我们绕来绕去地谈这个问题，但没有得出结论。

senses.example: The teacher TALKED me THROUGH the test so I knew what to expect.
senses.example_zh: 老师详细指导我如何应对考试，所以我知道会考什么。

senses.en: Make something appear more important or significant than it really is.
senses.example: The government are trying to TALK UP the effect of their policies.
senses.example_zh: 政府试图夸大其政策的效果。

senses.en: Talk until you have nothing left to say.
senses.example: He TALKED himself OUT after a couple of hours and calmed down.
senses.example_zh: 他讲了几个小时，直到无话可说，然后平静了下来。

senses.example: I TAPPED him FOR a loan.
senses.example_zh: 我向他借了一笔钱。

senses.en: Use or exploit a plentiful resource for your benefit.
senses.example: The company is hoping to TAP INTO the Chinese market.
senses.example_zh: 该公司希望打入中国市场。

senses.example: He TAPPED OFF WITH someone at the party on Saturday.
senses.example_zh: 他在周六的派对上和某人发生了性关系。

senses.example: He TAPPED OUT the tune with his pencil while he was thinking.
senses.example_zh: 他思考时用铅笔轻轻敲出曲调。

senses.example: How can we buy a new house without TAPPING OUT our savings account.
senses.example_zh: 我们怎么能在不耗尽储蓄账户的情况下买新房子呢？

senses.en: Approach a footballer illegally to get them to change teams.
senses.example: Chelsea were accused of TAPPING him UP even though he was under contract.
senses.example_zh: 切尔西被指控违规接触他，尽管他还有合同在身。

senses.en: Work with someone or a group to achieve something.
senses.example: They TEAMED UP to publicise the issue.
senses.example_zh: 他们合作宣传这个问题。

senses.example: People were TORN APART when news of the train crash came through.
senses.example_zh: 火车相撞的消息传来时，人们都悲痛欲绝。

senses.en: Pull or try to pull something to pieces.
senses.example: The fighters TORE ATeach other.
senses.example_zh: 斗士们互相撕扯。

senses.example: I had to TEAR him AWAY from the office for dinner.
senses.example_zh: 我不得不把他从办公室拉出来去吃饭。

senses.example: The roof was TORN AWAY in the hurricane.
senses.example_zh: 屋顶在飓风中被扯掉了。

senses.example: The estate was TORN DOWN so that theycould develop the land into luxury flats.
senses.example_zh: 那片住宅区被拆除了，以便他们能将土地开发成豪华公寓。

senses.example: She TORE INTO me for losing it.
senses.example_zh: 她因为我弄丢了东西而严厉斥责我。

senses.en: Remove part of a form or letter using your hands, not scissors.
senses.example: She TORE the slip OFF the bottom of the form and sent it with her cheque.
senses.example_zh: 她撕下表格底部的纸条，连同支票一起寄了出去。

senses.example: The police TORE OFF in their car after arresting her.
senses.example_zh: 警察逮捕她后，开车迅速离开了。

senses.example: The storm TORE the roof OFF.
senses.example_zh: 暴风雨把屋顶扯掉了。

senses.example: The sheriff TORE OUT after the escaping criminals.
senses.example_zh: 治安官迅速追了出去，追赶逃跑的罪犯。

senses.example: He TORE the fax UP and threw the bits of paper in the bin.
senses.example_zh: 他把传真撕碎，把纸片扔进了垃圾桶。

senses.example: They are TEARING UP the old part of town to build a new shopping centre.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在摧毁老城区，以建造一个新的购物中心。

senses.example: After hearing the tragic news he TEARED UP and could hardly speak.
senses.example_zh: 听到这个悲惨的消息后，他热泪盈眶，几乎说不出话来。

senses.en: Place a golf ball on a short plastic or wooden stick before hitting it at the start of a hole..
senses.example: He TEED OFF at the first hole.
senses.example_zh: 他在第一洞开球。

senses.example: It TEES me OFF when theyturn up late.
senses.example_zh: 他们迟到时，这让我很恼火。

senses.example: She TEED OFF ON me about the work I gave her.
senses.example_zh: 她因为我给她的工作而批评我。

senses.en: Place a golf ball on a short plastic or wooden stick before hitting it at the start of a hole..
senses.example: She TEED UP two strokes ahead at the last hole.
senses.example_zh: 她在最后一洞以两杆优势开球。

senses.en: Make preparations before starting or launching something.
senses.example: They are TEEING UP for the conference tomorrow.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在为明天的会议做准备。

senses.example: The new project will TEE OFF next month.
senses.example_zh: 新项目将于下个月开始。

senses.en: See a difference between two things.
senses.example: They're identical twins so I cannot TELL them APART.
senses.example_zh: 他们是同卵双胞胎，所以我无法区分他们。

senses.en: Chide; talk angrily to someone about something they've done wrong..
senses.example: His fiancée TOLD him OFF for arriving nearly an hour late.
senses.example_zh: 他的未婚妻因为他迟到近一个小时而责备他。

senses.example: The pupil TOLD ON the others for cheating and the teacher failed them.
senses.example_zh: 那个学生告发了其他人作弊，老师给他们判了不及格。

senses.en: Cancel an appointment by sending a text message.
senses.example: I was feeling too tired to go and TEXTED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 我太累了不想去，就发短信取消了。

senses.example: I've THOUGHT it OVER and have made up my mind; I'm going to take the job in Leeds.
senses.example_zh: 我仔细考虑过了，已经下定决心；我要接受利兹的那份工作。

senses.en: Consider all the possibilities and outcomes of a situation.
senses.example: The plan fell through because they hadn't THOUGHT it THROUGH properly.
senses.example_zh: 这个计划失败了，因为他们没有全面考虑。

senses.en: Create or invent something, especially when lying.
senses.example: I'd better THINK UP a good reason for handing the work in late.
senses.example_zh: 我最好想出一个迟交作业的好理由。

senses.en: Discard something when no longer needed.
senses.example: I THREW the alarm clock AWAY because it had stopped working.
senses.example_zh: 我把闹钟扔掉了，因为它不走了。

senses.example: May I THROW IN with you? My companions left me behind.
senses.example_zh: 我可以加入你们吗？我的同伴把我落下了。

senses.example: They THREW IN a printer so I bought it from them.
senses.example_zh: 他们额外赠送了一台打印机，所以我从他们那里买了。

senses.example: I THREW OFF my shoes and flopped on the settee.
senses.example_zh: 我迅速脱下鞋子，一屁股坐在沙发上。

senses.example: It took me ages to THROW OFF the cold.
senses.example_zh: 我花了很长时间才摆脱感冒。

senses.example: The lamp THROWS OFF a lot of heat.
senses.example_zh: 这盏灯散发出大量的热。

senses.example: I THREW ON a jacket and rushed outside.
senses.example_zh: 我迅速穿上夹克，冲了出去。

senses.example: I THREW OUT all my old clothes to make some space in my wardrobe.
senses.example_zh: 我扔掉了所有旧衣服，以腾出衣柜的空间。

senses.example: Edward slipped on the ice and THREW OUT his shoulder.
senses.example_zh: 爱德华在冰上滑倒，肩膀脱臼了。

senses.example: The committee THREW the proposal OUT.
senses.example_zh: 委员会拒绝了这项提议。

senses.example: The car THROWS OUT a lot of smoke.
senses.example_zh: 这辆车排放大量烟雾。

senses.example: The school THREW him OUT for smoking.
senses.example_zh: 学校因他吸烟而开除了他。

senses.example: She THREW me OVER last year.
senses.example_zh: 她去年抛弃了我。

senses.example: They THREW OVER the agreement.
senses.example_zh: 他们拒绝了该协议。

senses.example: I THREW a quick dinner TOGETHER before we left.
senses.example_zh: 我们离开前，我匆忙拼凑了一顿晚餐。

senses.example: The prawns she ate at lunch made her THROW UP and she had to go home early.
senses.example_zh: 她午餐吃的对虾让她呕吐，她不得不提前回家。

senses.example: The talks THREW UP some interesting possibilities.
senses.example_zh: 会谈产生了一些有趣的可能性。

senses.en: Leave a job or position suddenly.
senses.example: She THREW UP her job to go travelling.
senses.example_zh: 她突然辞职去旅行了。

senses.en: Create clouds of dust or splash water into the air.
senses.example: The road was bumpy and the car in front was THROWING UP so much dust that we could hardly see where we were going.
senses.example_zh: 道路崎岖不平，前面的车扬起了大量灰尘，我们几乎看不清方向。

senses.en: Make it clear you are sexually attracted to someone.
senses.example: He THREW HIMSELF AT her but she wasn't interested.
senses.example_zh: 他向她投怀送抱，但她不感兴趣。

senses.example: She THREW herself INTO the project.
senses.example_zh: 她全身心投入到这个项目中。

senses.en: Make reasonable progress without any serious problems.
senses.example: Things are TICKING ALONG at work while the director's away.
senses.example_zh: 主任不在时，工作进展顺利。

senses.example: The last few seconds TICKED AWAY and the team couldn't come back.
senses.example_zh: 最后几秒过去了，球队未能扳回。

senses.example: The seconds TICKED BY and the team failed to score.
senses.example_zh: 时间一秒秒过去，球队未能得分。

senses.example: She really TICKS me OFF when she doesn't reply to my emails.
senses.example_zh: 她不回我邮件时，真让我生气。

senses.example: He TICKED me OFF for arriving late.
senses.example_zh: 他因我迟到而责备我。

senses.en: Put a mark on an item in a list when it has been dealt with.
senses.example: She TICKED OFF our names when we arrived.
senses.example_zh: 我们到达时，她在我们的名字旁打了勾。

senses.example: The company TICKED OVER while she was away on holiday.
senses.example_zh: 她休假期间，公司维持运转。

senses.example: The mechanic left the engine TICKING OVER for a while to see if he could see what was causing the problem.
senses.example_zh: 机械师让引擎空转了一会儿，看看能否找出问题原因。

senses.en: Use something carefully so as not to finish it.
senses.example: This £50 will have to TIDE me OVER until I get paid.
senses.example_zh: 这50英镑得帮我撑到发工资。

senses.en: Put things in the correct place in a room.
senses.example: I TIDIED UP my bedroom because it was a complete mess.
senses.example_zh: 我把卧室收拾了一下，因为实在太乱了。

senses.en: Fasten or secure so that it doesn't obstruct.
senses.example: She TIED her hair BACK before playing tennis.
senses.example_zh: 打网球前，她把头发向后扎了起来。

senses.en: Secure something to prevent it moving.
senses.example: They TIED him DOWN to stop him escaping.
senses.example_zh: 他们把他绑住，以防他逃跑。

senses.example: Marriage TIES you DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 婚姻会束缚你。

senses.en: Stop people (often police or military) going where they are needed.
senses.example: The army were TIED DOWN with the rebellion and couldn't help.
senses.example_zh: 军队被叛乱牵制，无法支援。

senses.example: The theory TIES IN with what the police have been saying.
senses.example_zh: 该理论与警方的说法相符。

senses.example: He is TIED IN somehow with the crime syndicate.
senses.example_zh: 他与犯罪集团有某种关联。

senses.example: The publication TIES IN the twentieth anniversary of the incident.
senses.example_zh: 该出版物与事件二十周年同时推出。

senses.example: They TIED UP the hostages so that they couldn't escape.
senses.example_zh: 他们把绑起来，以防他们逃跑。

senses.example: Work has TIED me UP all week.
senses.example_zh: 工作让我忙了一整周。

senses.example: I TIED UP my shoelaces.
senses.example_zh: 我系好了鞋带。

senses.example: The convoy TIED UP the road for an hour.
senses.example_zh: 车队把路堵了一个小时。

senses.en: Make something more secure or function better.
senses.example: They're TIGHTENING UP security for the president's visit.
senses.example_zh: 他们正在加强总统访问期间的安保。

senses.en: End or close because of a time limit.
senses.example: The program TIMED OUT before I could reply.
senses.example_zh: 我还没来得及回复，程序就超时了。

senses.en: End or close something because of a time limit.
senses.example: The program TIMED me OUT after twenty minutes.
senses.example_zh: 二十分钟后，程序让我超时退出了。

senses.en: Secretly inform the police or authorities.
senses.example: Thepolice arrested the drug dealer after someone TIPPED them OFF.
senses.example_zh: 有人向警方举报后，警察逮捕了毒贩。

senses.en: Spill, make something fall on its side.
senses.example: I TIPPED my coffee OVER and ruined my keyboard.
senses.example_zh: 我把咖啡打翻了，弄坏了键盘。

senses.example: She soon TIRED OF the course and dropped out.
senses.example_zh: 她很快就对课程厌倦了，退出了。

senses.example: Working so much TIRES me OUT.
senses.example_zh: 工作太累，让我筋疲力尽。

senses.example: It's geting late, so I'm going to TODDLE OFF home.
senses.example_zh: 天晚了，我要回家了。

senses.example: The Minister tried to TONE DOWN what she had said when the press started attacking her.
senses.example_zh: 媒体开始攻击后，部长试图缓和她说过的话。

senses.example: The company spent a lot on TOOLING the factory UP.
senses.example_zh: 公司花了很多钱为工厂装备设备。

senses.example: The gangsters got TOOLED UP before they went into the club.
senses.example_zh: 歹徒们进入俱乐部前武装好了自己。

senses.example: It's getting late, so we're going to TOOTLE OFFhome.
senses.example_zh: 天晚了，我们要回家了。

senses.en: Finish something in a special way.
senses.example: He complained for an hour and to TOP it OFF started shouting his head off.
senses.example_zh: 他抱怨了一个小时，最后还大喊大叫。

senses.en: Stop increasing, reach the highest point.
senses.example: The temperature TOPPED OUT at forty degrees yesterday.
senses.example_zh: 昨天气温最高达到四十度。

senses.example: Shall I TOP UP your drink while I'm pouring myself one?
senses.example_zh: 我给自己倒一杯时，也给你续上好吗？

senses.en: Discuss something freely and openly, but not very seriously.
senses.example: WE TOSSED ideas ABOUT before the negotiations.
senses.example_zh: 谈判前我们随意交流了一些想法。

senses.en: Discuss something freely and openly, but not very seriously.
senses.example: We TOSSED their plan AROUND a bit and then rejected it.
senses.example_zh: 我们稍微讨论了一下他们的计划，然后拒绝了。

senses.example: I TOSSED BACK my beer and left.
senses.example_zh: 我迅速喝掉啤酒然后离开了。

senses.example: I TOSSED a couple of drinks DOWN before they arrived.
senses.example_zh: 他们来之前我快速喝了几杯。

senses.example_zh: 我在必须交作业的前一晚仓促写完了那篇文章。

senses.en: Decide something by throwing a coin and seeing which side lands face up..
senses.example: We TOSSED UP to see who would kick off.
senses.example_zh: 我们掷硬币决定谁先开球。
