senses.example_zh: 飞机晚点一小时在成田机场着陆。

senses.example: I TOUCHED him FOR some cash as I'd forgotten my cards.
senses.example_zh: 我向他借了些现金，因为我忘带卡了。

senses.example: The government's decision TOUCHED OFF riots in the capital.
senses.example_zh: 政府的决定在首都引发了骚乱。

senses.example: The talk TOUCHED ON the issue, but didn't give any new information.
senses.example_zh: 演讲提到了这个问题，但没有提供任何新信息。

senses.example: I couldn't be bothered to redecorate, so I just TOUCHED UP the bits that needed painting the most.
senses.example_zh: 我懒得重新装修，所以只是修饰了最需要粉刷的地方。

senses.en: Touch someone in a sexual way.
senses.example: She got angry when he tried to TOUCH her UP in the elevator.
senses.example_zh: 他在电梯里试图猥亵她时，她生气了。

senses.example: They didn't TOUCH UPON the subject because of the controversy.
senses.example_zh: 由于争议，他们没有提及这个话题。

senses.en: Remove a vehicle, especially if parked illegally.
senses.example: I parked in a no-parking zone and they TOWED my car AWAY.
senses.example_zh: 我把车停在禁停区，他们就把我的车拖走了。

senses.en: Pretend to think about or think about in a casual way.
senses.example: She TOYED AT getting them to help her but then did it alone.
senses.example_zh: 她曾不认真地考虑让他们帮忙，但后来还是自己做了。

senses.example: I TOYED OVER the idea for a while, but decided not to go ahead with it.
senses.example_zh: 我考虑了这个想法一段时间，但决定不继续推进。

senses.en: Not eat much of a meal.
senses.example: It was horrible, so I just TOYED WITH the food.
senses.example_zh: 食物很难吃，所以我只是拨弄了几下。

senses.en: Consider something, but not very seriously.
senses.example: We TOYED WITH the idea of moving to the country, but it isn't really practical.
senses.example_zh: 我们曾不认真地考虑搬到乡下，但这不太实际。

senses.en: Move or play with something to occupy your hands.
senses.example: He TOYED WITH his cup.
senses.example_zh: 他摆弄着他的杯子。

senses.example: He thought she loved him but she was just TOYING WITH him.
senses.example_zh: 他以为她爱他，但她只是在玩弄他。

senses.example: It took me ages to TRACK them DOWN in thecrowd at the football game.
senses.example_zh: 我花了很长时间才在足球比赛的人群中追踪到他们。

senses.en: Sell something and replace it with something cheaper.
senses.example: Their house it too large now that their children have left home, so they're going to TRADE DOWN to something smaller.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们离开家后，他们的房子太大了，所以他们打算换购小一点的。

senses.en: Exchange something old as part of the price of something new.
senses.example: She TRADED IN her old car for the new model.
senses.example_zh: 她用旧车折价换购了新款。

senses.en: Leave your wife or husband to marry someone younger.
senses.example: He TRADED IN his wife when he became the chairman.
senses.example_zh: 他当上主席后就抛弃了妻子。

senses.en: Bargain, make a deal or compromise.
senses.example: A longer working week was TRADED OFF for a pay rise.
senses.example_zh: 延长工作周以换取加薪。

senses.en: Accept something you don't really want to get something you do want.
senses.example: We had to TRADE OFF space for the location when buying the apartment.
senses.example_zh: 买公寓时，我们不得不在空间和位置之间权衡取舍。

senses.en: Exploit, use something to your advantage.
senses.example: He TRADES ON their insecurity to get his way.
senses.example_zh: 他利用他们的不安全感来达到自己的目的。

senses.en: Buy larger or more expensive items.
senses.example: British wine drinkers have TRADED UP over the last few years from cheap plonk to expensive wines.
senses.example_zh: 过去几年，英国葡萄酒饮用者已从廉价酒换购为昂贵葡萄酒。

senses.en: Leave your wife or husband and marry someone better looking, richer, etc.
senses.example: Shesupported him for years while he was struggling, but when he hit the big time he left her and TRADED UP.
senses.example_zh: 在他奋斗期间，她支持了他多年，但当他成功后，他离开了她，另娶了别人。

senses.example: They TRADE UPON their reputation to scare rivals.
senses.example_zh: 他们利用自己的声誉来吓唬对手。

senses.en: Teach someone the specific skills they will need to carry out a job or task.
senses.example: I have been TRAINING my new assistant UP.
senses.example_zh: 我一直在培训我的新助手。

senses.en: Pass benefits from economic expansion through the economy to the less fortunate.
senses.example: Despite the economic boom, few benefits have TRICKLED DOWN to the poor.
senses.example_zh: 尽管经济繁荣，但惠及穷人的好处却寥寥无几。

senses.en: Be under the influence of psychoactive drugs.
senses.example: After taking the LSD he TRIPPED OUT for hours.
senses.example_zh: 服用LSD后，他产生了数小时的幻觉。

senses.example: I TRIPPED OVER and hurt my knee.
senses.example_zh: 我绊倒了，伤了膝盖。

senses.en: Fall because you hit an obstacle.
senses.example: I TRIPPED OVER the kerb and broke my nose.
senses.example_zh: 我被路缘石绊倒，摔断了鼻子。

senses.example: I TRIPPED UP in the interview when they asked me about what I could offer the company.
senses.example_zh: 面试时，当他们问我能为公司提供什么时，我犯了个错误。

senses.example: The meeting was over so I TROTTED OFF.
senses.example_zh: 会议结束了，所以我就走开了。

senses.example: I TROTTED OFF TO see the dentist.
senses.example_zh: 我跑去看牙医了。

senses.example: The spokeswoman TROTTED OUT the same old unconvincing excuses.
senses.example_zh: 女发言人又搬出了那些老掉牙的、令人无法信服的借口。

senses.example: The police TRUMPED UP the charges against him and he ended up in prison though he hadn't done it.
senses.example_zh: 警方捏造了对他的指控，尽管他没做过，他还是进了监狱。

senses.example: I called but they weren't in, so I'll TRY BACK later.
senses.example_zh: 我打过电话，但他们不在，所以我晚点再打。

senses.en: Make an attempt to get something.
senses.example: I'm going to TRY FOR the job.
senses.example_zh: 我要争取这份工作。

senses.en: Provoke someone by being annoying or behaving badly.
senses.example: The children were TRYING IT ON all night until I lost my temper.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们整晚都在试探我，直到我发了脾气。

senses.en: Attempt to get something, usually by deceit, without great hopes of success.
senses.example: He knew I wasn't got to let him do it-he was just TRYING IT ON.
senses.example_zh: 他知道我不会让他这么做——他只是在试探。

senses.en: Put clothes on to see if they fit.
senses.example: I TRIED the jacket ON before I bought it.
senses.example_zh: 买之前我试穿了那件夹克。

senses.example: Scientists are TRYING OUT a new drug in thefight against the disease.
senses.example_zh: 科学家们正在试验一种对抗该疾病的新药。

senses.en: Test something to see if you like it or want to buy it.
senses.example: I TRIED OUT the program before I bought it.
senses.example_zh: 我在购买之前试用了这个程序。

senses.en: Be tested for a sports team.
senses.example: He TRIED OUT FOR the baseball team.
senses.example_zh: 他参加了棒球队的选拔。

senses.en: Put something in a safe place.
senses.example: I TUCKED the money AWAY in my drawer.
senses.example_zh: 我把钱藏在了抽屉里。

senses.example: We TUCKED AWAY a huge dinner before we went out.
senses.example_zh: 我们出门前大吃了一顿。

senses.en: Tidy the ends of items of clothing by placing them inside something.
senses.example: I forgot to TUCK my shirt IN.
senses.example_zh: 我忘了把衬衫塞进去。

senses.example: The dinner smelled so good I couldn't wait to TUCK IN.
senses.example_zh: 晚餐闻起来太香了，我迫不及待地开吃。

senses.en: Arrange the sheets, duvet or blankets to make someone, usually a child, comfortable in bed.
senses.example: He TUCKED her IN and read her a story.
senses.example_zh: 他帮她掖好被子，给她读了个故事。

senses.example: I was starving and TUCKED INTO the food.
senses.example_zh: 我饿坏了，开始大吃起来。

senses.en: Arrange the sheets, duvet or blankets to make someone, usually a child, comfortable in bed.
senses.example: She TUCKED her children UP in bed and switched the lights off.
senses.example_zh: 她给孩子们掖好被子，关了灯。

senses.en: Watch or listen to a TV or radio show.
senses.example: Be sure to TUNE IN next week for the next episode.
senses.example_zh: 请务必下周收听下一集。

senses.en: Watch or listen to a TV or radio programme.
senses.example: Make sure you TUNE IN TO next week's show.
senses.example_zh: 请务必收听下周的节目。

senses.example: I TUNED him OUT because he was talking such rubbish.
senses.example_zh: 我没理他，因为他在胡说八道。

senses.en: Improve the performance of a machine or engine.
senses.example: He's TUNED his car UP for the race.
senses.example_zh: 他为比赛调试了汽车。

senses.en: Tune a musical instrument before playing.
senses.example: The orchestra TUNED UP their instruments before the concert.
senses.example_zh: 音乐会前，管弦乐队给乐器调了音。

senses.example: The public TURNED AGAINST the government when they became arrogant and ceased to listen.
senses.example_zh: 当政府变得傲慢且不再倾听时，公众转而反对它。

senses.en: Not allow someone to enter a place.
senses.example: The doorman TURNED him AWAY from the nightclub because he was wearing trainers.
senses.example_zh: 夜总会门卫因为他穿着运动鞋而把他拒之门外。

senses.example: The room was too hot, so she TURNED the heating DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 房间太热了，所以她把暖气调低了。

senses.example: They offered her the job, but she TURNED it DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 他们给了她这份工作，但她拒绝了。

senses.en: Fold the top covers of a bed down to make it ready for someone to go to sleep.
senses.example: The hotel staff TURNED DOWN the bed and scattered flower petals on it while we was having dinner.
senses.example_zh: 我们吃晚饭时，酒店员工为我们铺好了床，还在上面撒了花瓣。

senses.example: I TURNED IN at half past eleven because I had an early start the next morning.
senses.example_zh: 我十一点半就上床睡觉了，因为第二天一早就要出发。

senses.example: She TURNED IN her paper.
senses.example_zh: 她交了她的论文。

senses.example: Tadpoles TURN INTO frogs.
senses.example_zh: 蝌蚪会变成青蛙。

senses.example: I TURNED the TV OFF and went to bed.
senses.example_zh: 我关掉电视，然后去睡觉了。

senses.en: Cause someone to feel attraction or pleasure.
senses.example: He really TURNS me ON.
senses.example_zh: 他真让我着迷。

senses.example: I TURNED the radio ON to get the weather forecast.
senses.example_zh: 我打开收音机听天气预报。

senses.example: The neighbour's dog TURNED ON me when I tried to stroke it.
senses.example_zh: 我想摸邻居的狗时，它攻击了我。

senses.example: The factory TURNS OUT three thousand units a day.
senses.example_zh: 这家工厂每天生产三千件产品。

senses.example: It looked as if we were going to fail, but it TURNED OUT well in the end.
senses.example_zh: 看起来我们好像要失败了，但最后结果还不错。

senses.example: She TURNED OUT the lights and went to bed.
senses.example_zh: 她关掉灯，然后去睡觉了。

senses.example: Thousand TURNED OUT for the demonstration.
senses.example_zh: 数千人参加了示威游行。

senses.example: The court ordered the company to TURN OVER their financial records.
senses.example_zh: 法院命令该公司交出他们的财务记录。

senses.example: She had nobody to TURN TO when her husband died.
senses.example_zh: 她丈夫去世后，她无人可以求助。

senses.example: He TURNED TO drink after he lost his job.
senses.example_zh: 他失业后开始酗酒。

senses.example: She didn't TURN UP for class today.
senses.example_zh: 她今天没来上课。

senses.example: I TURNED the music UP full blast.
senses.example_zh: 我把音乐音量调到最大。

senses.example: He TYPED the text IN and printed it off.
senses.example_zh: 他把文本输入电脑并打印出来。

senses.en: Write a full or finished version of a text on a computer.
senses.example: She TYPED her essay OUT and handed it in a the last minute.
senses.example_zh: 她把论文打出来，在最后一刻交了上去。

senses.example: She TYPED UP her lecture notes and printed them out.
senses.example_zh: 她把讲课笔记打出来并打印了。

senses.example: Thecrowd URGED the players ON.
senses.example_zh: 人群为球员们加油鼓劲。

senses.en: Persuade or pressure to accept something.
senses.example: They URGED the deal ON the company.
senses.example_zh: 他们力劝该公司接受这笔交易。

senses.en: Persuade or pressure to accept something.
senses.example: They URGED the contract UPON us.
senses.example_zh: 他们力劝我们接受这份合同。

senses.en: Finish or consume all of something.
senses.example: We USED UPall the olive oil.
senses.example_zh: 我们用完了所有的橄榄油。

senses.en: Be at, mark or celebrate an important point in time.
senses.example: We always give a party USHER IN the NEW YEAR.
senses.example_zh: 我们总是举办派对来迎接新年。

senses.example: Her appointment as CEO USHERED IN a whole new phase in the company's growth.
senses.example_zh: 她被任命为首席执行官，开启了公司发展的全新阶段。

senses.example: He VACUUMED UP all of the food.
senses.example_zh: 他把所有食物都一扫而光。

senses.en: Make something more exciting, attractive, etc.
senses.example: The place is dull and you need to VAMP it UP.
senses.example_zh: 这个地方很沉闷，你需要把它弄得更有吸引力。

senses.example: I had to VAMP UP a reason for being so late.
senses.example_zh: 我只好编了个迟到的理由。

senses.example: I'm going to VEG OUT in front of the TV tonight.
senses.example_zh: 今晚我要在电视机前放松一下。

senses.example: If the storm has finished, we could VENTURE FORTH.
senses.example_zh: 如果暴风雨停了，我们就可以冒险出去了。

senses.en: Start something or get involved, often without thinking or to forcefully.
senses.example: He just WADED IN without listening to what anyone had to say.
senses.example_zh: 他根本不听别人怎么说就贸然介入了。

senses.example: The hooligans WADED IN when they saw fans from the other team.
senses.example_zh: 那些流氓看到对方球队的球迷就大打出手。

senses.en: Become embroiled or involved in a situation, without thinking or planning usually.
senses.example: They WADED INTO the negotiations and thedeal collapsed.
senses.example_zh: 他们贸然介入谈判，结果交易告吹了。

senses.en: Get to the end of something difficulty.
senses.example: It took me ages to WADE THROUGH the book.
senses.example_zh: 我花了很长时间才费力读完这本书。

senses.example: I WAITED ABOUT for an hour, but they didn't come.
senses.example_zh: 我干等了一个小时，但他们没来。

senses.example: Theywere just WAITING AROUND to see if anything was going to happen.
senses.example_zh: 他们只是干等着，看看会不会发生什么事。

senses.en: Stay somewhere after other people have left.
senses.example: I WAITED BEHIND to ask the lecturer a question.
senses.example_zh: 我留下来等，想问讲师一个问题。

senses.en: Stay at home because someone is going to visit.
senses.example: I WAITED IN for the guy to fix the TV.
senses.example_zh: 我在家等着修电视的人来。

senses.example: They have two people WAITING ON each table.
senses.example_zh: 他们有两个人在每张桌子服务。

senses.example: He WAITS ON customers in an electronics store.
senses.example_zh: 他在一家电子产品商店接待顾客。

senses.en: Provide someone with everything they need or want.
senses.example: He has a butler who WAITS ON him.
senses.example_zh: 他有一个管家服侍他。

senses.en: Wait for a result before being able to make a decision.
senses.example: They're WAITING ON the results of the vote before taking a final decision.
senses.example_zh: 他们在等待投票结果，然后才能做出最终决定。

senses.en: Wait till something has finished, usually something unpleasant.
senses.example: We'll have to WAIT OUT this uncertainty.
senses.example_zh: 我们不得不等待这种不确定性结束。

senses.en: Not go to bed because you are waiting.
senses.example: I was worried and WAITED UP until they got home safe and sound.
senses.example_zh: 我很担心，一直熬夜等他们平安回家。

senses.example: Wait up! I need to talk to you.
senses.example_zh: 等一等！我需要和你谈谈。

senses.en: Provide someone with what they require.
senses.example: They used to have servants WAITING UPON them.
senses.example_zh: 他们过去有仆人服侍他们。

senses.en: Wait for a result before being able to make a decision.
senses.example: They must WAIT UPON the outcome of the match before they know who they'll be playing.
senses.example_zh: 他们必须等待比赛结果，然后才能知道将和谁比赛。

senses.example: I WOKE UP at half past six this morning.
senses.example_zh: 我今天早上六点半醒来。

senses.example: You can't just WALK AWAY FROM your problems.
senses.example_zh: 你不能就这样逃避你的问题。

senses.example: She WALKED AWAY WITH the first prize.
senses.example_zh: 她轻松赢得了一等奖。

senses.example: They declined to WALK BACK FROM their comments despite the controversy.
senses.example_zh: 尽管有争议，他们拒绝收回自己的言论。

senses.en: Enter somewhere unexpectedly and see something.
senses.example: He WALKED IN ON them planning to sack him.
senses.example_zh: 他撞见他们正在计划解雇他。

senses.example: He WALKED INTO a great job straight after university.
senses.example_zh: 他大学毕业后直接轻松获得了一份好工作。

senses.en: Be unaware of the presence of something and either enter it (a trap) or bump into it (an obstruction).
senses.example: You WALKED INTO that one [You became victim to a trap I set]or I WALKED INTO a door and broke my nose.
senses.example_zh: 你中了那个圈套[你成了我设的陷阱的受害者]或者我撞上了门，摔断了鼻子。

senses.en: Go for a walk to reduce the effects of an illness or bad feeling.
senses.example: I tried to WALK OFF my hangover.
senses.example_zh: 我试图通过散步来消除宿醉。

senses.example: He WALKED OFF the award.
senses.example_zh: 他轻松赢得了那个奖项。

senses.en: Take something without permission or steal.
senses.example: Someone WALKED OFF my umbrella so I got soaked.
senses.example_zh: 有人顺手拿走了我的雨伞，所以我被淋湿了。

senses.example: I saw the accident but just WALKED ON as I didn't want to have to give a statement.
senses.example_zh: 我看到了事故，但继续走了，因为我不想做陈述。

senses.en: Leave work because of a dispute with the management.
senses.example: The workers WALKED OUT because the felt that safety wasn't being handled correctly.
senses.example_zh: 工人们罢工，因为他们觉得安全问题没有得到正确处理。

senses.en: Leave a place angrily or because you are not satisfied.
senses.example: The film was abore so I WALKED OUT halfway through.
senses.example_zh: 电影很无聊，所以我中途退场了。

senses.example: He WALKED OUT ON his wife last year.
senses.example_zh: 他去年抛弃了他的妻子。

senses.en: Explain or demonstrate something carefully to someone.
senses.example: He WALKED me THROUGH the procedures.
senses.example_zh: 他向我详细解释了这些程序。

senses.example: A man WALKED UP and asked me the time.
senses.example_zh: 一个男人走过来问我时间。

senses.example: She WALTZED THROUGH the tests and got the highest score.
senses.example_zh: 她轻松通过了测试，并获得了最高分。

senses.en: Leave a place, usually without telling other people.
senses.example: She WANDERED OFF and got lost in the crowd.
senses.example_zh: 她走散了，在人群中迷路了。

senses.example: The lecture was boring and my mind WANDERED OFF after ten minutes.
senses.example_zh: 讲座很无聊，十分钟后我就走神了。

senses.en: Want to leave a relationship or arrangement.
senses.example: Jackie wasn't happy with her marriage and WANTED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 杰基对她的婚姻不满意，想离开。

senses.example: The team WARMED UP half an hour before the volleyball match.
senses.example_zh: 球队在排球比赛前半小时进行了热身。

senses.en: When floods or waves completely remove a structure, building, etc..
senses.example: The ice cream stall on the beach was WASHED AWAY in the storm last night.
senses.example_zh: 海滩上的冰淇淋摊在昨晚的暴风雨中被冲走了。

senses.en: Drink in order to swallow something solid.
senses.example: I WASHED the antibiotics DOWN with a glass of water.
senses.example_zh: 我用一杯水送服了抗生素。

senses.en: Rain so heavily that an event has to be cancelled.
senses.example: The rain WASHED OUT the championship final.
senses.example_zh: 大雨使锦标赛决赛被迫取消。

senses.example: He felt numb as grief WASHED OVER him.
senses.example_zh: 当悲伤涌上心头时，他感到麻木。

senses.en: Clean everything used to prepare food and eat it.
senses.example: The children WASHED UP after lunch.
senses.example_zh: 孩子们午饭后洗了碗。

senses.en: When something in the sea or river is left on the shore or bank.
senses.example: After the crash, several bodies WASHED UP on the beach.
senses.example_zh: 事故发生后，几具尸体被冲上了海滩。

senses.example: Be sure you and the kids WASH UP before dinner.
senses.example_zh: 晚饭前你和孩子们一定要洗手洗脸。

senses.en: Become very thin and weak, usually due to illness.
senses.example: He WASTED AWAY as the cancer got worse.
senses.example_zh: 随着癌症恶化，他日渐消瘦。

senses.example: Watch out-there's ice on the road.
senses.example_zh: 当心——路上有冰。

senses.example: WATCH OUT FOR bats in the caves; many have rabies.
senses.example_zh: 提防洞穴里的蝙蝠；许多都携带狂犬病毒。

senses.en: Keep an eye on something or someone to check that there's no trouble.
senses.example: The lecturer WATCHED OVER the students as they did the experiment.
senses.example_zh: 讲师在学生做实验时照看着他们。

senses.en: Make something weaker and less effective.
senses.example: The Freedom of Information Act was WATERED DOWN by the Government and didn't give ordinary people much access to official data files
senses.example_zh: 政府淡化了《信息自由法》，没有给普通民众太多获取官方数据文件的途径。

senses.en: Ignore or refuse to consider what someone says.
senses.example: They WAVED ASIDE our objections and carried on with the plan.
senses.example_zh: 他们对我们的反对置之不理，继续执行计划。

senses.en: Make a hand signal to stop a vehicle.
senses.example: They WAVED the van DOWN and got a lift after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 事故后，他们挥手拦下了一辆货车，搭了便车。

senses.en: Go to a place where someone is leaving to wave goodbye.
senses.example: We WAVED her OFF at the station.
senses.example_zh: 我们在车站挥手送别她。

senses.en: Make a hand signal to tell someone to keep moving.
senses.example: The accident was bad, but the police WAVED us ON.
senses.example_zh: 事故很严重，但警察挥手让我们继续前行。

senses.en: Slowly stop a dependency on something.
senses.example: We will have to WEAN him OFF his obsession.
senses.example_zh: 我们得让他逐渐摆脱他的痴迷。

senses.example: The lawn has been WORN AWAY by people walking across it and it's just bare soil now with hardly a blade of grass.
senses.example_zh: 草坪被人踩得磨损了，现在只剩光秃秃的泥土，几乎看不到一片草叶。

senses.example: The stress of my job is WEARING me DOWN.
senses.example_zh: 工作的压力让我疲惫不堪。

senses.example: The anaesthetic WORE OFF and my tooth started hurting.
senses.example_zh: 麻醉药效消退后，我的牙开始疼了。

senses.en: Use something until it stops working.
senses.example: She played the video so many times that she WORE the tape OUT.
senses.example_zh: 她播放了太多次，把录像带都用坏了。

senses.example: The company WEEDED OUT the unsuccessful sales reps.
senses.example_zh: 公司淘汰了业绩不佳的销售代表。

senses.example: The requirements of her new job WEIGHED DOWN ON her.
senses.example_zh: 新工作的要求让她不堪重负。

senses.en: Have a certain weight (in sports like boxing).
senses.example: The champion WEIGHED IN at 120 kilos.
senses.example_zh: 这位冠军体重为120公斤。

senses.example: He disliked the plan and WEIGHED IN with some heavy criticism.
senses.example_zh: 他不喜欢这个计划，并加入争论提出了严厉批评。

senses.en: Enter an argument or discussion to express a strongly felt idea.
senses.example: She WEIGHED IN ON their immigration policies.
senses.example_zh: 她对他们的移民政策发表了意见。

senses.example: The issues raised WEIGHED ON her mind.
senses.example_zh: 提出的问题让她心事重重。

senses.en: Measure a certain amount of something by weight.
senses.example: Could you WEIGH OUT 200 grammes of that for me?
senses.example_zh: 你能帮我称出200克那个吗？

senses.example: They WEIGHED the pros and cons UP carefully before deciding.
senses.example_zh: 他们在做决定前仔细权衡了利弊。

senses.example: The way he spoke was WEIRDING me OUT.
senses.example_zh: 他说话的方式让我感到不安。

senses.example: I felt tears WELLING UP when I heard the news.
senses.example_zh: 听到这个消息时，我感到泪水涌了上来。

senses.example: Anger WELLED UP inside us when we saw what they had done.
senses.example_zh: 看到他们的所作所为，我们心中涌起怒火。

senses.en: Experience an emotion or feeling, start to cry.
senses.example: Tears WELLED UP when I heard they had died.
senses.example_zh: 听说他们去世了，我的眼泪涌了出来。

senses.en: Turn quickly and face in the opposite direction.
senses.example: When he heard the whistle, he WHEELED AROUND to see what was happening.
senses.example_zh: 听到哨声，他迅速转身看看发生了什么事。

senses.en: Use something like an explanation that has been used many times before and has lost its impact.
senses.example: They WHEELED OUT the same old excuses last time this happened.
senses.example_zh: 上次发生这种事时，他们又搬出了同样的老借口。

senses.en: Turn quickly and face in the opposite direction.
senses.example: She WHEELED ROUND when he told her to stop.
senses.example_zh: 他叫她停下时，她迅速转过身来。

senses.en: Spend time doing something because you have nothing better to do.
senses.example: We WHILED a couple of hours AWAY playing computer games.
senses.example_zh: 我们玩电脑游戏消磨了几个小时。

senses.en: Enter rapidly (as for a brief errand).
senses.example: Ben WHIPPED INTO the convenience store for a bag of crisps.
senses.example_zh: 本快速冲进便利店买了一袋薯片。

senses.example: The police officer WHIPPED OUT her radio and called for back-up.
senses.example_zh: 警察迅速拿出对讲机呼叫支援。

senses.example: Lola WHIPPED OUT OF a side street without looking and broadsided a police car.
senses.example_zh: 洛拉没有看路就快速从侧街冲出来，撞上了一辆警车的侧面。

senses.example: She WHIPPED THROUGH the task.
senses.example_zh: 她迅速完成了任务。

senses.example: We got back late and WHIPPED UP dinner.
senses.example_zh: 我们回来晚了，就快速做好了晚饭。

senses.en: Mix liquid food quickly to make it thick and creamy.
senses.example: I WHIPPED UP the egg whites.
senses.example_zh: 我把蛋清搅打好了。

senses.en: Make people feel more strongly about something.
senses.example: The boss tried to WHIP UP some support for her new policies.
senses.example_zh: 老板试图为她的新政策争取一些支持。

senses.example: The police WHISKED the minister AWAY when the trouble started.
senses.example_zh: 麻烦开始时，警察迅速把部长带走了。

senses.en: Use correction fluid to cover a mistake in a written text.
senses.example: Could you pass the Tippex? I need to WHITE this mistake OUT.
senses.example_zh: 你能把涂改液递给我吗？我需要把这个错误涂掉。

senses.example: He WIGGED OUT when he heard that he had failed.
senses.example_zh: 听说自己没通过，他抓狂了。

senses.example: He was supposed to be in charge but tried to WIGGLE OUT.
senses.example_zh: 他本该负责，却试图逃避。

senses.example: I WIGGLED OUT OF having to work late.
senses.example_zh: 我逃避了加班。

senses.en: Not be brave enough to do something.
senses.example: I was going to have the hottest curry on the menu, but I WIMPED OUT and had a mild lamb Korma instead.
senses.example_zh: 我本来打算点菜单上最辣的咖喱，但我退缩了，改点了温和的羊肉科尔马。

senses.example: I'm going to WIND DOWN in the country this weekend and do nothing.
senses.example_zh: 这个周末我要去乡下放松一下，什么都不做。

senses.en: Slowly close a business or organisation.
senses.example: They WOUND the committee DOWN after the inquiry.
senses.example_zh: 调查结束后，他们逐渐解散了委员会。

senses.en: Forward a film or tape to a certain point.
senses.example: He WOUND the video ON to show us the scene.
senses.example_zh: 他把录像带快进到那个场景给我们看。

senses.en: Close a company because it's unprofitable.
senses.example: The company was WOUND UP when the creditors demanded payment.
senses.example_zh: 债权人要求付款时，这家公司被关闭了。

senses.en: Tighten the spring in a watch or clock to make it work.
senses.example: I forgot to WIND UP my alarm clock and overslept.
senses.example_zh: 我忘了给闹钟上发条，睡过头了。

senses.en: Irritate someone or increase their stress level, especially if done deliberately.
senses.example: The children are really WINDING me UP
senses.example_zh: 孩子们真让我恼火。

senses.en: Find or get something that takes a great deal of effort.
senses.example: It took me a while to WINKLE the truth OUT of him.
senses.example_zh: 我花了好一会儿才从他那里套出真相。

senses.example: Revising for the exam last night WIPED me OUT.
senses.example_zh: 昨晚复习考试把我累坏了。

senses.en: Kill all of a population, make extinct.
senses.example: A meteor crashing into the planet WIPED the dinosaurs OUT.
senses.example_zh: 一颗流星撞击地球，使恐龙灭绝了。

senses.example: She WIRED her new stereo system UP as soon as she got home.
senses.example_zh: 她一到家就把新音响系统接好了。

senses.example: His supervisor told him to WISE UP and start following the rules or else he'd lose his job.
senses.example_zh: 他的主管叫他放聪明点，开始遵守规则，否则就会丢掉工作。

senses.example: The solicitor WORDED her UP client before the police interview, so they go very little out of him.
senses.example_zh: 律师在警察问话前向她的当事人交代了情况，所以他们几乎没从他那里得到什么信息。

senses.en: A phrase that was used a greeting.
senses.example: 'Word up! You OK?'
senses.example_zh: “嘿！你还好吗？”

senses.en: Exercise to remove stress or weight.
senses.example: She goes to the gym to WORK OFF her anger.
senses.zh: 通过运动消除（压力、体重等）
senses.example_zh: 她去健身房锻炼以消除怒气。

senses.example: Scientists are WORKING ON genetically modified crops and foods.
senses.example_zh: 科学家们正在研究转基因作物和食品。

senses.example: Things were going wrong for them but fortunately it all WORKED OUT in the end.
senses.example_zh: 他们的事情本来进展不顺，但幸运的是最后都圆满解决了。

senses.example: I couldn't WORK OUT all the answers to the crossword puzzle.
senses.example_zh: 我无法解出填字游戏的所有答案。

senses.example: They WORKED him OVER and robbed him.
senses.example_zh: 他们把他打了一顿，然后抢走了他的东西。

senses.example: They WORKED it OVER until they had got it right.
senses.example_zh: 他们反复修改，直到做对为止。

senses.example: They WORKED OVER the market looking for bargains.
senses.example_zh: 他们仔细搜寻市场，想找些便宜货。

senses.en: Deal with, resolve a problem, often emotional.
senses.example: It took him a long time to WORK THROUGH his anger after he lost his job.
senses.example_zh: 失业后，他花了很长时间才化解心中的愤怒。

senses.en: Cover with clothing, usually to keep warm.
senses.example: She WRAPPED a scarf AROUND her head because it was so cold.
senses.example_zh: 因为天气太冷，她用围巾裹住了头。

senses.en: Cover or encircle with part of your body.
senses.example: He WRAPPED his arms AROUND her.
senses.example_zh: 他用双臂搂住了她。

senses.en: Cover with clothing, usually to keep warm.
senses.example: He WRAPPED the cloth ROUND his fingers to keep warm.
senses.example_zh: 他把布裹在手指上保暖。

senses.en: or encircle with part of your body.
senses.example: She WRAPPED her arms ROUND him.
senses.example_zh: 她用双臂搂住了他。

senses.example: They WRAPPED UP the presents then put a ribbon around them.
senses.example_zh: 他们把礼物包好，然后系上丝带。

senses.example: WRAPUP carefully or you'll catch your death of cold outside in that rain.
senses.example_zh: 穿暖和点，否则你在外面的雨里会冻坏的。

senses.example: That WRAPS things UP, so we'll end this meeting.
senses.example_zh: 那就把一切收尾了，所以我们将结束这次会议。

senses.en: Avoid doing something in a way other people don't like.
senses.example: He always manages to WRIGGLE OUT OF any extra work we get.
senses.example_zh: 他总是能设法逃避我们得到的额外工作。

senses.example: I WROTE her mobile number DOWN on a scrap of paper and I've lost it.
senses.example_zh: 我把她的手机号码写在一张纸片上，结果弄丢了。

senses.en: Send a letter to a TV station, etc..
senses.example: They asked viewers to WRITE IN with their opinions and suggestions.
senses.example_zh: 他们请求观众写信来发表意见和提出建议。

senses.en: Destroy a car in an accident.
senses.example: He WROTE the car OFF in an accident on the motorway.
senses.example_zh: 他在高速公路上发生事故，把车报废了。

senses.example: I WROTE OUT my notes in full to help me remember them.
senses.example_zh: 我把笔记完整地写出来，以帮助自己记住。

senses.example: I WROTE UP the report and submitted it.
senses.example_zh: 我把报告整理成文并提交了。

senses.en: Talk continuously, especially if it is an annoying way.
senses.example: He YACKED ON for an hour.
senses.example_zh: 他喋喋不休地说了一个小时。

senses.en: Talk continuously, especially if it is an annoying way.
senses.example: She YAMMERED ON for ages.
senses.example_zh: 她喋喋不休地说了很久。

senses.example: I tried hard to resist, but in the end I YIELDED TO temptation and ate it all.
senses.example_zh: 我努力抵抗，但最后还是屈服于诱惑，把它全吃了。

senses.example: The police have ZEROED IN ON the man they believe to be responsible for the murder.
senses.example_zh: 警方已将注意力集中到他们认为应对谋杀负责的男子身上。

senses.example: The hurricane is ZEROING IN ON Florida.
senses.example_zh: 飓风正向佛罗里达逼近。

senses.en: Cut off funding for a project.
senses.example: The debt was ZEROED OUT by the department.
senses.example_zh: 该部门取消了这笔债务的资金。

senses.example: The entry was ZEROED OUT of the database.
senses.example_zh: 该条目已从数据库中删除。

senses.example: We ZIPPED AROUND the supermarket to get the shopping done.
senses.example_zh: 我们在超市里快速转了一圈，把该买的东西买了。

senses.example: The motorbike ZIPPED BY the cars stuck in the traffic jam.
senses.example_zh: 摩托车从堵在路上的汽车旁快速驶过。

senses.example: He told me to ZIP IT, so I said nothing.
senses.example_zh: 他叫我闭嘴，所以我什么也没说。

senses.example: He was being stupid in the meeting, so we told him to ZIP UP.
senses.example_zh: 他在会上表现得很愚蠢，所以我们叫他闭嘴。

senses.en: Pay attention after not doing so.
senses.example: I was bored at first but then ZONED IN when things started getting more interesting.
senses.example_zh: 起初我觉得无聊，但后来事情变得更有趣时，我就集中了注意力。

senses.en: Pay attention after not doing so.
senses.example: I ZONED IN ON what they were saying when they started gossiping.
senses.example_zh: 当他们开始闲聊时，我集中注意力听他们说话。

senses.example: She ZONED OUT during the lecture because it was so boring.
senses.example_zh: 讲座太无聊了，她走神了。

senses.example: I put some ambient music on and ZONED OUT.
senses.example_zh: 我放了些环境音乐，然后放空自己。

senses.example: I ZONKED OUT during the film and missed most of it.
senses.example_zh: 我在看电影时睡着了，错过了大部分内容。

senses.example: The camera ZOOMED IN to show people's faces.
senses.example_zh: 摄像机拉近镜头，显示人们的脸。

senses.example: The camera ZOOMED IN ON his face.
senses.example_zh: 摄像机拉近镜头对准他的脸。

senses.example: He rushed out of the building and ZOOMED OFF in his car.
senses.example_zh: 他冲出大楼，开车快速离开了。

senses.example: The camera ZOOMED OUT to show all the crowd.
senses.example_zh: 摄像机拉远镜头，显示整个人群。
